1module water_tracers
2!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3!
4! Provide core functionality for water tracers.
5!
6! This module works in tandem with "waterisotope" which specifically
7! teats the istopic fractionation.
8!
9! All interface routine are identified by wtrc_*, etc.
10!
11! Indexing ASSUMES (as everywhere else in CAM), normal water vapour is
12! m=1. Cloud liquid and ice are probably m=2 and m=3... but not
13! assumed, as they are correctly registered.
14!
15! DEFAULT CONFIGURATION is for 3 additional tracers with each of 3 phases, to
16! parallel the base CAM water prognosis. This default is invoked by setting the
17! namelist variable "wisotope". If not set, don't know what to do, so
18! complain and crash.
19!
20! Note total vapout (Q) is registered as wet, even though it is treated
21! as dry. This means the PD coupling is diferent from the vertical
22! diffusion. Do get around this we make all water species wet, but have
23! spacial cased for vapour, as in main cam code.
24!
25!
26! Code here based on chemistry.F90 and cldcond.F90.
27!
28! Author: David Noone <dcn@caltech.edu> - Sun Jun 29 15:22:48 MDT 2003
29!
30! Modified (slightly) for CAM5 by Jesse Nusbaumer <nusbaume@colorado.edu> - 4-3-11
31!
32! 2/4/2012 - bardeenc : Significant refactoring to accomplish several goals:
33! - broke out water_types
34! - configuration is driven by configure and build_namelist, rather than
35! being hard coded
36! - added support for rain and snow
37! - made an explicit distinction between tagging and isotopes
38! to allow for better checking
39! - added explicit definition of surface fields
40! - made more granular, but extensible list of tracers to ease
41! looping over subsets of the tracers
42!
43! For precipitation, still need to decide if we need to track
44! convective and large scale precipitation separately. Also need
45! deal with precipitation totals at the surface and getting those
46! coupled to the surface models.
47!
48! Will the interface for the process rates from stratiform also
49! work for convection and any other place where phase changes or
50! transport is happening?
51!
52!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
53

331!
332! Purpose: register advected water tracer constituents
333!
334! Method:
335! Calls CAM constituent registration routines based on
336! water tracer species and phase indexing. Create a number of tracer

352 !use pio, only: pio_seterrorhandling, PIO_INTERNAL_ERROR

3792918430208 iwistag(:) = .false.

393

39512 write(iulog,*) ''

399 ! Count up the number of water tracers

4021433614336 icnst = icnst + 1

45635843584 call cnst_get_ind(wtrc_bulk_names(icnst), wtrc_bulk_indices(icnst))
457 iwspec(wtrc_bulk_indices(icnst)) = isph2o
458 end do
459
460 ! Make a list of the bulk (parent) constituents for the water types.
461 ! It might be better if iwspec and iwater were added as variables in
462 ! constituent.F90
463 ! and the calls that create these constituents updated to set the
464 ! variables correctly.
46535844096 do icnst = 1, pwtype
46635843584 call cnst_get_ind(wtrc_bulk_names(icnst), wtrc_bulk_indices(icnst))
467 iwspec(wtrc_bulk_indices(icnst)) = isph2o
468 end do
469
470 ! Is this constituent a tag or an isotopologue?
471358400359424 wtrc_is_tag(:) = .false.
4721433614848 do icnst = 1,wtrc_ncnst
473401408415744 do itag = 1,wtrc_ncnst
474401408401408 if (wtrc_tag_names(itag) == wtrc_names(icnst)) then
47500 wtrc_is_tag(icnst) = .true.
476 exit
477 end if
478 end do
479 end do
480
481 ! Add constituents for each of the isotope tracers.
48220483072 wtrc_nspec(:) = 0
48335844608 wtrc_ntype(:) = 0
484
4851433614848 do icnst = 1, wtrc_ncnst
486
487 ! The weight of the condensate is too large for the standard diffusion
488 ! routines, so treat them as just part of the air parcel and adjust
489 ! later
490 ! in the microphysics.
4911433614336 if (wtrc_types(icnst) == iwtvap) then
49220482048 mw = mwh2o
493 cp = cpwv
494 else
4951228812288 mw = mwdry
496 cp = cpair
497 end if
498
4991433671680 longname = trim(wtrc_species_names(icnst)) // ' isotope mmr for ' // trim(wtrc_type_names(icnst))
500
5011433614336 if (wtrc_is_tag(icnst)) then
50200 longname = trim(longname) // ' (tagged)'
503 end if
504
505 ! Check if tracer is present on initial conditions file:
506 ! Currently doesn't work with CIME/pio code used in iHESP. -JN
507
508 !ierr = pio_inq_varid(fh_ini, wtrc_names(icnst), wtrc_fil_id)
509 !if (ierr == PIO_NOERR) then
510 ! readiv_val = .true.
511 !else
512 ! readiv_val = .false.
513 !end if
5141433614336 readiv_val = .false.
515
516 ! Register the water isotope tracer.
5171433614336 call wtrc_cnst_add(wtrc_names(icnst), wtrc_types(icnst), wtrc_species(icnst), &
518 wtrc_is_tag(icnst), mw, cp, 0._r8, wtrc_indices(icnst), longname, readiv=readiv_val)
519
520 ! Make some indices and counts to make it easier to loop over the isotopes.
5211433614336 wtrc_ntype(wtrc_types(icnst)) = wtrc_ntype(wtrc_types(icnst)) + 1
522 wtrc_iatype(wtrc_ntype(wtrc_types(icnst)), wtrc_types(icnst)) = wtrc_indices(icnst)
523
524 wtrc_nspec(wtrc_species(icnst)) = wtrc_nspec(wtrc_species(icnst)) + 1
525! wtrc_iaspec(wtrc_nspec(wtrc_types(icnst)), wtrc_species(icnst)) = wtrc_indices(icnst)
526 wtrc_iaspec(wtrc_nspec(wtrc_species(icnst)), wtrc_species(icnst)) = wtrc_indices(icnst)
527
528 ! The constituents are assumed to be ordered by wset.
529 wtrc_iawset(wtrc_types(icnst), ((icnst - 1) / pwtype) + 1) = wtrc_indices(icnst)
530
531 ! Make sure they are all the same species.
532 if (mod((icnst - 1), pwtype) /= 0) then
5331228812288 if (wtrc_species(icnst) /= wtrc_species(((icnst - 1) / pwtype) * pwtype + 1)) then
53400 call endrun("WTRC_INIT: Error - Water tracers must be ordered by wsets of the same isotopic species.")
535 end if
536 end if
537 end do
538
539 ! Set PIO error-handling back to its original value:
540 ! Currently doesn't work with CIME/pio code used in iHESP. -JN
541 !call pio_seterrorhandling(fh_ini, PIO_INTERNAL_ERROR)
542
543 ! Determine which specifies are coupled to the surface.
544512512 icnst = 1
54520482560 do while(wtrc_srfvap_names(icnst) /= "")
54620484096 wtrc_iasrfvap(icnst) = wtrc_get_icnst(wtrc_srfvap_names(icnst))
547 if (wtrc_iasrfvap(icnst) == -1) then
54800 call endrun('WTRC_INIT: Error - Surface vapor tracer not found for ' // trim(wtrc_srfvap_names(icnst)))
549 end if
55020482048 icnst = icnst + 1
551 end do
552512512 wtrc_nsrfvap = icnst-1
553
554 ! Set output names:
55520482048 do icnst=1, wtrc_nsrfvap
55620482048 wtstrng = wtrc_srfvap_names(icnst) !copy string
55720482048 wtstsz = scan(wtstrng,'V',BACK=.true.) !determine size of string (to cut off trailing "V").
55820482048 wtrc_out_names(icnst) = wtstrng(1:wtstsz-1) !Remove trailing V.
559 end do
560
561512512 icnst = 1
56281928704 do while(wtrc_srfpcp_names(icnst) /= "")
563819216384 wtrc_iasrfpcp(icnst) = wtrc_get_icnst(wtrc_srfpcp_names(icnst))
564 if (wtrc_iasrfpcp(icnst) == -1) then
56500 call endrun('WTRC_INIT: Error - Surface precipitation tracer not found for ' // trim(wtrc_srfpcp_names(icnst)))
566 end if
56781928192 icnst = icnst + 1
568 end do
569512512 wtrc_nsrfpcp = icnst-1
570
571 ! Add 2D surface precipitation variables in the physics buffer for each of the
572 ! precipitation types and wsets.
573358400512512 wtrc_srfpcp_indices(:,:) = -1
574
57520482560 do iwset = 1, wtrc_nwset
576204820480 call pbuf_add_field('P_' // trim(cnst_name(wtrc_iawset(iwtcvrain, iwset))), 'physpkg', dtype_r8, (/pcols/), pidx)
577 wtrc_srfpcp_indices(iwtcvrain,iwset) = pidx
578
579204818432 call pbuf_add_field('P_' // trim(cnst_name(wtrc_iawset(iwtcvsnow, iwset))), 'physpkg', dtype_r8, (/pcols/), pidx)
580 wtrc_srfpcp_indices(iwtcvsnow,iwset) = pidx
581
582204818432 call pbuf_add_field('P_' // trim(cnst_name(wtrc_iawset(iwtstrain, iwset))), 'physpkg', dtype_r8, (/pcols/), pidx)
583 wtrc_srfpcp_indices(iwtstrain,iwset) = pidx
584
585204816384 call pbuf_add_field('P_' // trim(cnst_name(wtrc_iawset(iwtstsnow, iwset))), 'physpkg', dtype_r8, (/pcols/), pidx)
586 wtrc_srfpcp_indices(iwtstsnow,iwset) = pidx
587 end do
588
589 ! Once the registration is done, report what we actually have just to make sure
590512512 if ( masterproc ) then
59111 call wtrc_setup_diag
592
59312 write(iulog,*) 'WTRC_REGISTER: done.'
59412 write(iulog,*) ''
595 end if
596 end if
597
598
599 return
600512512end subroutine wtrc_register
601

7601433614336 subroutine wtrc_cnst_add(name, iwt, isp, is_tag, mwc, cpc, qminc, ind, &
761 longname, readiv, mixtype)
762!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
763! Purpose: provide a wrapper for cnst_add with added index condifuration
764! for more details registration of water tracers
765! Author: David Noone <dcn@caltech.edu> - Sun Jun 29 21:02:25 MDT 2003
766!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
767 use constituents, only: cnst_add
768!---------------------------- Arguments --------------------------------
769 character(len=*), intent(in) :: &
770 name ! constituent name for variable name in history file(8 char max)
771 character(len=*), intent(in), optional :: &
772 longname ! long_name attribute in netcdf output (128 char max) [name]
773 logical, intent(in), optional :: &
774 readiv ! true => read initial values from initial file (default: true)
775 character(len=*), intent(in), optional :: &
776 mixtype ! mixing ratio type (dry, wet)
777
778! integer, intent(in) :: type ! flag indicating advected or nonadvected
779 integer, intent(in) :: iwt ! water type indicator
780 integer, intent(in) :: isp ! water species indicator
781 logical, intent(in) :: is_tag ! tagged tracer indicator
782 real(r8),intent(in) :: mwc ! const. molecular weight (kg/kmol)
783 real(r8),intent(in) :: cpc ! const. spcfic heat const press (J/kg/K)
784 real(r8),intent(in) :: qminc ! minimum mass mixing ratio (kg/kg)
785! normally 0., except water 1.E-12, for
786! radiation.
787
788 integer, intent(out) :: ind ! global constituent index (in q array)
789
790!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
791!
792! Pass arguments on to normal code
793!
7941433657344 call cnst_add(name, mwc, cpc, qminc, ind, longname, readiv, mixtype)
795!
796! Knowing the tracer index assign water type and species
797!
7981433614336 iwater(ind) = iwt
799 iwspec(ind) = isp
800 iwistag(ind) = is_tag
801!
802 return
8031433614336 end subroutine wtrc_cnst_add

8381433614336 subroutine wtrc_init_cnst(name, q, gcid, qq, ql, qi)
839!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
840!
841! Initializes water tracers if not read from initial conditions file.
842! Assign as some standard mass fraction of the prognostic waters
843! (which can assumed are set correctly). If using water isotope
844! Set the standard ration, else set zero
845!
846!
847! Author: David Noone <dcn@caltech.edu> - Sun Jun 29 18:24:57 MDT 2003
848! 2/3/2012 - bardeenc : Changed to a way compatible with CAM5's initialization
849! interface; however, it requires some special coding in initdat.F90.
850!
851!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
852 use constituents, only: pcnst, cnst_get_ind
853!---------------------------- Arguments --------------------------------
854 character(len=*),intent(in) :: name ! tracer name
855 real(r8), intent(out) :: q(:,:) ! mass mixing ratio (gcol, lev)
856 integer, intent(in) :: gcid(:) ! global column id
857 real(r8), intent(in) :: qq(:,:) ! Q mass mixing ratio (gcol, lev)
858 real(r8), intent(in) :: ql(:,:) ! CLDLIQ mass mixing ratio (gcol, lev)
859 real(r8), intent(in) :: qi(:,:) ! CLDICE mass mixing ratio (gcol, lev)
860 !------------------------- Local Variables -----------------------------
861 integer ixwtrc ! index of water tracer
862 integer ixwprg ! intext of water prognostic
863 real(r8) rat ! an isotope ratio
864!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
865!
866
867 ! Retrieve the tracer index, and work out index of equivilent prognostic
8681433628672 call cnst_get_ind(name, ixwtrc) ! this SHOULD be m in calling routine
8691433628672 if (.not. wtrc_is_wtrc(ixwtrc)) then
87000 call endrun( 'WTRC_INIT_CNST: non water tracer detected.')
871 else
872
873 ! Assign tracer to be total, scaled by some standard ratio
8741433614336 if (trace_water) then
875
876 !standard ratio or isotope run:
8771433628672 rat = wtrc_get_rstd(iwspec(ixwtrc))
878 !----------------------
8791433628672 if(wtrc_is_tagged(ixwtrc)) then !not standard (H2O) water
88000 rat = 0._r8
881 end if
882 !----------------------
8831433614336 if (iwater(ixwtrc) == iwtvap) then
88416591201847536 q(:,:) = rat * qq(:,:)
8851228812288 else if (iwater(ixwtrc) == iwtliq) then
88616591201847536 q(:,:) = rat * ql(:,:)
8871024010240 else if (iwater(ixwtrc) == iwtice) then
88816591201847536 q(:,:) = rat * qi(:,:)
889 else
89066364807390144 q(:,:) = 0._r8
891 end if
892 else
89300 q(:,:) = 0._r8
894 end if
895 end if
896
897 return
8981433614336 end subroutine wtrc_init_cnst
899

902431371200431371200 subroutine wtrc_add_rate(process_rates, icol, iz, isrctype, idsttype, rtype, rate, do_reverse)
903!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
904!
905! Purpose: Add process rate to matrix
906!
907! Method:
908! Add a process rate for the production of idsttype from isrctype
909! to a matrix of process rates. This routine will add the reverse
910! rate for the loss term for isrctype to idsttype.
911!
912! Author: Chuck Bardeen
913!
914!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
915 use water_types, only: pwtype
916
917 real(r8), intent(inout) :: process_rates(pcols,pver,pwtype,pwtype,pwtype) ! process rates (kg/kg/sec)
918 integer, intent(in) :: icol ! column index
919 integer, intent(in) :: iz ! vertical index
920 integer, intent(in) :: isrctype ! source water type index
921 integer, intent(in) :: idsttype ! destination water type index
922 integer, intent(in) :: rtype ! water type used to calculate ratio - JN
923 real(r8), intent(in) :: rate ! process rate (kg/kg/s) for src -> dst
924 logical, intent(in), optional :: do_reverse ! apply reverse rates too (default=true)
925
926 logical :: ldo_reverse
927!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
928
929 ! Determine whether to apply the reverse rates.
9304313712001294113600 if (present(do_reverse)) then
93100 ldo_reverse = do_reverse
932 else
933431371200431371200 ldo_reverse = .true.
934 end if
935
936431371200431371200 process_rates(icol, iz, idsttype, isrctype, rtype) = process_rates(icol, iz, idsttype, isrctype, rtype) + rate
937
938366665520366665520 if ((isrctype /= idsttype) .and. (ldo_reverse)) then
939366665520366665520 process_rates(icol, iz, isrctype, idsttype, rtype) = process_rates(icol, iz, isrctype, idsttype, rtype) - rate
940 end if
941
942 return
943431371200431371200 end subroutine wtrc_add_rate
944
945
946!=======================================================================
94710649601064960 subroutine wtrc_add_rates(process_rates, ncol, top_lev, isrctype, idsttype, rtype, rate, do_reverse)
948!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
949!
950! Purpose: Add process rates to matrix
951!
952! Method:
953! Add process rates for the production of idsttype from isrctype
954! to a matrix of process rates. This routine will also add the
955! rate for the loss term for for isrctype to idsttype.
956!
957! Author: Chuck Bardeen
958!
959!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
960 use water_types, only: pwtype
961
962 real(r8), intent(inout) :: process_rates(pcols,pver,pwtype,pwtype,pwtype) ! process rates (kg/kg/sec)
963 integer, intent(in) :: ncol ! number of columns
964 integer, intent(in) :: top_lev ! top vertical level
965 integer, intent(in) :: isrctype ! source water type index
966 integer, intent(in) :: idsttype ! destination water type index
967 integer, intent(in) :: rtype ! water type used to calculate Ratio - JN
968 real(r8), intent(in) :: rate(pcols,pver) ! process rate (kg/kg/s) for src -> dst
969 logical, intent(in), optional :: do_reverse ! apply reverse rates too (default=true)
970
971 integer :: k
972 integer :: icol
973!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
974
9753194880033013760 do k = top_lev, pver
976431371200463320000 do icol = 1, ncol
9774313712001294113600 call wtrc_add_rate(process_rates, icol, k, isrctype, idsttype, rtype, rate(icol,k), do_reverse)
978 end do
979 end do
980
981 return
98210649601064960 end subroutine wtrc_add_rates
983

986159744159744 subroutine wtrc_init_rates(top_lev, process_rates )
987!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
988!
989! Purpose: Initialize process rate matrix
990!
991! Method:
992! Initializes the matrix of process rates.
993!
994! Author: Chuck Bardeen
995!
996!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
997 use water_types, only: pwtype
998
999 integer, intent(in) :: top_lev ! Top vertical level
1000 real(r8), intent(out) :: process_rates(pcols,pver,pwtype,pwtype,pwtype) ! Process rates (kg/kg/sec)
1001
1002!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1003
10042630025216031423082496 process_rates(:, top_lev:, :, :, :) = 0._r8
1005
1006 return
1007159744159744 end subroutine wtrc_init_rates

1010!=======================================================================
1011106496212992 subroutine wtrc_apply_rates(pstate, ptend_sum, pbuf, top_lev, dtime, micro, pre_rates, sed_rates, post_rates, do_stprecip, &
1012 liqcldf, icecldf, fc, fi, prelat, postlat, frzro, meltso)
1013!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1014!
1015! Purpose: Calculate water tracer tendencies from process rates
1016!
1017! Method:
1018! Given the microphysics process rates (pre-sedimentation, sedimentation
1019! and/or post-sedimentation), calculate the effect of these rater on the
1020! mass mixing ratio of water tracers.
1021!
1022! An iterative technique is used with pre, sed and post rates applied
1023! during each iteration.
1024!
1025! NOTE: The physics state state supplied should be the same one
1026! used for the bulk water properties calculation that generated the
1027! rates, and the tendency should only include the results of the
1028! tendencies from those processes.
1029!
1030! Author: Chuck Bardeen
1031!
1032! NOTE: I have commented out the adjust_H2O calls in this routine because
1033! they seemed to produce errors. However, the testing was done with niter
1034! set to 1. Thus if looping is turned on, and the values become substantially
1035! worse, then the adjust_H2O subroutines might need to be reinstated. - JN
1036! NOTE: Adding addtional iterations appeared to make no difference. Still,
1037! the adjust_H2O routine calls will remain just in case, at least until the code is
1038! cleaned-up. - JN
1039!
1040! NOTE: The subroutine here makes the assumption that the tendency rates are a
1041! linear function of the state, e.g.: dq/dt = f(q_i) = f(Rq) = R*f(q).
1042! However, in the actual microphysics routine, the relationship is often-times
1043! non-linear, and thus this subroutine may not be able to simulate those cloud
1044! physical tendencies with full accuracy. If it is found that the stratiform
1045! isotope values are not as they should be, this could be the culprit. - JN
1046!
1047! NOTE: The order of operations has been changed such that each phase change happens
1048! sequentially, instead of all at once. Although this is not as physically
1049! realistic, it does eliminate an error in the isotopic stratiform precipitation
1050! ,and it allows one to use substantially less code. However, if its found that
1051! accurate isotope values simply cannot be produced with this subroutine, then the
1052! modified order of operations may be to blame. - JN
1053!
1054!-----------------------------------------------------------------------

1196

1198 !calculate ratio:
11992780214827802148 if(isrctype .eq. iwtstrain) then !rain
12001453046029060920 R = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(msrc),rmass0(i,iwset),rmass0(i,1))
1201 else !snow
12021327168826543376 R = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(msrc),smass0(i,iwset),smass0(i,1))
1203 end if
1204 else

1206 end if
1207
1208181030108531414092 if(wisotope .and. (iwset .ne. 1) .and. (isrctype .eq. iwtvap) .and. &

1210 !only do Rayleigh distillation for water isotopes.

121284929198492919 ispec = iwspec(mdst) !determine isotope species of ice or snow (and thus vapoor)
1213849291916985838 alpha = wtrc_get_alpha(qloc0(i,k,wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,WTRC_WSET_STD)), &
1214 tloc(i,k), ispec, isrctype, idsttype, &

1221

1223 if(idsttype .eq. iwtstsnow) then !snow?
122400 smass(i,iwset) = smass(i,iwset) + (qloc0(i,k,msrc)-qloc(i,k,msrc))*pstate%pdel(i,k)
1225 else !ice?
122684929198492919 qloc(i,k,mdst) = qloc(i,k,mdst) + (qloc0(i,k,msrc)-qloc(i,k,msrc))
1227 end if
1228
1229172537189280990089 else if(((isrctype .eq. iwtliq) .or. (isrctype .eq. iwtice)) .and. (isrctype .eq. idsttype)) then
1230 !Apply Bergeron process to ice:

123296796569679656 if(isrctype .eq. iwtliq) then !liquid type used for Bergeron to ice
123348691124869112 mdst = wtrc_iawset(iwtice,iwset)
1234 else !ice type used for Bergeron to snow

123948105449621088 R = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(msrc),qloc0(i,k,msrc),qloc0(i,k,mbase)) !calculate ratio for single level
1240 end if
1241967965619359312 if(wisotope .and. (iwset .gt. 1)) then !Are you doing water isotopes?
1242 !Fractionation variables:

1244
1245 !cloud ice and snow use the same fractionation factors, so just use ice:
1246725974214519484 alpha = wtrc_get_alpha(qloc0(i,k,wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,WTRC_WSET_STD)), &
1247 tloc(i,k), ispec, iwtvap, iwtice, &
1248 .true., pstate%pmid(i,k))
1249

1252 R*pre_rates(i,k,idsttype,isrctype,rtype)*dtime/wtrc_niter

1254

1257

1259

1262 pre_rates(i,k,idsttype,isrctype,rtype)*dtime/wtrc_niter))
1263 !Constrain ratio fraction:

1265
1266725974214519484 qloc(i,k,wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,iwset)) = qloc0(i,k,wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,iwset))*(fr**alpha) !vapor
1267 if(mdst .eq. wtrc_iawset(iwtstsnow,iwset)) then !snow?
126836079083607908 smass(i,iwset) = smass(i,iwset) + (qloc0(i,k,wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,iwset))-&
1269 qloc(i,k,wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,iwset)))*pstate%pdel(i,k)
1270 else !ice
127136518343651834 qloc(i,k,mdst) = qloc(i,k,mdst) + (qloc0(i,k,wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,iwset))-&
1272 qloc(i,k,wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,iwset)))
1273 end if

1281 end if

1302 ! end if
1303 else
1304162857533162857533 alpha = 1._r8
1305 !Add tendency to destination:
1306 if(idsttype .eq. iwtstrain) then !rain?
13071411655214116552 rmass(i,iwset) = rmass(i,iwset) + (R*pre_rates(i,k,idsttype,isrctype,rtype)*dtime* &
1308 pstate%pdel(i,k))/wtrc_niter
1309 else if(idsttype .eq. iwtstsnow) then !snow?
13102912988029129880 smass(i,iwset) = smass(i,iwset) + (R*pre_rates(i,k,idsttype,isrctype,rtype)*dtime* &
1311 pstate%pdel(i,k))/wtrc_niter
1312 else !not precip?

1314 end if

13181453046014530460 rmass(i,iwset) = rmass(i,iwset) - (R*pre_rates(i,k,idsttype,isrctype,rtype)*dtime* &
1319 pstate%pdel(i,k))/wtrc_niter
1320 else if(isrctype .eq. iwtstsnow) then !snow?
13211327168813271688 smass(i,iwset) = smass(i,iwset) - (R*pre_rates(i,k,idsttype,isrctype,rtype)*dtime* &
1322 pstate%pdel(i,k))/wtrc_niter

1324113874297113874297 qloc(i,k,msrc) = qloc(i,k,msrc)-alpha*R*pre_rates(i,k,idsttype,isrctype,rtype)*dtime/wtrc_niter

1331181030108271545162 rmass0(i,:) = rmass(i,:) !update precip
1332181030108271545162 smass0(i,:) = smass(i,:)

1344 tloc(i,k), iwspec(wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,iwset)), &

1351 end if

1358 !Calculate precipitation melting and freezing

136186274240107842800 do iwset = 1,wtrc_nwset
1362 !NOTE: melting and freezing should never occur at the same time. -JN

136486274240172548480 R = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iawset(iwtstrain,iwset)),smass0(i,iwset),smass0(i,1))
1365 rmass(i,iwset) = rmass(i,iwset) + R*meltso(i,k)*dtime

13688627424086274240 R = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iawset(iwtstrain,iwset)),rmass0(i,iwset),rmass0(i,1))
1369 smass(i,iwset) = smass(i,iwset) + R*frzro(i,k)*dtime
1370 rmass(i,iwset) = rmass(i,iwset) - R*frzro(i,k)*dtime
1371 end do

137386274240129411360 smass0(i,:) = smass(i,:)
1374 end if

1381

1384
13856470568082441746 if((rmass(i,iwset) .gt. 0._r8) .and. ((icecldf(i,k) + liqcldf(i,k)) .le. 1.e-4_r8)) then
1386 !rain exists but no clouds (i.e. below cloud base)

138973869407386940 ispec = iwspec(wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,iwset))
1390

1396 iwspec(wtrc_iatype(iwset,iwtvap)), &
1397 iwtvap, iwtliq, .false.,1._r8,.false.)

14002954776044321640 difrm = (/ 1._r8, 1._r8, 0.9836504_r8, 0.9686999_r8 /) ! kinetic theory
1401

1403 !NOTE: mean diameter in mm = 4/(4.1*R^-0.21), with R in mm/hr, assuming
1404 !a Marshall-Palmer distribution. -JN
1405738694014773880 radius = 2._r8/(4.1_r8*((rmass(i,1)/gravit/dtime)*60._r8*60._r8)** (-0.21_r8))
1406

1409

141173869407386940 call wtrc_equil_time(ispec,tloc(i,k),pstate%pmid(i,k),radius,dz,alpha,difrm(ispec),fequil)
1412

1417 qtmp = qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap)) * pstate%pdel(i,k)
1418 itmp = qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(iwset,iwtvap)) * pstate%pdel(i,k)
1419 rtmp = rmass(i,1)
1420 irtmp= rmass(i,iwset)
1421

1423 ! itmp, irtmp, dliqiso)
1424

1426 itmp, irtmp, dliqiso)
1427

142973869407386940 qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(iwset,iwtvap)) = qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(iwset,iwtvap)) - &
1430 (dliqiso / pstate%pdel(i,k))
1431 !rain:
1432 rmass(i,iwset) = rmass(i,iwset) + dliqiso
1433
1434 end if !cloud base
1435
1436 end if
1437 end do
143812294079201272545040 qloc0(i,k,:) = qloc(i,k,:) !update state
143986274240129411360 rmass0(i,:) = rmass(i,:) !update precip
144086274240129411360 smass0(i,:) = smass(i,:)
1441 end if
1442 !-------------------------
1443 !correct any precip errors
1444 !-------------------------
1445 !NOTE: May not be needed. - JN
14464313712086274240 if(wisotope .and. ldo_stprecip) then
1447 !rain:
14482156856021568560 pdiff = rmass(i,2)-rmass(i,1) !2=H216O,1=H2O
14496470568064705680 do iwset=2,wtrc_nwset !don't loop over H2O
14506470568064705680 R = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iawset(iwtstrain,iwset)),rmass0(i,iwset),rmass0(i,2)) !use H216O as denominator
1451 rmass(i,iwset) = rmass(i,iwset) - R*pdiff !adjust rain mass
1452 mdst = wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,iwset) !assume extra mass goes to vapor
1453 !(largest atmospheric reservoir)
1454 qloc(i,k,mdst) = qloc(i,k,mdst)+R*pdiff/pstate%pdel(i,k) !add mass to vapor
1455 end do
1456 !snow:
14572156856021568560 pdiff = smass(i,2)-smass(i,1) !2=H216O,1=H2O
14586470568064705680 do iwset=2,wtrc_nwset !don't loop over H2O
14596470568064705680 R = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iawset(iwtstrain,iwset)),smass0(i,iwset),smass0(i,2)) !use H216O as denominator
1460 smass(i,iwset) = smass(i,iwset) - R*pdiff !adjust rain mass
1461 mdst = wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,iwset) !assume extra mass goes to vapor
1462 ! (largest atmospheric reservoir)
1463 qloc(i,k,mdst) = qloc(i,k,mdst)+R*pdiff/pstate%pdel(i,k) !add mass to vapor
1464 end do
146512294079201272545040 qloc0(i,k,:) = qloc(i,k,:) !update state
146686274240129411360 rmass0(i,:) = rmass(i,:) !update precip
146786274240129411360 smass0(i,:) = smass(i,:)
1468 end if
1469 !------------------
1470 !update temperature
1471 !------------------
1472 !NOTE ON TEMPERATURE CHANGE:
1473 !Arguably, the most physically realistic method of temperature integration would
1474 !be to loop over all processes each time the temperature is changed, as this would better
1475 !reflect the fact that in reality, all of these processes are occuring at once. However,
1476 !doing so appears difficult to accomplish given the current setup, and it also doesn't match the
1477 !actual MG scheme (where the pre-rates are not impacted by the post-rates, which wouldn't
1478 !be true given a full loop). Instead, each section (excluding sedimentation at the moment)
1479 !will be looped independently, updating the final temperature by the amount the latent heating
1480 !is updated in the actual cloud physics routines. This allows the water tracer/
1481 !isotope routines to be algorithmically as close as possible to the actual model physics - JN
1482
1483 !NOTE: Temperature currently calculated as an average value over the entire parameterization time period. - JN
1484! tloc(i,k) = tloc(i,k) + prelat(i,k)/cpair*dtime/wtrc_niter
1485 !NOTE: This temperature call simply updates the temperature to its value after pre-rate effects.
1486 tloc(i,k) = pstate%t(i,k) + prelat(i,k)/cpair*dtime/wtrc_niter
1487 !------------------
1488 end do!atmospheric columns (i)
1489 end do !atmospheric levels (k)
1490 end do !iter
1491 end if !pre-rates
1492
1493 !*************
1494 !Sedimentation
1495 !*************
1496106496319488 if (present(sed_rates)) then
149753248479232 call wtrc_sediment(wtrc_niter,ncol,pstate%lchnk,top_lev,dtime,fc,fi,liqcldf,icecldf,pstate%pdel,pbuf,tloc,qloc)
1498 end if
1499
150024588158403023564128 qloc0(:ncol,top_lev:,:) = qloc(:ncol,top_lev:,:) !reset control quantity
1501
1502 !****************************
1503 !Post-Sedimentation Processes
1504 !****************************
1505106496319488 if (present(post_rates)) then
1506 !Do this top down, like is done in MG microphysics.
150753248106496 do iter=1,wtrc_niter !temperature iterator
150815974401650688 do k = top_lev, pver
15092156856023166000 do i = 1, ncol
1510 !----------------------------------------------------
1511 !calculate average temperature during cloud processes
1512 !----------------------------------------------------
15132156856021568560 tloc(i,k) = (tloc(i,k) + (tloc(i,k)+postlat(i,k)/cpair*dtime))/2._r8
1514 !----------------------------------------------------
1515150979920150979920 do isrctype=1,pwtype !loop through moisture sources
151610568594401207839360 do idsttype=1,pwtype !loop through water types that are modified
151710568594401056859440 rtype = isrctype !the moisture source is what determines the value of R
1518 if(post_rates(i,k,idsttype,isrctype,rtype) .gt. 0._r8) then !make sure destination type is increasing
15191026452012830650 do iwset=1,wtrc_nwset !loop over water tracers/isotopes
1520
15211026452010264520 msrc = wtrc_iawset(isrctype,iwset) !source water index
1522 mbase= wtrc_iawset(isrctype,1) !H2O source water index
1523 mdst = wtrc_iawset(idsttype,iwset) !destination water index
1524
1525 if(isrctype .gt. iwtice) then !Is precipitation the source?
1526 !--------------------
1527 !use column integrals
1528 !--------------------
1529 !NOTE: This section is currently never called. - JN
153000 if(k .gt. 1) then !don't do for top level
153100 if(sum(qloc0(i,1:k,mbase)*pstate%pdel(i,1:k)) .gt. 0._r8) then !prevent NaNs
153200 R = sum(qloc0(i,1:k,msrc)*pstate%pdel(i,1:k))/sum(qloc0(i,1:k,mbase)*pstate%pdel(i,1:k))
1533 !calculate integral ratio
1534 else
153500 R = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(msrc), qloc0(i,k,msrc),qloc0(i,k,mbase)) !just do for single level
1536 end if
1537 else
153800 R = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(msrc), qloc0(i,k,msrc),qloc0(i,k,mbase)) !calculate for single level
1539 end if
1540 !----------------------
1541 else
15421026452020529040 R = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(msrc),qloc0(i,k,msrc),qloc0(i,k,mbase)) !calculate ratio for single level
1543 end if
1544
15451026452028456249 if(wisotope .and. (iwset .ne. 1) .and. (isrctype .eq. iwtvap) .and. &
1546 ((idsttype .eq. iwtice) .or. (idsttype .eq. iwtstsnow))) then
1547 !only do Rayleigh distillation on water isotopes.
1548
15491873518735 ispec = iwspec(mdst) !determine isotope species of ice or snow (and thus vapoor)
15501873537470 alpha = wtrc_get_alpha(qloc0(i,k,wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,WTRC_WSET_STD)), &
1551 tloc(i,k), ispec, isrctype, idsttype, &
1552 .true., pstate%pmid(i,k))
1553
1554 !calculate change in vapor mass:
1555 fr = qloc(i,k,mbase)/qloc0(i,k,mbase)
1556 !Constrain ratio fraction:
1557 fr = min(1._r8,max(0._r8,fr))
1558
15591873537470 qloc(i,k,msrc) = qloc0(i,k,msrc)*(fr**alpha)
1560 qloc(i,k,mdst) = qloc(i,k,mdst) + (qloc0(i,k,msrc)-qloc(i,k,msrc))
1561 else
15621024578510245785 alpha = 1._r8
1563 !Add tendency to destination:
1564 qloc(i,k,mdst) = qloc(i,k,mdst) + alpha*R*post_rates(i,k,idsttype,isrctype,rtype)*dtime/wtrc_niter
1565 !Subtract tendency from source:
1566 if(isrctype .ne. idsttype) then
15671024578510245785 qloc(i,k,msrc) = qloc(i,k,msrc) - alpha*R*post_rates(i,k,idsttype,isrctype,rtype)*dtime/wtrc_niter
1568 end if
1569 end if !ice/snow distillation
1570
1571 end do !iwset
1572! call wtrc_check_tracer_mass(pbuf,pstate,qloc,isrctype,idsttype,micro,iter,dtime,1e-10_r8,.true.) !check mass
1573146269410151401670 qloc0(i,k,:) = qloc(i,k,:) !update state
1574 end if
1575 end do
1576 !---------------------------------
1577 !equilibrate vapor and cloud water
1578 !---------------------------------
1579603919680754899600 do iwset = 1,wtrc_nwset
1580603919680603919680 if(wisotope) then !are you using water isotopes?
1581603919680603919680 if(iwset .ne. 1) then !not H2O tracer?
1582 !set fractionation factor
1583 !NOTE: Assumes RH = 100%
1584452939760905879520 alpha = wtrc_get_alpha(qloc0(i,k,wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,WTRC_WSET_STD)), &
1585 tloc(i,k), iwspec(wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,iwset)), &
1586 iwtvap, iwtliq, .false.,1._r8,.false.)
1587 !qloc:
1588452939760452939760 call wtrc_liqvap_equil(alpha, 1._r8, qloc(i,k,wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,1)), &
1589 qloc(i,k,wtrc_iawset(iwtliq,1)), &
1590 qloc(i,k,wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,iwset)), &
1591 qloc(i,k,wtrc_iawset(iwtliq,iwset)), dliqiso)
1592 end if
1593 end if
1594 end do
159586058554408907815280 qloc0(i,k,:) = qloc(i,k,:) !update state
1596 !--------------------------------
1597 end do !isrctype
1598 !------------------
1599 !update temperature
1600 !------------------
1601 !NOTE: Temperature currently calculated as an average value over the entire parameterization time period. - JN
1602 !tloc(i,k) = tloc(i,k) + postlat(i,k)/cpair*dtime/wtrc_niter
1603 !NOTE: This temperature call simply updates the temperature to its value after pre-rate effects.
1604 tloc(i,k) = pstate%t(i,k) + (prelat(i,k)+postlat(i,k))/cpair*dtime/wtrc_niter
1605 !------------------
1606 !-----------------------------------------
1607 !partially equilibrate vapor and cloud ice (to represent slow equilibration of ice crystals in atmosphere)
1608 !-----------------------------------------
1609! do iwset = 1,wtrc_nwset
1610! if(wisotope) then !are you using water isotopes?
1611! if(iwset .ne. 1) then !not H2O tracer?
1612 !set fractionation factor
1613 !NOTE: Assumes RH = 100%
1614! alpha = wtrc_get_alpha(qloc0(i,k,wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,WTRC_WSET_STD)),&
1615! tloc(i,k), iwspec(wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,iwset)), &
1616! iwtvap, iwtice, .false.,1._r8,.false.)
1617! !qloc:
1618! call wtrc_liqvap_equil(alpha, 0.02_r8, qloc(i,k,wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,1)), qloc(i,k,wtrc_iawset(iwtice,1)),&
1619! qloc(i,k,wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,iwset)), qloc(i,k,wtrc_iawset(iwtice,iwset)), dliqiso)
1620! end if
1621! end if
1622! end do
1623 !--------------------------------
1624 end do!atmospheric columns (i)
1625 end do !atmospheric levels (k)
1626 end do !iter loop
1627 end if !post-rates
1628
1629 ! Use the tendencies to update the state for the next iteration, and also
1630 ! round any small numbers to avoid negative numbers and numerical problems.
1631! do iwset = 1, wtrc_nwset
1632
1633 ! Eliminate negative mixing ratios.
1634 ! NOTE: Use 0 as a threshold rather than wtrc_qmin during the substepping.
1635! call wtrc_adjust_h2o("WTRC_APPLY_RATES(" // trim(ptend_sum%name) // ")", iwset, ncol, top_lev, qloc, qmin=0._r8)
1636! end do
1637
1638745472851968 do idsttype = 1, pwtype
1639301959840370543264 qloc(:ncol, top_lev:, wtrc_bulk_indices(idsttype)) = qloc(:ncol, top_lev:, wtrc_bulk_indices(idsttype)) + &
1640 ptend_sum%q(:ncol, top_lev:, wtrc_bulk_indices(idsttype)) * dtime
1641
1642! call wtrc_adjust_h2o_bulk("WTRC_APPLY_RATES(" // trim(ptend_sum%name) // ")", ncol, top_lev, qloc)
1643 end do
1644
1645 ! Now that we have the final state, apply q limits like those used by the
1646 ! MG microphysics.
1647 !
1648 ! NOTE: There is some inconsistency here, since other parameterizations and
1649 ! physics_update may use different limits. It would be nice if all
1650 ! parameterizations used cnst_qmin.
1651! do iwset = 1, wtrc_nwset
1652! call wtrc_adjust_h2o("WTRC_APPLY_RATES(" // trim(ptend_sum%name) // ")", iwset, ncol, top_lev, qloc)
1653! end do
1654
1655 ! Sedimentation of cloud liquid and cloud ice is stratiform precipitation.
1656 ! out of the bottom layer is precipitation.
1657 !
1658 ! TBD - Can't do this until the sedimentation rates are provided for motion to
1659 ! and from layer rather than change in the layer.
1660 ! NOTE: No longer needed (handled in wtrc_sediment) - JN.
1661 ! if (present(sed_rates)) then
1662 ! if (ldo_stprecip) then
1663 ! call wtrc_collect_precip(pstate, pbuf, iwtliq, iwtstrain, sed_rates, dtime)
1664 ! call wtrc_collect_precip(pstate, pbuf, iwtice, iwtstsnow, sed_rates, dtime)
1665 ! end if
1666 ! end if
1667
1668 ! Diagnose stratiform precipitation, since CAM currently does diagnostic rather
1669 ! than prognostic precipitation. If it was prognostic, then sedimentation of
1670 ! rain and snow would also generate surface precipitation.
1671106496106496 if (ldo_stprecip) then
1672
16735324853248 call wtrc_diagnose_precip(pstate, rmass, pbuf, top_lev, iwtstrain, dtime)
16745324853248 call wtrc_diagnose_precip(pstate, smass, pbuf, top_lev, iwtstsnow, dtime)
1675
16765324853248 call wtrc_diagnose_bulk_precip(pstate, ptend_sum, top_lev, iwtstrain, dtime)
16775324853248 call wtrc_diagnose_bulk_precip(pstate, ptend_sum, top_lev, iwtstsnow, dtime)
1678 end if
1679
1680 !Calculate net tendencies:
1681357826560427368448 diff(:,:,:) = 0._r8 !set initial difference to zero!
168214379041544400 do i=1,ncol
16834313712044575024 do k=top_lev,pver
168412078393601250976480 do icnst = 1, wtrc_ncnst
1685
1686 !Allow for tendency to change state:
1687! ptend_sum%lq(wtrc_indices(icnst)) = .true.
1688
1689 !Calculate state:
169012078393601207839360 ptend_sum%q(i,k,wtrc_indices(icnst)) = (qloc(i,k,wtrc_indices(icnst)) - pstate%q(i,k,wtrc_indices(icnst))) / dtime
1691
1692 if(icnst .le. pwtype) then !H2O only
1693301959840301959840 diff(i,k,icnst) = ptend_sum%q(i,k,wtrc_indices(icnst))-(ptend_sum%q(i,k,wtrc_bulk_indices(icnst)))
1694 end if
1695
1696 end do
1697 end do
1698 end do
1699
1700!---------------------------------
1701!Numerical corrections:
1702!---------------------------------
1703
1704 !check diff value to make sure it isn't too large:
1705301959840371608224 if(sum(abs(ptend_sum%q(:ncol,top_lev:,wtrc_indices(1:pwtype)))) .ne. 0._r8) then
1706301959840743109952 if(sum(abs(diff(:ncol,top_lev:pver,:)))/sum(abs(ptend_sum%q(:ncol,top_lev:,&
1707 wtrc_indices(1:pwtype)))) .gt. 1.e-10_r8) then
170800 write(iulog,*) 'WARNING: BIG ERROR, diff value:',sum(abs(diff(:ncol,top_lev:,:)))/ &
170900 sum(abs(ptend_sum%q(:ncol,top_lev:,wtrc_indices(1:pwtype)))),&
171000 sum(abs(diff(:ncol,top_lev:,:))),sum(abs(diff(:ncol,top_lev:,1:3))), &
171100 sum(qloc(:ncol,top_lev:pver,wtrc_iatype(1,:))-qloc(:ncol,top_lev:pver,wtrc_bulk_indices(:))),&
171200 sum(abs(ptend_sum%q(:ncol,top_lev:,wtrc_indices(1:pwtype))))
1713 end if
1714 end if
1715
1716!Apply correction and divide by time:
171714379041544400 do i=1,ncol
17184313712044575024 do k=top_lev,pver
1719301959840345096960 do icnst = 1,pwtype !only loop over bulk_water!
172012078393601509799200 do m = 1,wtrc_nwset !loop over water species
1721
172212078393601207839360 if(m .eq. 1) then !is it the standard water tracer?
1723301959840301959840 qtmp = ptend_sum%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,icnst))
1724 end if
1725
1726 !calculate water tracer ratio:
172712078393601207839360 R = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,icnst)),ptend_sum%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,icnst)),qtmp)
1728
1729 ptend_sum%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,icnst)) = ptend_sum%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,icnst))-R*diff(i,k,icnst)
1730
1731 end do
1732 end do
1733 end do
1734 end do
1735
1736!Apply correction again (I don't know why this is needed, but for some reason it is, as apparently the fix above produces
1737!another numerical error for cloud liquid - JN)
173814379041544400 do i=1,ncol
17394313712044575024 do k=top_lev,pver
1740301959840345096960 do icnst = 1,pwtype !only loop over bulk_water!
174112078393601509799200 do m = 1,wtrc_nwset !loop over water species
1742
174312078393601207839360 if(m .eq. 1) then !Only do for H2O
1744301959840301959840 diff(i,k,icnst) = ptend_sum%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,icnst))-ptend_sum%q(i,k,wtrc_bulk_indices(icnst))
1745 qtmp = ptend_sum%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,icnst))
1746 end if
1747
1748 !calculate water tracer ratio:
174912078393601207839360 R = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,icnst)), ptend_sum%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,icnst)),qtmp)
1750
1751 ptend_sum%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,icnst)) = ptend_sum%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,icnst))-R*diff(i,k,icnst)
1752
1753 end do
1754 end do
1755 end do
1756 end do
1757
1758 !verify again that the error isn't hiding an actual error:
1759301959840371608224 if(sum(abs(ptend_sum%q(:ncol,top_lev:,wtrc_indices(1:pwtype)))) .ne. 0._r8) then
1760301959840743109952 if(sum(abs(diff(:ncol,top_lev:pver,:)))/sum(abs(ptend_sum%q(:ncol,top_lev:, &
1761 wtrc_indices(1:pwtype)))) .gt. 1.e-20_r8) then
176200 write(iulog,*) 'WARNING: BIG ERROR AGAIN, diff value:',sum(abs(diff(:ncol,top_lev:,:)))/ &
176300 sum(abs(ptend_sum%q(:ncol,top_lev:,wtrc_indices(1:pwtype)))),&
176400 sum(abs(diff(:ncol,top_lev:,:))),sum(abs(diff(:ncol,top_lev:,1:3))), &
176500 sum(qloc(:ncol,top_lev:pver,wtrc_iatype(1,:))-qloc(:ncol,top_lev:pver,wtrc_bulk_indices(:)))
1766 end if
1767 end if
1768
1769!------------------------------
1770!End Numerical corrections
1771!------------------------------
1772
1773 ! Optionally check to see if the total water is conserved by all
1774 ! non-tagged water wsets.
1775 !
1776 ! NOTE: For the h216o model, if the pre-test indicated an error in
1777 ! total mass, but the post-test indicates the same error, then the
1778 ! processes being applied were mass conserving and the problem is
1779 ! with the initial state.
1780 ! isOk = wtrc_check_h2o("WTRC_APPLY_RATES(POST-" // trim(ptend_sum%name) // ")", pstate, qloc, dtime, ptend=ptend_sum)
1781
1782end if !tracer_water
1783
1784 return
1785end subroutine wtrc_apply_rates

1787!====================================================================
1788subroutine wtrc_check_tracer_mass(pbuf,pstate,qloc,stype,dtype,micro,iter,dtime,level,prec)
1789!
1790!Purpose: To determine if any mass was lost or gained during the application of a tendency.
1791!
1792!NOTE: Currently only uses the last water tracer (wtrc_nwset). Will be fixed later... - JN
1793!
1794!Written by: Jesse Nusbaumer <nusbaume@colorado.edu> - April, 2013
1795!
1796!**************
1797!Use statements:
1798!**************
1799
1800use physics_types, only: physics_state
1801use physics_buffer, only: physics_buffer_desc, pbuf_get_index, pbuf_get_field
1802use physconst, only: gravit, rhoh2o
1803use constituents, only: cnst_name
1804
1805!*****************
1806!Delcare variables:
1807!*****************
1808
1809!Input variables:
1810type(physics_buffer_desc), pointer :: pbuf(:) !physics buffer
1811type(physics_state), intent(in) :: pstate ! State of the atmosphere
1812
1813real(r8),intent(in) :: qloc(pcols,pver,pcnst) !state of the atmosphere after tendency change.
1814
1815integer, intent(in) :: stype !source water type
1816integer, intent(in) :: dtype !destination water type
1817integer, intent(in) :: iter !iteration loop number
1818real(r8), intent(in) :: dtime !model time step
1819real(r8), intent(in) :: level !mass change cutoff
1820logical, intent(in) :: micro !micro or macro physics?
1821logical, intent(in) :: prec !call precip values from pbuff?
1822
1823!Local variables:
1824integer :: sedrainidx !physics buffer index for tracer rain
1825integer :: sedsnowidx !physics buffer index for tracer snow
1826integer :: sdrnh2oidx !physics buffer index for H2O rain
1827integer :: sdswh2oidx !physics buffer index for h2o snow
1828
1829real(r8) :: qtot,qorg,qprc,qtoth,qorgh,qprch !Mass checkers
1830real(r8) :: sedrain(pcols) !tracer sed. rain
1831real(r8) :: sedsnow(pcols) !tracer sed. snow
1832real(r8) :: sdrnh2o(pcols) !H2O sed. rain
1833real(r8) :: sdswh2o(pcols) !H2O sed. snow
1834
1835real(r8), pointer, dimension(:) :: sedrainpt !tracer sed. rain pointer
1836real(r8), pointer, dimension(:) :: sedsnowpt !tracer sed. snow pointer
1837real(r8), pointer, dimension(:) :: sdrnh2opt !H2O sed. rain pointer
1838real(r8), pointer, dimension(:) :: sdswh2opt !H2O sed. snow pointer
1839
1840integer :: i !loop control variable
1841
1842!*****************************************
1843!read in precipitation from physics buffer
1844!*****************************************
1845
1846 if(prec) then !grab precipitation in buffer
1847
1848 !tracer water:
1849 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, wtrc_srfpcp_indices(iwtstrain, wtrc_nwset), sedrainpt)
1850 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, wtrc_srfpcp_indices(iwtstsnow, wtrc_nwset), sedsnowpt)
1851 sedrain = sedrainpt * gravit * rhoh2o * dtime !convert to kg/m/s2
1852 sedsnow = sedsnowpt * gravit * rhoh2o * dtime
1853 !H2O water:
1854 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, wtrc_srfpcp_indices(iwtstrain, 1), sdrnh2opt)
1855 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, wtrc_srfpcp_indices(iwtstsnow, 1), sdswh2opt)
1856 sdrnh2o = sdrnh2opt * gravit * rhoh2o * dtime
1857 sdswh2o = sdswh2opt * gravit * rhoh2o * dtime
1858
1859 else !set everything to zero
1860 sedrain(:) = 0._r8
1861 sedsnow(:) = 0._r8
1862 sdrnh2o(:) = 0._r8
1863 sdswh2o(:) = 0._r8
1864 end if
1865
1866!*****************
1867!Loop over columns
1868!*****************
1869
1870do i=1,pstate%ncol
1871
1872!**************************
1873!calculate column integrals
1874!**************************
1875
1876 !Isotope/water tracer:
1877 qtot = 0._r8 !initalize variables
1878 qorg = 0._r8
1879 qprc = 0._r8
1880 qtot = sum(qloc(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,wtrc_nwset))*pstate%pdel(i,:))+&
1881 sum(qloc(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtliq,wtrc_nwset))*pstate%pdel(i,:))+& !sum of HDO
1882 sum(qloc(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtice,wtrc_nwset))*pstate%pdel(i,:))
1883 qorg = sum(pstate%q(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,wtrc_nwset))*pstate%pdel(i,:))+&
1884 sum(pstate%q(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtliq,wtrc_nwset))*pstate%pdel(i,:))+& !sum of
1885 sum(pstate%q(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtice,wtrc_nwset))*pstate%pdel(i,:))
1886 qprc = sedrain(i)+sedsnow(i)+sum(qloc(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtstrain,wtrc_nwset))*pstate%pdel(i,:))+&
1887 sum(qloc(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtstsnow,wtrc_nwset))* pstate%pdel(i,:))
1888 !H2O (standard) tracer:
1889 qtoth = 0._r8 !initalize variables
1890 qorgh = 0._r8
1891 qprch = 0._r8
1892 qtoth = sum(qloc(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,1))*pstate%pdel(i,:))+&
1893 sum(qloc(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtliq,1))*pstate%pdel(i,:))+& !sum of HDO
1894 sum(qloc(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtice,1))*pstate%pdel(i,:))
1895 qorgh = sum(pstate%q(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,1))*pstate%pdel(i,:))+&
1896 sum(pstate%q(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtliq,1))*pstate%pdel(i,:))+& !sum of
1897 sum(pstate%q(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtice,1))*pstate%pdel(i,:))
1898 qprch = sdrnh2o(i)+sdswh2o(i)+sum(qloc(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtstrain,1))*pstate%pdel(i,:))+&
1899 sum(qloc(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtstsnow,1))*pstate%pdel(i,:))
1900
1901!******************
1902!Perform mass check
1903!******************
1904
1905 !mass check:
1906 if(qorg .ne. 0._r8) then
1907 if(abs(qorg-qtot-qprc)/qorg .gt. level) write(iulog,*) 'conservation error here for HDO!', &
1908 stype,dtype,micro,iter,(qorg-qtot-qprc)/qorg,qorg-qtot,&
1909 qorgh-qtoth,qprc,qprch,qorg-qorgh,qprc-qprch,&
1910 sum(qloc(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtstrain,2))*&
1911 pstate%pdel(i,:))-sum(qloc(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtstrain,1))*&
1912 pstate%pdel(i,:)),&
1913 sum(qloc(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtstsnow,2))* pstate%pdel(i,:))-&
1914 sum(qloc(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtstsnow,1))* pstate%pdel(i,:)),&
1915 sum(qloc(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,2))*pstate%pdel(i,:))-&
1916 sum(qloc(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtvap,1))*pstate%pdel(i,:)),&
1917 sum(qloc(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtice,2))*pstate%pdel(i,:))-&
1918 sum(qloc(i,:,wtrc_iawset(iwtice,1))*pstate%pdel(i,:)),&
1919 sedsnow(i)-sdswh2o(i),sedrain(i)-sdrnh2o(i),(qprc-sedsnow(i)-&
1920 sedrain(i))-(qprch-sdswh2o(i)-sdrnh2o(i)),prec,i
1921 end if
1922 if(qorgh .ne. 0._r8) then
1923 if(abs(qorgh-qtoth-qprch)/qorgh .gt. level) write(iulog,*) 'conservation error here for H2O too!', &
1924 iter,(qorgh-qtoth-qprch)/qorgh,prec
1925 end if
1926
1927!***************
1928!End column loop
1929!***************
1930
1931 end do
1932
1933end subroutine wtrc_check_tracer_mass
1934
1935!=============================================================================================
193653248106496subroutine wtrc_sediment(wtrc_niter,ncol,lchnk,top_lev,dtime,wtfc,wtfi,liqcldf,icecldf,pdel,pbuf,tloc,qloc)
1937!--------------------------------------
1938!
1939!Purpose: To calculate the sedimentation rates of water tracers and its
1940!impact on different water tracer quantities (vapor, condensate, precipitation).
1941!
1942!NOTE: This code is needed because the tendency at a particular grid point
1943!due to sedimentation is caused by the flux out of the grid box minus the flux
1944!coming in from the grid box above. Thus both the condensate ratio of the grid
1945!box and the grid box above are needed, along with the sediment fall velocities.
1946!These quantities are difficult to extract from the output tendencies, so
1947!instead the sedimentation rates for water tracers are calculated directly, via
1948!this subroutine. - JN
1949!
1950!Written by: Jesse Nusbaumer <nusbaume@colorado.edu> - January 2013
1951!
1952!--------------------------------------
1953
1954!***************************
1955!use statements/header files
1956!***************************
1957
1958use physconst, only: gravit, cpair, latvap, latice
1959use physics_buffer, only: physics_buffer_desc, pbuf_get_index, pbuf_get_field
1960use constituents, only: cnst_name
1961
1962!*****************
1963!Declare variables:
1964!*****************
1965
1966!Input arguments:
1967integer, intent(in) :: wtrc_niter !water tracer temperature iteration
1968integer, intent(in) :: ncol !number of columns in chunk
1969integer, intent(in) :: lchnk !chunk number
1970integer, intent(in) :: top_lev !top vertical level
1971real(r8), intent(in) :: dtime !model time step
1972real(r8), intent(in) :: wtfc(pcols,pver) !initial fall velocity of cloud liquid
1973real(r8), intent(in) :: wtfi(pcols,pver) !initial fall velocity of cloud ice
1974real(r8), intent(in) :: liqcldf(pcols,pver) !liquid cloud fraction (unitless)
1975real(r8), intent(in) :: icecldf(pcols,pver) !ice cloud fraction (unitless)
1976real(r8), intent(in) :: pdel(pcols,pver) !change in pressure per vertical level
1977
1978!Input/Output arguments:
1979type(physics_buffer_desc), pointer :: pbuf(:) !physics buffer
1980
1981real(r8), pointer, dimension(:) :: srfpcp !surface precipitation (m/s)
1982
1983real(r8), intent(inout) :: tloc(pcols,pver) !air temperature
1984real(r8), intent(inout) :: qloc(pcols,pver,pcnst) !current state of water tracers (kg/kg)
1985
1986!Local variables:
1987integer :: i,m,n,k !loop control variables
1988integer :: nstep !CFL-stable sub-step
1989integer :: srfpcidx !physics buffer index
1990real(r8) :: rgvm !fastest velocity (for CFL calculation)
1991real(r8) :: dum !dummy variable used for liquid cloud fraction ratios (unitless)
1992real(r8) :: dum1 !dummy variable used for ice cloud fraction ratios (unitless)
1993real(r8) :: faltndqce !change in liquid due to sedimentation (no-evap)
1994real(r8) :: faltndqie !change in ice due to sedimentation (no-evap)
1995real(r8) :: faltndc !change in liquid due to sedimentation
1996real(r8) :: faltndi !change in ice due to sedimentation
1997real(r8) :: fc(pver) !cloud liquid fall velocity
1998real(r8) :: fi(pver) !cloud ice fall velocity
1999real(r8) :: lcldm(pcols,pver) !liquid cloud fraction
2000real(r8) :: icldm(pcols,pver) !ice cloud fraction
2001real(r8) :: faloutc(pver,wtrc_nwset) !falling liquid amount
2002real(r8) :: falouti(pver,wtrc_nwset) !falling ice amount
2003real(r8) :: precr(pcols,wtrc_nwset) !rain amount (m/s)
2004real(r8) :: preci(pcols,wtrc_nwset) !snow amount (m/s)
2005
2006!water isotopes:
2007real(r8) :: alpha !fractionation factor
2008real(r8) :: dliqiso !change in liquid due to isotopic equilibration
2009real(r8) :: ttmp(pcols,pver) !temporary air temperature (used for equilibration)
2010real(r8) :: tloc0(pcols,pver) !copy of air temperature
2011
2012real(r8), parameter :: mincld = 0.0001_r8 !minimum cloud fraction (unitless)
2013
2014!************************
2015!Save initial temperature
2016!************************
2017
20182555904030457856tloc0(:,top_lev:) = tloc(:,top_lev:) !copy initial temperature
2019
2020!***********************
2021!calculate cloud amounts
2022!***********************
2023
2024718952772200do i=1,ncol
20252156856022287512 do k=top_lev,pver
2026 lcldm(i,k)=max(liqcldf(i,k),mincld)
2027 icldm(i,k)=max(icecldf(i,k),mincld)
2028 end do
2029end do
2030
2031!******************************
2032!Loop over water tracer species
2033!******************************
2034
20352555904030457856ttmp(:,top_lev:) = tloc0(:,top_lev:) !copy initial air temperature
2036
2037!*******************
2038!Initalize variables
2039!*******************
2040
204134078724153344precr(:,:) = 0._r8
204234078724153344preci(:,:) = 0._r8
2043
2044!******************
2045!Loop over columns:
2046!******************
2047
2048718952772200do i=1,ncol !loop over columns
2049
2050718952718952 nstep = 1 !initalize variables
2051
2052!********************************
2053!set initial fall velocity values
2054!********************************
2055
20562156856023006464 fc(top_lev:) = wtfc(i,top_lev:)
20572156856023006464 fi(top_lev:) = wtfi(i,top_lev:)
2058
2059!******************
2060!calculate sub-step
2061!******************
2062
20632156856022287512 do k=top_lev,pver
2064 rgvm = max(fi(k),fc(k))
2065 nstep = max(int(rgvm*dtime/pdel(i,k)+1._r8),nstep)
2066 end do
2067
2068!******************
2069!Loop over substeps
2070!******************
2071
207219630892682041 do n = 1,nstep !loop over sub-time step to ensure stability
2073
2074!******************************
2075!Calculate sedimentation fluxes
2076!******************************
20775889267060855759 do k = top_lev,pver
2078235570680294463350 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
2079 falouti(k,m) = fi(k)*qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice))
2080 faloutc(k,m) = fc(k)*qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq))
2081 end do
2082 end do
2083
2084!******************************
2085!Calculate changes at model top
2086!******************************
2087
208819630891963089 k = top_lev
208978523567852356 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
2090 faltndi = falouti(k,m)/pdel(i,k)
2091 faltndc = faloutc(k,m)/pdel(i,k)
2092
2093 qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice)) = qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice))-faltndi*dtime/nstep
2094 qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)) = qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq))-faltndc*dtime/nstep
2095 end do
2096
2097!********************************************
2098!Calculate changes for the rest of the column
2099!********************************************
2100
21015692958158892670 do k = top_lev+1,pver
2102
2103! for cloud liquid and ice, if cloud fraction increases with height
2104! then add flux from above to both vapor and cloud water of current level
2105! this means that flux entering clear portion of cell from above evaporates
2106! instantly
2107
21085692958156929581 dum=lcldm(i,k)/lcldm(i,k-1)
2109 dum=min(dum,1._r8)
2110 dum1=icldm(i,k)/icldm(i,k-1)
2111 dum1=min(dum1,1._r8)
2112
2113227718324227718324 do m=1, wtrc_nwset
2114
2115227718324227718324 faltndqie=(falouti(k,m)-falouti(k-1,m))/pdel(i,k)
2116 faltndi=(falouti(k,m)-dum1*falouti(k-1,m))/pdel(i,k)
2117 faltndqce=(faloutc(k,m)-faloutc(k-1,m))/pdel(i,k)
2118 faltndc=(faloutc(k,m)-dum*faloutc(k-1,m))/pdel(i,k)
2119
2120!*********************************
2121!Add fluxes to water tracer states
2122!*********************************
2123
2124 !sedimenting ice sublimation:
2125 qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) = qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))-&
2126 (faltndqie-faltndi)*dtime/nstep
2127 !sedimenting liquid evaporation:
2128 qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) = qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))-&
2129 (faltndqce-faltndc)*dtime/nstep
2130
2131 qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice)) = qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice))-faltndi*dtime/nstep
2132 qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)) = qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq))-faltndc*dtime/nstep
2133
2134!***************************
2135!Ensure isotopic equilibrium
2136!***************************
2137
2138 if(wisotope) then
2139227718324227718324 if(m .ne. 1) then !not H2O tracer?
2140 !set fractionation factor
2141170788743341577486 alpha = wtrc_get_alpha(qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap)), tloc0(i,k), iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)), &
2142 iwtvap, iwtliq, .false.,1._r8,.false.)
2143
2144 !NOTE: Equilibrates over CFL sub-step. This may not be the same as wtrc_niter, and thus it may not converge
2145 !as cleanly as other cloud physics processes. - JN
2146170788743170788743 call wtrc_liqvap_equil(alpha, 1._r8, qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap)), qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtliq)),&
2147 qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)), qloc(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)), dliqiso)
2148
2149 end if
2150 end if
2151
2152!****************************
2153!calculate temperature change
2154!****************************
2155
2156227718324227718324 if(m .eq. 1) then !only do for H2O
21575692958156929581 tloc(i,k)=tloc(i,k)+(faltndqie-faltndi)*(latvap+latice)*dtime/cpair/nstep
2158 tloc(i,k)=tloc(i,k)+(faltndqce-faltndc)*latvap*dtime/cpair/nstep
2159 end if
2160
2161 end do !water tracers
2162
2163 !update fractionation temperature:
2164 tloc0(i,k) = tloc(i,k)
2165
2166!*********************
2167!reset fall velocities
2168!*********************
2169
2170 fi(k)=max(fi(k)/pdel(i,k),fi(k-1)/pdel(i,k-1))*pdel(i,k)
2171 fc(k)=max(fc(k)/pdel(i,k),fc(k-1)/pdel(i,k-1))*pdel(i,k)
2172
2173 end do !pver (column) loop
2174
2175!*********************************************
2176!Add up sedimentation flux out of bottom level
2177!*********************************************
2178
217978523569815445 do m=1, wtrc_nwset
2180
2181 !units below are m/s:
2182 precr(i,m) = precr(i,m)+(faloutc(pver,m)) &
2183 /gravit/nstep/1000._r8
2184 preci(i,m) = preci(i,m)+(falouti(pver,m)) &
2185 /gravit/nstep/1000._r8
2186 end do
2187
2188!*********
2189!End loops
2190!*********
2191
2192 end do !nstep loop
2193end do !ncol loop
2194
2195!************************************************
2196!Add summed bottom sediment flux to precipitation
2197!************************************************
2198
2199212992266240do m=1, wtrc_nwset
2200
2201 !Point to water tracer rain
2202212992212992 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, wtrc_srfpcp_indices(iwtstrain,m), srfpcp)
220334078723833856 srfpcp(:) = srfpcp(:) + precr(:,m) !add rain to precipitation variable
2204
2205 !Point to water tracer snow
2206212992212992 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, wtrc_srfpcp_indices(iwtstsnow,m), srfpcp)
220734078723833856 srfpcp(:) = srfpcp(:) + preci(:,m) !add snow to precipitation variable
2208
2209end do
2210
2211end subroutine wtrc_sediment
2212
2213
2214!============================================================================
2215subroutine stewart_isoevap(ispec, Rr0, rmass0, rmass, irmass0, vmass0, vmass, &
2216 ivmass0, airtemp, airpres, pdel, dz, dtime, irmass, ivmass)
2217
2218!--------------------------------------------------
2219!Purpose:
2220!
2221!To calculate the final isotopic rain ratio
2222!after the re-evaporation of rain droplets as they
2223!fall through sub-cloud air.
2224!
2225!Written by: Jesse Nusbaumer <nusbaume@colorado.edu> - June, 2015
2226!
2227!Equations from Stewart, 1975.
2228!
2229!------------------------------------------------
2230
2231!**************
2232!Use statements
2233!**************
2234
2235!use wv_saturation, only: qsat_water
2236use wv_saturation, only: qsat
2237use physconst, only: gravit
2238
2239!********************
2240!Variable declaration
2241!********************
2242
2243!Input variables:
2244integer, intent(in) :: ispec !isotope species
2245real(r8), intent(in) :: Rr0 !rain ratio pre-evaporation [unitless]
2246real(r8), intent(in) :: rmass0 !bulk water mass pre-evaporation [kg/m/s2]
2247real(r8), intent(in) :: rmass !bulk water mass post-evaporationa [kg/m/s2]
2248real(r8), intent(in) :: irmass0 !isotopic water mass pre-evaporation [kg/kg]
2249real(r8), intent(in) :: vmass0 !bulk vapor mass pre-evaporation [kg/kg]
2250real(r8), intent(in) :: vmass !bulk vapor mass post-evaporation [kg/kg]
2251real(r8), intent(in) :: ivmass0 !isotopic vapor mass pre-evaporation [kg/kig]
2252real(r8), intent(in) :: airtemp !air temperature [Kelvin?]
2253real(r8), intent(in) :: airpres !air pressure [Pa]
2254real(r8), intent(in) :: pdel !layer thickness [Pa]
2255real(r8), intent(in) :: dz !layer thickness [m]
2256real(r8), intent(in) :: dtime !model time step [s]
2257
2258!Input/Output variables:
2259real(r8), intent(inout) :: irmass !isotopic water mass post-evaporation [kg/kg]
2260real(r8), intent(inout) :: ivmass !isotopic vapor mass post-evaporation [kg/kg]
2261
2262!Local variables:
2263real(r8) :: fr !fraction of precipitation mass remaining after evaporation.
2264real(r8) :: gam !gamma paramter in Stewart equation
2265real(r8) :: bet !beta parameter in stewart equation
2266real(r8) :: vsat !saturated vapor mass [kg/kg]
2267real(r8) :: es !saturated vapor pressure
2268real(r8) :: rh !relative humidity
2269real(r8) :: ae !equilibrium fractionation factor
2270real(r8) :: ak !kinetic fractionation factor
2271real(r8) :: Rstw !Stewart rain ratio
2272real(r8) :: Rr !rain ratio post-evaporation
2273real(r8) :: Rv0 !vapor ratio pre-evaporation
2274real(r8) :: tmpv !temporary bulk vapor variable for equilibration
2275real(r8) :: itmpv !temporary isotopic vapor variable for equilibration
2276real(r8) :: itmpr !temporary isotopic rain variable for equilibration
2277real(r8) :: dliqiso !change in liquid mass due to equilibration [kg/m/s2]
2278real(r8) :: phi !local enchancement of relative humidity (tuning parameter)
2279real(r8) :: heff !local "effective" relative humidity
2280real(r8) :: radius !average radius of raindrop [m]
2281real(r8) :: fequil !fraction of rain the experiences stewart/equilibration
2282
2283!For kinetic fractionation:
2284real(r8) :: difrm(pwtspec)
2285real(r8) :: dkfac
2286
2287!*****************
2288!Tuning parameters
2289!*****************
2290
2291!phi value given in Bony et. al., 2008:
2292phi = 0.9_r8
2293
2294!Assumed raindrop radius (in meters):
2295!NOTE: Now calculated based off rain rate -JN
2296!radius = 0.00035_r8
2297
2298!*****************************
2299!Diffusivity ratios and powers (should be called from water_isotopes.F90 eventually):
2300!*****************************
2301
2302difrm = (/ 1._r8, 1._r8, 0.9836504_r8, 0.9686999_r8 /) ! kinetic theory
2303dkfac = 0.58_r8 ! From Stewart, 1975?
2304
2305!***************************
2306!Calculate relative humidity
2307!***************************
2308
2309!calculate saturation vapor pressure over water:
2310!call qsat_water(airtemp, airpres, es, vsat)
2311call qsat(airtemp, airpres, es, vsat)
2312
2313!Calculate RH:
2314rh = vmass0/vsat
2315
2316!calculate effective RH:
2317heff = phi+((1_r8-phi)*rh) !From Bony et. al., 2008
2318
2319!*******************************
2320!Calculate fractionation factors
2321!*******************************
2322
2323!equilibrium fractionation factor:
2324ae = wtrc_get_alpha(vmass0,airtemp,ispec,iwtvap,iwtliq,.false.,1._r8,.false.)
2325
2326!kinetic fractionation factor:
2327ak = (1._r8/difrm(ispec))**dkfac
2328
2329!***********************************************
2330!Calculate mass-weighted average raindrop radius
2331!***********************************************
2332
2333!NOTE: mean diameter in mm = 4/(4.1*R^-0.21), with R in mm/hr, assuming a Marshall-Palmer distribution. -JN
2334
2335radius = 2._r8/(4.1_r8*((rmass0/gravit/dtime)*60._r8*60._r8)** (-0.21_r8))
2336
2337!convert radius to meters:
2338radius = radius/1000._r8
2339
2340
2341!***************************************************
2342!Calculate fraction of precip that will eqiuilibrate
2343!***************************************************
2344
2345call wtrc_equil_time(ispec,airtemp,airpres,radius,dz,ae,difrm(ispec),fequil)
2346
2347!Constrain possible values:
2348fequil = min(1._r8,max(0._r8,fequil))
2349
2350!*******************************************************
2351!Calculate fraction of precipitation lost to evaporation
2352!*******************************************************
2353
2354 !Remaining mass fraction:
2355 fr = rmass/rmass0
2356
2357 !Constrain possible values:
2358 fr = min(1._r8,max(0._r8,fr))
2359
2360!********************************
2361!Apply Stewart equation if RH < 1
2362!********************************
2363
2364if((heff .lt. 1._r8) .and. (fr .lt. 1._r8)) then
2365!if(.false.) then !Only equilibrate -JN
2366
2367!*************************************
2368!Calculate Stewart equation parameters
2369!*************************************
2370
2371 gam = (ae*heff)/(1._r8-ae*ak*(1._r8-heff))
2372 bet = (1._r8-ae*ak*(1._r8-heff))/(ae*ak*(1._r8-heff))
2373
2374!*********************************
2375!Calculate new isotopic rain ratio
2376!*********************************
2377
2378 !pre-evaporation vapor ratio:
2379 Rv0 = wtrc_ratio(ispec,ivmass0,vmass0)
2380
2381 !Apply stewart equation:
2382 Rstw = ((Rr0-gam*Rv0)*(fr**bet)) + gam*Rv0
2383
2384 !Apply equilibration fraction:
2385 if((fr .eq. 0._r8) .and. (bet .lt. 0._r8)) then !Prevent NaNs (plus there shouldn't be any evaporation anyways)
2386 Rr = Rr0 !just conserve ratio
2387 else
2388 Rr = fequil*Rstw + (1._r8-fequil)*Rr0 !perform fractionation
2389 end if
2390
2391!*******************************
2392!Calculate isotopic mass changes
2393!*******************************
2394
2395 dliqiso = irmass0 - Rr*rmass
2396
2397!*************************************************************
2398!Calculate new isotopic mass values for current vertical level
2399!*************************************************************
2400
2401 !NOTE: 1/pdel needed to convert quantity back
2402 ! to units of kg/kg.
2403
2404 !isotopic rain value:
2405 irmass = irmass0 - dliqiso
2406
2407 !isotopic vapor value:
2408 ivmass = ivmass0 + (dliqiso/pdel)
2409
2410!**********************
2411else !RH < 1
2412!**********************
2413!Equilibrate rain/vapor
2414!**********************
2415
2416 !apply evaporation fluxes
2417 dliqiso = irmass0 - Rr0*rmass
2418 irmass = irmass0 - dliqiso
2419 ivmass = ivmass0 + dliqiso/pdel
2420
2421 !save copies of rain and vapor masses
2422 tmpv = vmass*pdel !temporary storage variable for bulk vapor
2423 itmpv = ivmass*pdel !temporary storage variable for isotopic vapor
2424 itmpr = irmass !temporary storage variable for isotopic rain
2425
2426 if((rmass .ge. 0._r8) .and. (vmass .ge. 0._r8) .and. &
2427 (itmpv .ge. 0._r8) .and. (itmpr .ge. 0._r8)) then !Ensure quantities are positive (NOTE: may not be needed - JN).
2428
2429 call wtrc_liqvap_equil(ae, fequil, tmpv, rmass, itmpv, itmpr, dliqiso)
2430
2431 irmass = irmass + dliqiso
2432 ivmass = ivmass - dliqiso/pdel
2433
2434 end if
2435
2436!**********************
2437end if !RH < 1
2438!**********************
2439end subroutine stewart_isoevap
2440
2441

2443106496106496 subroutine wtrc_clear_precip(pstate, pbuf, itype)
2444!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2445!
2446! Purpose: Clear the surface precipitation fields.
2447!
2448! Method:
2449! Clear the accumulated amount of surface precipitation
2450!
2451! Author: Chuck Bardeen
2452!
2453!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2454 use physics_types, only: physics_state, physics_ptend
2455 use water_types, only: pwtype
2456 use physconst, only: gravit, rhoh2o
2457 use physics_buffer, only: physics_buffer_desc, pbuf_get_index, pbuf_get_field
2458 use constituents, only: cnst_name
2459
2460 type(physics_state), intent(in) :: pstate ! State of the atmosphere
2461 type(physics_buffer_desc), pointer :: pbuf(:) !physics buffer
2462
2463 integer, intent(in) :: itype ! precipitation water type index
2464
2465 integer :: iwset ! water set index
2466 integer :: lchnk
2467 integer :: ncol
2468 integer :: icol
2469 integer :: srfpcidx ! Physics Buffer index
2470 real(r8), pointer, dimension(:) :: srfpcp ! Surface precipitation (m/s)
2471
2472!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2473!
2474 if (trace_water) then
2475
2476 ! Use an internal local ptend, so we can do the mass checking.
2477106496106496 ncol = pstate%ncol
2478 lchnk = pstate%lchnk
2479
2480 ! Iterate over the water sets.
2481425984425984 do iwset = 1, wtrc_nwset
2482
2483 ! The surface precipitation is stored in the physics buffer, so
2484 ! get a pointer to the data.
2485425984425984 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, wtrc_srfpcp_indices(itype,iwset), srfpcp)
2486
2487 ! Calculate surface total.
248857516166603584 srfpcp(:ncol) = 0._r8
2489 end do
2490 end if
2491
2492 return
2493106496106496end subroutine wtrc_clear_precip

2497 subroutine wtrc_collect_precip(pstate, pbuf, isrctype, idsttype, sediment_rates, dtime)
2498!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2499!
2500! Purpose: Calculate the surface precipitation fields from the
2501! corresponding 3D precipitation fields.
2502!
2503! Method:
2504! Collects sedimenting cloud condensate from the bottom model level
2505! into the surface precipitation fields. The sediment_rates indicates
2506! the sedimentation rate from the bottom model level of the source
2507! water type.
2508!
2509! Author: Chuck Bardeen
2510!
2511! NOTE: Subroutine is currently not used. - JN
2512!
2513!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2514 use physics_types, only: physics_state, physics_ptend
2515 use water_types, only: pwtype
2516 use physconst, only: gravit, rhoh2o
2517 use physics_buffer, only: physics_buffer_desc, pbuf_get_index, pbuf_get_field
2518 use constituents, only: cnst_name
2519
2520 type(physics_state), intent(in) :: pstate ! State of the atmosphere
2521 type(physics_buffer_desc), pointer :: pbuf(:) !physics buffer
2522 integer, intent(in) :: isrctype ! source water type index
2523 integer, intent(in) :: idsttype ! destination water type index
2524 real(r8), intent(in) :: sediment_rates(pcols,pver,pwtype) ! Sedimentation rates (kg/kg/sec)
2525 real(r8), intent(in) :: dtime ! length of timestep (s)
2526
2527 integer :: iwset ! water set index
2528 integer :: lchnk
2529 integer :: ncol
2530 integer :: icol
2531 integer :: srfpcidx ! Physics Buffer index
2532 real(r8), pointer, dimension(:) :: srfpcp ! Surface precipitation (m/s)
2533
2534!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2535!
2536 if (trace_water) then
2537
2538 ! Use an internal local ptend, so we can do the mass checking.
2539 ncol = pstate%ncol
2540 lchnk = pstate%lchnk
2541
2542 ! Iterate over the water sets.
2543 do iwset = 1, wtrc_nwset
2544
2545 ! The surface precipitation is stored in the physics buffer, so
2546 ! get a pointer to the data.
2547 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, wtrc_srfpcp_indices(idsttype,iwset), srfpcp)
2548
2549 ! The 3D data is in the state structure and/or the tendency. Calculate the mass and
2550 ! convert from kg/m2 to m/s.
2551 do icol = 1, ncol
2552
2553 ! Calculate surface total.
2554 srfpcp(icol) = srfpcp(icol) + sediment_rates(icol, pver, isrctype) * &
2555 pstate%pdel(icol,pver) / gravit / rhoh2o / dtime
2556 end do
2557 end do
2558 end if
2559
2560 return
2561end subroutine wtrc_collect_precip
2562
