2565106496106496 subroutine wtrc_diagnose_precip(pstate, pmass, pbuf, top_lev, iwtype, dtime)
2566!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2567!
2568! Purpose: Calculate the surface precipitation fields from the
2569! corresponding 3D precipitation fields.
2570!
2571! Method:
2572! Currently, precipitation is a diagnostic field in CAM. While some
2573! precipitation may occur from sedimentation of cloud liquid and ice
2574! to surface, most of it comes from 3-D rain and snow fields that are
2575! the result of microphysical processes (e.g. autoconversion) in the
2576! atmosphere. CAM assumes that all snow and rain in the atmosphere
2577! reaches the surface at the end of the time step. Thus 3-D fields for
2578! water tracer rain and snow need to be collected up and placed into
2579! the corresponding surface precipitation fields.
2580!
2581! NOTE: This will just do one water type at a time, so that the timing
2582! for the collection of convective precipitation can be different than
2583! for stratiform precipitation. However precipitation from all
2584! isotopic species will be collected separately.
2585!
2586! Author: Chuck Bardeen
2587!
2588! NOTE: It has been found that the sedimenting ice and cloud liquid that falls
2589! through the bottom layer are added to the bulk stratiform precipitation, and thus
2590! must be added here. It does not appear that the sedimentation tendencies
2591! can be used directly in a simple way, as they involve the net flux of condensate
2592! into the grid box, while the sediment that counts as precipitation is simply
2593! the sediment flux out of the bottom grid box (Flux_out versus Flux_out-Flux_in)
2594! There should be no fractionation involved with sedimentation, so only a ratio needs
2595! to be counted. The routine below uses the pre-sedimentation bottom-level values to
2596! calculate the ratio, but this may not be ideal. If the stratiform precipitation
2597! appears to have incorrect values, then this ratio may be the culprit. - JN
2598!
2599!
2600!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2601 use physics_types, only: physics_state, physics_ptend
2602 use water_types, only: pwtype
2603 use physconst, only: gravit, rhoh2o
2604 use physics_buffer, only: physics_buffer_desc, pbuf_get_index, pbuf_get_field
2605 use constituents, only: cnst_name
2606
2607 use time_manager, only: get_nstep
2608
2609 type(physics_state), intent(in) :: pstate ! State of the atmosphere
2610 real(r8), intent(inout) :: pmass(pcols,wtrc_nwset) ! local constituents
2611 type(physics_buffer_desc), pointer :: pbuf(:) ! physics buffer
2612 integer, intent(in) :: top_lev ! top level index
2613 integer, intent(in) :: iwtype ! water type index
2614 real(r8), intent(in) :: dtime ! length of timestep (s)
2615
2616 integer :: iwset
2617 integer :: lchnk
2618 integer :: ncol
2619 integer :: icol
2620 integer :: srfpcidx ! physics Buffer index
2621 real(r8) :: R ! water tracer precipitation ratio (unitless)
2622 real(r8), pointer, dimension(:) :: srfpcp ! surface precipitation (m/s)
2623 real(r8) :: stdpcp(pcols) ! bulk water precipitation <-used for mass fixer - JN
2624
2625!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2626!
2627 if (trace_water) then
2628
2629 ! Use an internal local ptend, so we can do the mass checking.
2630106496106496 ncol = pstate%ncol
2631 lchnk = pstate%lchnk
2632
2633 !initalize variable:
2634 !stdpcp(:) = 0._r8 !<-used for mass fixer - JN
2635
2636 ! Iterate over the water sets.
2637425984425984 do iwset = 1, wtrc_nwset
2638
2639 ! The surface precipitation is stored in the physics buffer, so
2640 ! get a pointer to the data.
2641425984425984 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, wtrc_srfpcp_indices(iwtype,iwset), srfpcp)
2642
2643 ! The 3D data is in the state structure and/or the tendency. Sum the mass and
2644 ! convert from kg/m2 to m/s.
264557516166177600 do icol = 1, ncol
2646
2647 ! Calculate surface total.
264857516165751616 srfpcp(icol) = srfpcp(icol) + pmass(icol,iwset)/gravit/rhoh2o/dtime
2649
2650 !**********************************
2651 !Stratiform isotopic snow error fix -JN
2652 !**********************************
2653 !NOTE: May not be needed. - JN
2654 !Save bulk (H2O) water for possible error-correcting.
2655 if(iwset .eq. 1) then
265614379041437904 stdpcp(icol) = srfpcp(icol)
2657 end if
2658
2659 !Prevent stratiform snow error (the random snow events that preciptate WAY too much isotopic mass).
2660 !NOTE: Eventually the root cause of this issue should be found and fixed, but for now this will do. - JN
2661575161610065328 if((iwset .ne. 1) .and. (srfpcp(icol) .gt. 2._r8 * stdpcp(icol))) then !isotopic precip too large, possible numerical error.
2662 !Write out warning to log file:
2663649734649734 if(stdpcp(icol) .gt. wtrc_qmin) write(*,*) 'ERROR: isotopic stratiform precipitation mass error!',srfpcp(icol),stdpcp(icol),iwtype,iwset,icol
2664 !Adjust water tracers back to standard:
2665! srfpcp(icol) = stdpcp(icol) !set isotopic mass to be equal to bulk water (aka destroy numerically produced mass).
2666 end if
2667 !***********************************
2668
2669 ! Clear out the field.
2670 pmass(icol,iwset) = 0._r8
2671
2672 end do
2673 end do
2674 end if
2675
2676 return
2677106496106496end subroutine wtrc_diagnose_precip
2678
2679
2680!=======================================================================
2681106496106496 subroutine wtrc_diagnose_bulk_precip(pstate, ptend, top_lev, iwtype, dtime)
2682!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2683!
2684! Purpose:
2685!
2686! Method:
2687! Currently, precipitation is a diagnostic field in CAM. If a consituent
2688! was added in water tracer to mirror the bulk water, then clear this out
2689! now. The actual diagnosis of the bulk precipitation is done in the
2690! CAM microphysics.
2691!
2692! Author: Chuck Bardeen
2693!
2694!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2695 use physics_types, only: physics_state, physics_ptend
2696 use water_types, only: pwtype
2697
2698 type(physics_state), intent(in) :: pstate ! State of the atmosphere
2699 type(physics_ptend), intent(inout) :: ptend ! State tendencies
2700 integer, intent(in) :: top_lev ! top level index
2701 integer, intent(in) :: iwtype ! water type inde
2702 real(r8), intent(in) :: dtime ! length of timestep (s)
2703
2704 integer :: ncol
2705
2706!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2707!
2708106496106496 if (trace_water) then
2709
2710 ! Does wtrc own some of the bulk fields?
2711106496106496 if (wtrc_add_stprecip) then
2712106496106496 ncol = pstate%ncol
2713
2714 ! Clear out the 3-D bulk precipitation field.
2715 ptend%lq(wtrc_bulk_indices(iwtype)) = .false.
27164313712052934752 ptend%q(:ncol,top_lev:,wtrc_bulk_indices(iwtype)) = 0._r8
2717 end if
2718 end if
2719
2720 return
2721106496106496end subroutine wtrc_diagnose_bulk_precip
2722
2723
27245324853248 subroutine wtrc_output_precip(pstate, pbuf)
2725!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2726!
2727! Purpose: Output the surface precipitation fields.
2728!
2729! Method:
2730! Clear the accumulated amount of surface precipitation
2731!
2732! Author: Chuck Bardeen
2733!
2734!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2735 use physics_types, only: physics_state
2736 use physics_buffer, only: physics_buffer_desc, pbuf_get_index, pbuf_get_field
2737 use constituents, only: cnst_name
2738 use cam_history, only: outfld
2739
2740 type(physics_state), intent(in) :: pstate ! State of the atmosphere
2741 type(physics_buffer_desc), pointer :: pbuf(:) !physics buffer
2742
2743 integer :: iwset ! water set index
2744 integer :: lchnk
2745 integer :: ncol
2746 integer :: srfpcidx ! Physics Buffer index
2747 real(r8), pointer, dimension(:) :: srfpcp ! Surface precipitation (m/s)
2748
2749!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2750!
2751 ! Output fields for the isotopes.
2752 if (trace_water) then
27535324853248 ncol = pstate%ncol
2754 lchnk = pstate%lchnk
2755
2756 ! Iterate over the water sets.
2757212992212992 do iwset = 1, wtrc_nwset
2758
2759 ! Output the convective rain and snow.
2760212992212992 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, wtrc_srfpcp_indices(iwtcvrain,iwset), srfpcp)
27612129922555904 call outfld('PRECRC_' // trim(cnst_name(wtrc_iawset(iwtcvrain, iwset))), srfpcp, pcols, lchnk)
2762
2763212992212992 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, wtrc_srfpcp_indices(iwtcvsnow,iwset), srfpcp)
27642129922555904 call outfld('PRECSC_' // trim(cnst_name(wtrc_iawset(iwtcvsnow, iwset))), srfpcp, pcols, lchnk)
2765
2766212992212992 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, wtrc_srfpcp_indices(iwtstrain,iwset), srfpcp)
27672129922555904 call outfld('PRECRL_' // trim(cnst_name(wtrc_iawset(iwtstrain, iwset))), srfpcp, pcols, lchnk)
2768
2769212992212992 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, wtrc_srfpcp_indices(iwtstsnow,iwset), srfpcp)
27702129922342912 call outfld('PRECSL_' // trim(cnst_name(wtrc_iawset(iwtstsnow, iwset))), srfpcp, pcols, lchnk)
2771
2772 end do
2773 end if
2774
2775 return
27765324853248end subroutine wtrc_output_precip
2777

2779!=======================================================================
2780212992212992subroutine wtrc_mass_fixer(state)
2781!--------------------------------
2782!
2783!Purpose: To reset the standard (H2O) water tracer back to the bulk water value, and adjust
2784!all of the proceeding water tracers bay an amount proportional to the H2O reset value.
2785!
2786!Written by: Jesse Nusbaumer <nusbaume@colorado.edu> - April, 2014
2787!
2788!--------------------------------
2789
2790!***************************
2791!use statements/header files
2792!***************************
2793
2794use physics_types, only: physics_state
2795use shr_const_mod, only: shr_const_pi
2796
2797!*****************
2798!Delcare variables
2799!*****************
2800
2801implicit none
2802
2803!Input/Output Variables:
2804type(physics_state), intent(inout) :: state ! Physics state variables
2805
2806!local variables:
2807integer :: i,k,p,m !loop control variables
2808integer :: ncol !number of horizontal variables
2809real(r8) :: oval !original value (used to calculate ratio).
2810real(r8) :: diff !mass difference between standard tracer and bulk water
2811real(r8) :: R !water tracer ratio
2812
2813real(r8) :: wtlat, wtphis
2814real(r8), parameter :: radtodeg = 180.0_r8/shr_const_pi
2815real(r8) :: diff_limit
2816
2817!**************
2818!set ncol value
2819!**************
2820
2821212992212992ncol = state%ncol
2822
2823!***************************
2824!Correct water tracer values
2825!***************************
282628758082875808do i = 1,ncol
28278627424089150048 do k = 1,pver
2828603919680690193920 do p = 1,pwtype
2829603919680603919680 if(state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(1,p)) .ne. state%q(i,k,wtrc_bulk_indices(p))) then
2830 !calculate difference:
28311983209919832099 diff = state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(1,p))-state%q(i,k,wtrc_bulk_indices(p))
2832 !save original value:
2833 oval = state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(1,p))
28347932839679328396 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
2835 !calculate ratio:
28367932839679328396 R = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,p)),state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,p)),&
2837 oval)
2838 !Adjust value:
2839 state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,p)) = state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,p)) - R*diff
2840 end do
2841 end if
2842 end do
2843 end do
2844end do
2845
2846!****************************
2847!Correct water isotope values
2848!NOTE: Some parts of the isotopic physics appear to be causing non-physical numerical errors.
2849!In order to fix these errors, H216O is corrected to match the bulk water, and all other water
2850!isotopes are adjusted accordingly. -JN
2851!****************************
2852212992212992if(wisotope) then
285328758083088800 do i = 1,ncol
28548627424089150048 do k = 1,pver
2855603919680690193920 do p = 1,pwtype
2856603919680603919680 if(state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(2,p)) .ne. state%q(i,k,wtrc_bulk_indices(p))) then
2857 !calculate difference:
28581594477715944777 diff = state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(2,p))-state%q(i,k,wtrc_bulk_indices(p))
2859 !save original value:
2860 oval = state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(2,p))
28614783433147834331 do m=2,wtrc_nwset
2862 !calculate ratio:
28634783433147834331 R = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,p)),state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,p)),&
2864 oval)
2865 !adjust value:
2866 state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,p)) = state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,p)) - R*diff
2867 end do
2868 end if
2869 end do
2870 end do
2871 end do
2872end if
2873
2874!******************************
2875!Additional limiter to take care out-of-bound values
2876!******************************
287728758083088800do i = 1,ncol
2878 !Need to define lat/lon for water tracers:
287928758082875808 wtlat = state%lat(i)*radtodeg
2880 wtphis = state%phis(i)
2881
28828627424086274240 do k= 1,pver
2883603919680690193920 do p=1,pwtype
288418117590402415678720 do m=2,wtrc_nwset
2885 !Set limit value:
288618117590401811759040 if(m == isphdo) then !HDO has higher limit
2887603919680603919680 diff_limit = wtrc_limiter_HDO_hgh
2888 else
288912078393601207839360 diff_limit = wtrc_limiter_18O_hgh
2890 end if
289118117590401811759040 if(state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,p)) .gt. diff_limit*state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(1,p))) then !Increase limiter -JN
289270440547044054 state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,p)) = state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(1,p))
2893 else !This else is only for iHESP -JN
289418047149863388771032 if(abs(wtlat) < 60._r8 .and. wtphis > wtrc_limiter_phis_crit) then !Only adjust values above topography and outside high latitudes
2895 !Set limit value:
289600 if(m == isphdo) then !HDO has higher limit
289700 diff_limit = wtrc_limiter_HDO_low + 0.005_r8*(k - pver) !reduce cut-off with height
2898 else
289900 diff_limit = wtrc_limiter_18O_low + 0.005_r8*(k - pver) !reduce cut-off with height
2900 end if
290100 if(state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,p)) < diff_limit*state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(1,p))) then
290200 state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,p)) = state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(1,p))
2903 end if
2904 end if
2905 end if
2906 end do
2907 end do
2908 end do
2909end do
2910
2911212992212992end subroutine wtrc_mass_fixer
2912
2913
2914!=======================================================================
2915477184477184 function wtrc_check_h2o(testname, pstate, qloc, dtime, ptend)
2916!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2917!
2918! Purpose: Check water tracers for conservation of mass.
2919!
2920! Method:
2921! The tests are :
2922!
2923! - (wtrc_check_total_h2o) - Checks whether the total mass of the first
2924! water set in the model (which should be a total water set) is the
2925! same as regular water.
2926!
2927! Errors are reported if a negative total mass is
2928! detected or if the relative change in mass is greater than
2929! wtrc_qchkmin.
2930
2931! Author: Chuck Bardeen
2932!
2933!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2934 use physics_types, only: physics_state, physics_ptend
2935 use water_types, only: pwtype, wtype_names
2936 use constituents, only: cnst_name, pcnst
2937
2938
2939 character(len=*),intent(in) :: testname ! name of the test
2940 type(physics_state), intent(in) :: pstate ! initial state
2941 real(r8), intent(in) :: qloc(pcols,pver,pcnst) ! current state
2942 real(r8), intent(in) :: dtime ! length of time step (s)
2943 type(physics_ptend), intent(inout), optional :: ptend ! initial tendency
2944
2945 logical :: wtrc_check_h2o
2946
2947 integer :: iwset
2948 integer :: icol
2949 integer :: ncol
2950 integer :: itype
2951 integer :: icnst
2952 integer :: nwset
2953 real(r8) :: bmass(pwtype)
2954 real(r8) :: tmass(pwtype)
2955 real(r8) :: sbmass
2956 real(r8) :: stmass
2957 real(r8) :: scale
2958
2959!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2960!
2961477184477184 wtrc_check_h2o = .true.
2962
2963 if (trace_water) then
2964
2965477184477184 ncol = pstate%ncol
2966
2967 ! Check to see if the total bulk mass is the same as the total wset mass.
2968 if (wtrc_check_total_h2o) then
2969
2970 ! When isotopes are used, only the first water set should have a
2971 ! mass comparable to bulk water.
2972477184477184 if (wisotope) then
2973477184477184 nwset = 1
2974 else
297500 nwset = wtrc_nwset
2976 end if
2977
297864429166920100 do icol = 1, ncol
29794510041257986244 bmass(:) = 0._r8
2980
29814510041251543328 do itype = 1, pwtype
298213530123601488313596 bmass(itype) = bmass(itype) + sum(pstate%q(icol, :, wtrc_bulk_indices(itype)) * pstate%pdel(icol, :))
29834510041290200824 if (present(ptend)) then
298400 bmass(itype) = bmass(itype) + sum(ptend%q(icol, :, wtrc_bulk_indices(itype)) * pstate%pdel(icol, :)) * dtime
2985 end if
2986 end do
29874510041264429160 sbmass = sum(bmass)
2988
298964429166442916 do iwset = 1, nwset
29904510041257986244 tmass(:) = 0._r8
2991
2992 ! Non-wisotope checks, used the fixed rstd to scale the total mass for
2993 ! the check.
2994644291612885832 scale = 1._r8 / wtrc_get_rstd(iwspec(wtrc_iawset(1, iwset)))
2995
29964510041245100412 do itype = 1, pwtype
299713530123601443213184 tmass(itype) = tmass(itype) + sum(qloc(icol, :, wtrc_iawset(itype, iwset)) * pstate%pdel(icol, :))
2998 end do
29994510041264429160 stmass = sum(tmass)
3000
300164429166442916 if ((stmass < 0._r8) .or. ((sbmass) < 0._r8)) then
300200 wtrc_check_h2o = .false.
3003
300400 write(iulog, *) trim(testname) // ": Warning - Negative total mass", iwset, icol, stmass, sbmass
300564429166442916 else if (sbmass > 0._r8) then
300664429166442916 wtrc_check_h2o = .false.
3007
3008 if (abs(((stmass * scale) - sbmass) / sbmass) > wtrc_qchkmin) then
3009
301000 if (wtrc_warn_only) then
301100 write(iulog, *) trim(testname) // ": Warning - Total mass conservation limit exceeded ", &
3012 iwset, icol, scale, stmass*scale, sbmass,(stmass*scale - sbmass) / sbmass
3013 else
301400 write(iulog, *) trim(testname) // ": Error - Total mass conservation limit exceeded ", &
3015 iwset, icol, scale, stmass*scale, sbmass, (stmass*scale - sbmass) / sbmass
3016 end if
3017
301800 if (wtrc_check_show_types) then
301900 do itype = 1, pwtype
302000 write(iulog, *) " " // wtype_names(itype) // " : ", tmass(itype)*scale, bmass(itype)
3021 end do
3022 end if
3023
302400 if (.not. wtrc_warn_only) then
302500 call endrun()
3026 end if
3027 end if
3028 end if
3029 end do
3030 end do
3031 end if
3032 end if
3033
3034 return
3035477184477184end function wtrc_check_h2o
3036
3037
3038!=======================================================================
3039 subroutine wtrc_adjust_h2o(testname, iwset, ncol, top_lev, qloc, qmin)
3040!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3041!
3042! Purpose: Adjust water values to avoid negative and/or small numbers
3043!
3044! Method:
3045! The numerical techniques used here can create small rounding errors that
3046! could generate QNEG3 errors. To compensate for this, mass with a wset
3047! is adjust to make sure that all of the tracers are positive definite.
3048!
3049! If there is not enough mass at the grid location for the wset to
3050! become positive definite, then the run is stopped.
3051!
3052! Author: Chuck Bardeen
3053!
3054!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3055 use water_types, only: pwtype, iwtice
3056 use constituents, only: cnst_name, pcnst
3057
3058
3059 character(len=*),intent(in) :: testname ! name of adjuster
3060 integer, intent(in) :: iwset ! wset index
3061 integer, intent(in) :: ncol ! number of columns
3062 integer, intent(in) :: top_lev ! top level index
3063 real(r8), intent(inout) :: qloc(pcols,pver,pcnst) ! current state
3064 real(r8), optional, intent(in) :: qmin ! a minimum value to use instead of wtrc_qmin
3065
3066 integer :: icol
3067 integer :: itype
3068 integer :: icnst
3069 integer :: i
3070 integer :: k
3071 integer :: m
3072 real(r8) :: qmin_int
3073
3074!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3075
3076 if (trace_water) then
3077
3078 do itype = 1, pwtype
3079 m = wtrc_iawset(itype, iwset)
3080
3081 if (present(qmin)) then
3082 qmin_int = qmin
3083
3084 ! The water types that represent particles have a different threshold
3085 ! than the gases.
3086 else if (itype /= iwtvap) then
3087 qmin_int = wtrc_qmin
3088 else
3089 qmin_int = 0._r8
3090 end if
3091
3092 do k = top_lev, pver
3093 do i = 1, ncol
3094 if ((qloc(i, k, m) < qmin_int)) then
3095 qloc(i, k, m) = 0._r8
3096 end if
3097 end do
3098 end do
3099 end do
3100 end if
3101
3102 return
3103end subroutine wtrc_adjust_h2o
3104
3105
3106!=======================================================================
3107 subroutine wtrc_adjust_h2o_bulk(testname, ncol, top_lev, qloc)
3108!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3109!
3110! Purpose: Adjust water values to avoid negative and/or small numbers
3111!
3112! Method:
3113! The numerical techniques used here can create small rounding errors that
3114! could generate QNEG3 errors. To compensate for this, mass with a wset
3115! is adjust to make sure that all of the tracers are positive definite.
3116!
3117! If there is not enough mass at the grid location for the wset to
3118! become positive definite, then the run is stopped.
3119!
3120! Author: Chuck Bardeen
3121!
3122!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3123 use water_types, only: pwtype
3124 use constituents, only: cnst_name, pcnst
3125
3126
3127 character(len=*),intent(in) :: testname ! name of adjuster
3128 integer, intent(in) :: ncol ! number of columns
3129 integer, intent(in) :: top_lev ! top level index
3130 real(r8), intent(inout) :: qloc(pcols,pver,pcnst) ! current state
3131
3132 integer :: icol
3133 integer :: itype
3134 integer :: i
3135 integer :: k
3136 integer :: m
3137
3138!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3139
3140 if (trace_water) then
3141
3142 do itype = 1, pwtype
3143 m = wtrc_bulk_indices(itype)
3144
3145 do k = top_lev, pver
3146 do i = 1, ncol
3147
3148 if ((qloc(i, k, m) < 0._r8)) then
3149 qloc(i, k, m) = 0._r8
3150 end if
3151 end do
3152 end do
3153 end do
3154 end if
3155
3156 return
3157end subroutine wtrc_adjust_h2o_bulk
3158
3159!=======================================================================
3160subroutine wtrc_dicm( niso , &
3161 isp , feq0 , told , tnew , &
3162 vapold , liqold , iceold , vapent , &
3163 vapnew , liqnew , icenew , vapdet , &
3164 rainpr , snowpr , dliqmt , dicefz )
3165!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3166!
3167! Differential (David's) Isotope Cloud Model (Mirophysics).
3168!
3169! This follows the type of model proposed by Merlivat and jouzel, with
3170! extension of mixed phase by Gendzelman and Arnold, and Ciais and
3171! Jouzel. Used in a plume model, the results should look very much like
3172! the Federer et al model.
3173!
3174! Assume changes to total happen linearly.
3175! This routine is quite generic given some thought about the inputs.
3176!
3177! dvap(m) + dliq(m) + dice(m) + prain(m) + psnow(m) = pvent - pvdet
3178!
3179! dvap(m) = -pliq_vap(m) - pice_vap(m) - pvdet(m) + pvent(m)
3180! dliq(m) = pliq_vap(m) - pice_liq(m) + pliq_ice(m) - prain(m)
3181! dice(m) = pice_vap(m) + pice_liq(m) - pliq_ice(m) - psnow(m)
3182!
3183! For isotopes, there is also and exchange between rain and vapour)
3184!
3185! All exchanges are without fractionation EXCEPT:
3186! o deposition of vapour onto ice as disillation (with kinetic
3187! fractionation)
3188! o vapour and liquid are held in equilibrim (equilibrium
3189! fractionation, unless evaporation then kinetic effects)
3190! o vapour and rain tend toward equilibrium at some slow rate
3191!
3192! Assumes no rain or snow initially. If this is not the case,
3193! you might judiciously dump all initial rain into cloud water,
3194! and specify an effective precipitation rate (?).
3195! If this is REALLY a problem, email me, it can be fixed.
3196! [note to self: snow sublimates no frac, rain as distillation is
3197! easiest] Similarly, detrainment and entrainment is easily include...
3198! bot it all costs flops!
3199!
3200! In CAM, this module is suitable for shallow and deep convection,
3201! and stratiform cloud condensation processes (although the latter
3202! needs some preprocessing to treat snow melt to rain, and
3203! evaporation of rain and snow).
3204!
3205! After 10 iterations the vapour and liquid delta values are good to the
3206! 5th significant figure of delta values (8 sig figs for mass). After
3207! 100 iterations the snow (which is the least accurate) is good to
3208! almost 3 sig figs delta. I recommend at least 10, and more if you can
3209! afford it. 20 or 30 seems to be a good choice.
3210! However, there is a better analytic shortcut that may have better
3211! convergence properties.
3212
3213! REMBER: FEQ WILL BE APPLIED DIFFERENTIALLY, so ends up something strange
3214! (in fact it has an exponential form which can be composed to give the
3215! correct result...)
3216!
3217! Note, magnitude of accumulated numerical imprecision increases with number of
3218! iterations. Mass imbalance of 1.e-13 after 1000000 iterations - not
3219! bad.
3220!
3221! David Noone <dcn@colorado.edu> - Wed Jul 21 18:07:18 MDT 2004
3222!
3223!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3224! use water_types, only: wtype_get_alpha
3225!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3226 implicit none
3227!------------------------- Input Arguments -----------------------------
3228 integer , intent(in) :: niso ! number of isotope species
3229 integer , intent(in) :: isp(niso) ! species index
3230
3231 real(r8), intent(in) :: feq0 ! fraction fractionated
3232 real(r8), intent(in) :: told ! initial temperature
3233 real(r8), intent(in) :: tnew ! final temperature
3234
3235 real(r8), intent(inout) :: vapold(niso) ! initial vapour mass
3236 real(r8), intent(inout) :: liqold(niso) ! initial cloud liquid mass
3237 real(r8), intent(inout) :: iceold(niso) ! initial cloud ice mass
3238 real(r8), intent(inout) :: vapent(niso) ! vapour entrainment
3239
3240 real(r8), intent(inout) :: vapnew(niso) ! final vapour mass
3241 real(r8), intent(inout) :: liqnew(niso) ! final cloud liquid mass
3242 real(r8), intent(inout) :: icenew(niso) ! final cloud ice mass
3243 real(r8), intent(inout) :: vapdet(niso) ! vapour detrainment
3244 real(r8), intent(inout) :: rainpr(niso) ! rain production
3245 real(r8), intent(inout) :: snowpr(niso) ! snow production
3246!
3247 real(r8), intent(in) :: dliqmt ! change in cloud liquid due to ice melt
3248 real(r8), intent(in) :: dicefz ! change in cloud ice due to liquid freeze
3249
3250!------------------------- Local Variables -----------------------------
3251
3252 integer m ! isotope number count
3253 integer itr ! iteration count
3254 integer nitr ! iterations for finite integration
3255
3256 logical ldistdif ! differential/integral distillation
3257
3258 real(r8) pliq_vap(niso) ! prod. cloud liquid from vapour condensation
3259 real(r8) pice_vap(niso) ! prod. cloud ice from vapour condensation
3260 real(r8) pice_liq(niso) ! prod. cloud ice from cloud liquid freeze
3261 real(r8) pliq_ice(niso) ! prod. cloud liquid from cloud ice melt
3262 real(r8) prnw_vap(niso) ! prod. rain water from vapour condensation exchange
3263
3264 real(r8) pvent(niso) ! prod. vapour mass by entrainment
3265 real(r8) pvdet(niso) ! prod. detrained vapour mass
3266 real(r8) psnow(niso) ! prod. snow from conversion of cloud ice
3267 real(r8) prain(niso) ! prod. rain from conversion of cloud liq
3268
3269 real(r8) dvap(niso) ! change in vapour
3270 real(r8) dliq(niso) ! change in cloud liquid
3271 real(r8) dice(niso) ! change in cloud ice
3272
3273 real(r8) qvap(niso) ! vapour integrand
3274 real(r8) qliq(niso) ! cloud liquid integrand
3275 real(r8) qice(niso) ! cloud ice integrand
3276 real(r8) vdet(niso) ! vapour detrainment accumulator
3277 real(r8) rain(niso) ! rain accumulator
3278 real(r8) snow(niso) ! snow accumulator
3279
3280 real(r8) alpice(niso) ! fractionation factor for ice (kinetic)
3281 real(r8) alpliq(niso) ! fractionation factor for liquid
3282
3283 real(r8) totalold, totalnew ! totals for conservation checks
3284 real(r8) vtotnew, visonew ! updates from distillation to ice
3285 real(r8) dvapiso ! change in vapour from distillation
3286 real(r8) tk ! temperature (kelvin)
3287 real(r8) fint ! fraction through integration
3288
3289!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3290 real(r8) :: feq_rn = 0.0_r8 ! fraction rain vapour equulibration
3291! real(r8) :: feq_rn = 0.1 ! fraction rain vapour equulibration [VERY SENSITIVE]
3292! real(r8) :: fieq = 0. ! fraction of initial equilibration (slow convergence)
3293! real(r8) :: fieq = 1. ! fraction of initial equilibration (better)
3294 real(r8) :: fieq = 0.5_r8 ! fraction of initial equilibration (like extra iteration)
3295!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3296 real(r8) :: qtolerr = 1.e-12 ! small q for error checks
3297 real(r8) :: qtiny = 1.e-22 ! essentially zero q
3298!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3299 alpliq(1) = 1._r8
3300 alpice(1) = 1._r8
3301!
3302! Check input budget
3303!
3304 totalold = vapold(1) + liqold(1) + iceold(1) + vapent(1)
3305 totalnew = vapnew(1) + liqnew(1) + icenew(1) + vapdet(1) + rainpr(1) + snowpr(1)
3306 if (abs(totalold - totalnew) > qtolerr) then
3307 write(iulog,*) '(wtrc_dicm) WARNING: total budget does not balance: old /= new'
3308 write(iulog,2) 'old',vapold(1), liqold(1), iceold(1), vapent(1)
3309 write(iulog,2) 'new',vapnew(1), liqnew(1), icenew(1), vapdet(1), rainpr(1), snowpr(1)
3310 write(iulog,2) 'total',totalold, totalnew, totalold - totalnew
3311!! call endrun('(wiso_dicm) ABORTED.')
3312 end if
3313!
3314! Check things we assume (all quantities positive definite, and temperature reasonable)
3315!
3316 do m = 1, niso
3317 if (vapold(m) < 0._r8 .or. liqold(m) < 0._r8 .or. iceold(m) < 0._r8) then
3318 write(iulog,*) '(wtrc_dicm) old values < 0.: m=',m
3319 write(iulog,2) 'old:',vapold(m),liqold(m),iceold(m)
3320 write(iulog,2) 'new:',vapnew(m),liqnew(m),icenew(m)
3321 vapold(1) = max(vapold(1),0._r8)
3322 liqold(1) = max(liqold(1),0._r8)
3323 iceold(1) = max(iceold(1),0._r8)
3324 call endrun('(wtrc_dicm) Abort')
3325 end if
3326 if (vapent(m) < 0._r8) then
3327 write(iulog,*) '(wtrc_dicm) entrainment < 0. : m=',m
3328 write(iulog,*) 'vapent:',vapent(m)
3329 vapent(m) = max(vapent(m),0._r8)
3330 end if
3331 end do
3332 if (vapnew(1) < 0._r8 .or. liqnew(1) < 0. .or. icenew(1) < 0.) then
3333 write(iulog,*) '(wtrc_dicm) new values < 0.'
3334 write(iulog,2) 'old:',vapold(1),liqold(1),iceold(1)
3335 write(iulog,2) 'new:',vapnew(1),liqnew(1),icenew(1)
3336 vapnew(1) = max(vapnew(1),0._r8)
3337 liqnew(1) = max(liqnew(1),0._r8)
3338 icenew(1) = max(icenew(1),0._r8)
3339 call endrun('(wtrc_dicm) Abort')
3340 end if
3341 if (vapdet(1) < 0._r8) then
3342 write(iulog,*) '(wtrc_dicm) detrainment < 0. : m=',m
3343 write(iulog,*) 'vapdet:',vapdet(1)
3344 vapdet(1) = max(vapdet(1),0._r8)
3345 end if
3346 if (rainpr(1) < 0._r8 .or. snowpr(1) < 0._r8) then
3347 write(*,*) '(wtrc_dicm) precipitation production < 0.'
3348 write(*,*) 'rain, snow:',rainpr(1),snowpr(1)
3349 call endrun('(wtrc_dicm) Abort...')
3350 rainpr(1) = max(rainpr(1), 0._r8)
3351 snowpr(1) = max(snowpr(1), 0._r8)
3352 end if
3353
3354 if (told > 330_r8 .or. tnew > 330._r8 .or. &
3355 told < 130_r8 .or. tnew < 130._r8 ) then
3356 write(*,*) '(wtrc_dicm) input temperature unreasonable:',told,tnew
3357!! call endrun('(wiso_dicm) Abort')
3358 end if
3359 2 format(a6,10e16.6)
3360!
3361! Given input net changes to total waters, compose small finte differences.
3362! These are held constant over all iterations.
3363!
3364 dvap(1) = (vapnew(1) - vapold(1))
3365 dliq(1) = (liqnew(1) - liqold(1))
3366 dice(1) = (icenew(1) - iceold(1))
3367!
3368! Work out what's going to happen, and decide if we need to iterate.
3369! If iterating use differential form for distillation, as it is slightly faster.
3370!
3371 nitr = wtrc_citer ! default full iterations
3372 ldistdif = .true. ! default full differential
3373!
3374 if (abs(dvap(1)) < qtiny .and. &
3375 abs(dliq(1)) < qtiny .and. &
3376 abs(dice(1)) < qtiny .and. &
3377 abs(rainpr(1)) < qtiny .and. &
3378 abs(snowpr(1)) < qtiny .and. &
3379 abs(dliqmt) < qtiny .and. &
3380 abs(dicefz) < qtiny) then ! nothing to do, just one pass
3381 nitr = 1
3382 ldistdif = .false.
3383
3384 else if (iceold(1) < qtiny .and. icenew(1) < qtiny .and. &
3385 snowpr(1) < qtiny .and. rainpr(1) < qtiny .and. &
3386 abs(dliqmt)<qtiny .and. abs(dicefz)<qtiny ) then ! equilibrate vap/liq
3387 nitr = 1
3388
3389 else if (liqold(1) < qtiny .and. liqnew(1) < qtiny .and. &
3390 snowpr(1) < qtiny .and. rainpr(1) < qtiny .and. &
3391 abs(dliqmt)<qtiny .and. abs(dicefz)<qtiny ) then ! distil to ice
3392 nitr = 1
3393 ldistdif = .false.
3394 end if
3395!
3396! Convert changes to iterative increments
3397!
3398 pvent(:niso) = vapent(:niso) / real(nitr)
3399!
3400 dvap(1) = dvap(1) / real(nitr) !<-This variable isn't used? - JN
3401 dliq(1) = dliq(1) / real(nitr)
3402 dice(1) = dice(1) / real(nitr)
3403
3404 pvdet(1) = vapdet(1) / real(nitr)
3405 prain(1) = rainpr(1) / real(nitr)
3406 psnow(1) = snowpr(1) / real(nitr)
3407
3408 pliq_ice(1) = dliqmt / real(nitr)
3409 pice_liq(1) = dicefz / real(nitr)
3410!
3411! Given the amount of cloud liquid/ice melt freeze,
3412! we can back out the other terms
3413!
3414
3415pliq_vap(1) = dliq(1) + prain(1) + pice_liq(1) - pliq_ice(1)
3416pice_vap(1) = dice(1) + psnow(1) - pice_liq(1) + pliq_ice(1)
3417prnw_vap(1) = 0._r8
3418
3419!
3420! Copy inputs to local variables to iterate on
3421!
3422 qvap(:niso) = vapold(:niso)
3423 qliq(:niso) = liqold(:niso)
3424 qice(:niso) = iceold(:niso)
3425 vdet(:niso) = 0._r8
3426 rain(:niso) = 0._r8
3427 snow(:niso) = 0._r8
3428
3429!
3430! Integrate over small changes, for all isotopes
3431! Here order is important... if number of iterations are small.
3432! The iteration is done in two substeps to improve accuracy
3433! (although I'm not convinced it's much better than doubling the number
3434! of iterations!)
3435!
3436 do itr = 1, nitr
3437!
3438! Compute temperature, and assign fractionation factors
3439!
3440 fint = (real(itr)-0.5_r8) / real(nitr)
3441 tk = fint*tnew + (1._r8-fint)*told
3442!
3443 !Assume 100% RH:
3444 do m = 2, niso
3445 alpliq(m) = wtrc_get_alpha(qvap(m),tk,isp(m),iwtvap,iwtliq,.false.,1._r8,.false.)
3446 alpice(m) = wtrc_get_alpha(qvap(m),tk,isp(m),iwtvap,iwtice,.false.,1._r8,.true.)
3447 end do
3448!
3449! Start by entraining vapour from the environment
3450!
3451 do m = 1, niso
3452 qvap(m) = qvap(m) + pvent(m)
3453 end do
3454!
3455! Equilibrating liquid and vapour, for a fraction of iteration vapour/liquid production
3456!
3457
3458 if (fieq > 0._r8) then
3459 qliq(1) = qliq(1) + fieq*pliq_vap(1)
3460 qvap(1) = qvap(1) - fieq*pliq_vap(1)
3461 do m = 2, niso
3462 call wtrc_liqvap_equil(alpliq(m),feq0,qvap(1),qliq(1), &
3463 qvap(m),qliq(m),pliq_vap(m))
3464 end do
3465 end if
3466
3467!
3468! Compute the ice melt and liquid freeze, and move it
3469!
3470 do m = 2, niso
3471 pice_liq(m) = pice_liq(1)*wtrc_ratio(isph2o,qliq(m),qliq(1))
3472 pice_liq(m) = min(pice_liq(m), qliq(m))
3473
3474 pliq_ice(m) = pliq_ice(1)*wtrc_ratio(isph2o,qice(m),qice(1))
3475 pliq_ice(m) = min(pliq_ice(m), qice(m))
3476 end do
3477!
3478 do m = 1, niso
3479 qice(m) = qice(m) + pice_liq(m) - pliq_ice(m)
3480 qliq(m) = qliq(m) - pice_liq(m) + pliq_ice(m)
3481 end do
3482!
3483! Compute the ice/vapour deposition/sublimation
3484! Both integral and differential schemes have about the same convergence
3485! characteristics.
3486 if (ldistdif) then ! use differential form for distillation
3487 do m = 2, niso
3488 if (pice_vap(1) > 0._r8) then ! ice deposition by distillation, kinetic
3489 pice_vap(m) = alpice(m)*pice_vap(1)*wtrc_ratio(isph2o,qvap(m), qvap(1))
3490 pice_vap(m) = min(pice_vap(m), qvap(m))
3491 else ! sublimation, no fractionation
3492 pice_vap(m) = pice_vap(1)*wtrc_ratio(isph2o,qice(m), qice(1))
3493 pice_vap(m) = max(pice_vap(m), -qice(m))
3494 end if
3495 end do
3496 else ! use integral form for distillation
3497 if (pice_vap(1) > 0._r8) then ! ice deposition by distillation, kinetic
3498 vtotnew = qvap(1) - pice_vap(1)
3499 vtotnew = max(vtotnew, 0._r8)
3500 do m = 2, niso
3501 call wtrc_vap_distil(alpice(m),qvap(1),vtotnew,qvap(m),visonew,dvapiso)
3502 pice_vap(m) = -dvapiso
3503 pice_vap(m) = min(pice_vap(m), qvap(m))
3504 end do
3505 else ! sublimation, no fractionation
3506 do m = 2, niso
3507 pice_vap(m) = pice_vap(1)*wtrc_ratio(isph2o,qice(m), qice(1))
3508 pice_vap(m) = max(pice_vap(m), -qice(m))
3509 end do
3510 end if
3511 end if
3512
3513 do m = 1, niso
3514 qice(m) = qice(m) + pice_vap(m)
3515 qvap(m) = qvap(m) - pice_vap(m)
3516 end do
3517
3518!
3519! equilibrate liquid/vapour equilibrium with second increment
3520!
3521 qliq(1) = qliq(1) + (1._r8-fieq)*pliq_vap(1)
3522 qvap(1) = qvap(1) - (1._r8-fieq)*pliq_vap(1)
3523 do m = 2, niso
3524 call wtrc_liqvap_equil(alpliq(m),feq0,qvap(1),qliq(1), &
3525 qvap(m),qliq(m),pliq_vap(m))
3526 end do
3527!
3528! Detrain vapour
3529!
3530 do m = 2, niso
3531 pvdet(m) = pvdet(1)*wtrc_ratio(isph2o,qvap(m),qvap(1))
3532 pvdet(m) = min(pvdet(m), qvap(m))
3533 end do
3534!
3535 do m = 1, niso
3536 qvap(m) = qvap(m) - pvdet(m)
3537 vdet(m) = vdet(m) + pvdet(m)
3538 end do
3539!
3540! Complete the iteration by removing rain and snow production
3541!
3542 do m = 2, niso ! must do m=1 first
3543 prain(m) = prain(1)*wtrc_ratio(isph2o,qliq(m),qliq(1))
3544 prain(m) = min(prain(m), qliq(m))
3545 psnow(m) = psnow(1)*wtrc_ratio(isph2o,qice(m),qice(1))
3546 psnow(m) = min(psnow(m), qice(m))
3547 end do
3548!
3549 do m = 1, niso
3550 qliq(m) = qliq(m) - prain(m)
3551 rain(m) = rain(m) + prain(m)
3552 qice(m) = qice(m) - psnow(m)
3553 snow(m) = snow(m) + psnow(m)
3554 end do
3555!
3556! Allows some fraction of the rain to equilibrate with cloud vapour
3557! (isotope only exchange effect)
3558!
3559 if (feq_rn > 0._r8) then
3560 do m = 2, niso
3561 call wtrc_liqvap_equil(alpliq(m),feq_rn,qvap(1),rain(1), &
3562 qvap(m),rain(m),prnw_vap(m))
3563 end do
3564 end if
3565
3566!
3567 end do ! itr, iteration loop
3568!
3569! For final state, ensure liquid and vapour are in equilibrium
3570! (might be needed in calling code)
3571!
3572
3573 do m = 2, niso
3574 call wtrc_liqvap_equil(alpliq(m),feq0,qvap(1),qliq(1), &
3575 qvap(m),qliq(m),pliq_vap(m))
3576 end do
3577
3578!
3579! Assin final values to output, and check budget was done correctly
3580!
3581
3582!write(iulog,*) 'bulk water vapor',vapnew(1),qvap(1)
3583!write(iulog,*) 'bulk water liquid',liqnew(1),qliq(1)
3584!write(iulog,*) 'bulk water ice', icenew(1),qice(1)
3585
3586 do m = 2, niso ! dont assign to total
3587!
3588 vapnew(m) = qvap(m)
3589 liqnew(m) = qliq(m)
3590 icenew(m) = qice(m)
3591 vapdet(m) = vdet(m)
3592 rainpr(m) = rain(m)
3593 snowpr(m) = snow(m)
3594!
3595! Final check for budgets
3596! If not balanced, try more iterations
3597! Also, could do an adjustment to enforce mass conservation while
3598! preserving ratios...
3599!
3600 totalold = vapold(m) + liqold(m) + iceold(m) + vapent(m)
3601 totalnew = vapnew(m) + liqnew(m) + icenew(m) + vapdet(m) + rainpr(m) + snowpr(m)
3602 if (abs(totalold - totalnew) > qtolerr) then
3603 write(*,*) '(wtrc_dicm) WARNING - isotope budget not balanced.'
3604 write(*,*) m,totalold, totalnew, totalold - totalnew
3605!! call endrun('(wiso_dicm) ABORTED.')
3606 end if
3607!
3608 end do
3609
3610 return
3611end subroutine wtrc_dicm
3612
3613!=======================================================================
361415584548811558454881subroutine wtrc_liqvap_equil(alpha, feq0, vaptot, liqtot, vapiso, liqiso, dliqiso)
3615!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3616! Equilibrate vapour and liquid, assuming the input mass is right
3617! but distribution is not. liquid vapour partitioning is given by input
3618! total water.
3619!
3620! Given budgets are unchanged : v + l = q, and vi + li = qi
3621! And equilibrium of final state: li/l = alpha vi/v
3622! Solve for final isotope vapour (thus liquid from budget):
3623! vi = efac*qi
3624! efac = 1/F; F = alpha*(l/v) + 1
3625!
3626! Nothing fancy here.
3627!
3628! David Noone <dcn@colorado.edu> - Wed Jul 21 19:08:54 MDT 2004
3629!
3630!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3631 implicit none
3632!---------------------------- Arguments --------------------------------
3633 real(r8), intent(in) :: alpha ! fractionation fatcor
3634 real(r8), intent(in) :: feq0 ! fraction fractionated
3635 real(r8), intent(in) :: vaptot ! total vapour
3636 real(r8), intent(in) :: liqtot ! total liquid
3637 real(r8), intent(inout) :: vapiso ! isotopic vapour
3638 real(r8), intent(inout) :: liqiso ! isotopic liquid
3639 real(r8), intent(out) :: dliqiso ! change in liquid
3640!------------------------- Local Variables -----------------------------
3641 real(r8) dviso ! change in vapour
3642 real(r8) qtot, qiso ! total mass of total and isotope
3643 real(r8) efac ! equilibration factor
3644 real(r8) ratio
3645!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3646! real(r8) :: qtiny = 1.e-22
3647 real(r8) :: qtiny = 1.e-36
3648!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3649!
365015584548811558454881 dliqiso = 0._r8
3651 qtot = vaptot + liqtot ! not used
3652 qiso = vapiso + liqiso
3653
3654!
3655! Check for trivial cases - while these fall out in the algebra,
3656! the numericas can be a little picky... so treat them explictly.
3657!
3658! NOTE: This code can produce incorrect values if the input is a moisture
3659!flux with negative values. Thus it must be guarranteed that every input
3660!into this subroutine is positive definite - JN.
3661!
3662 if (qtot < qtiny) then ! makes no sense, do nothing
3663! write(iulog,*) '(wiso_liqvap_equil) no (trivial) water - doing nothing'
3664 return
3665 end if
366615584548811558454881 if (qiso < qtiny) then
3667! write(iulog,*) '(wiso_liqvap_equil) no (trivial) isotope - doing nothing'
3668 return
3669 end if
3670!
367115584544701558454470 if (liqtot < qtiny) then
3672! write(iulog,*) '(wiso_liqvap_equil) no liquid - dump all isotope to vapor'
367310264214791026421479 dliqiso = -liqiso
3674 vapiso = vapiso - dliqiso
3675 liqiso = 0._r8
3676 return
3677 end if
3678532032991532032991 if (vaptot < qtiny) then
3679! write(iulog,*) '(wiso_liqvap_equil) no vapour - dump all isotope to liquid'
368000 dliqiso = vapiso
3681 vapiso = 0._r8
3682 liqiso = liqiso + dliqiso
3683 return
3684 end if
3685!
3686! Compute mass exchange from Rc = a Rv and v + l + q, in the normal way
3687!
36885320329911064065982 dviso = wtrc_dqequil(alpha,feq0,vaptot,liqtot,vapiso,liqiso)
3689 dliqiso = -dviso
3690
3691!
3692! Update for outpout
3693!
3694 liqiso = liqiso + dliqiso
3695 vapiso = vapiso - dliqiso
3696!
3697 return
369815584548811558454881end subroutine wtrc_liqvap_equil
3699
3700!=======================================================================
3701532032991532032991function wtrc_dqequil(alpha,feq0,vtotnew,ltotnew,visoold,lisoold)
3702!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3703! Computes changes in vapour isotope due to equilibration (optionally
3704! partial), in a two-phase system. Nothing fancy here:
3705! Solve the mass balance under constraints dv+dl = 0; Rl = aRv
3706! Author: David Noone <dcn@colorado.edu> - Wed Aug 11 13:32:00 MDT 2004
3707!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3708 implicit none
3709!---------------------------- Arguments --------------------------------
3710 real(r8), intent(in) :: alpha ! fractionation factor
3711 real(r8), intent(in) :: feq0 ! fraction equilibrated
3712 real(r8) ,intent(in) :: vtotnew ! new vapour
3713 real(r8) ,intent(in) :: ltotnew ! new liquid
3714 real(r8) ,intent(in) :: visoold ! old isotope vapour
3715 real(r8) ,intent(in) :: lisoold ! old isotope liquid
3716!
3717 real(r8) wtrc_dqequil ! return value
3718!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3719 real(r8) qiso ! total isotope
3720 real(r8) vieql ! new isotope vapour with equilibration
3721 real(r8) vinof ! new isotope vapour no fractionation
3722 real(r8) visonew ! new isotope vapour
3723 real(r8) dviso ! change in isotope vapour
3724!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3725!
3726532032991532032991 qiso = visoold + lisoold
3727
3728! fractionating: Rc = alpha Rv
37295320329911064065982 vieql = qiso * wtrc_efac(alpha, vtotnew, ltotnew)
3730
3731! non-fractionating: Rc = Rv
37325320329911064065982 vinof = qiso * wtrc_efac(1.0_r8 , vtotnew, ltotnew)
3733
3734! Merge for partial equilibration
3735 visonew = feq0*vieql + (1._r8-feq0)*vinof
3736
3737! Compute tendency
3738 dviso = visonew - visoold
3739
3740! Check for numerical overflow
3741 if (dviso < 0._r8) then
37425004396950043969 dviso = max(dviso , -visoold ) ! don't move more than available vapour
3743 else
3744481989022481989022 dviso = min(dviso , lisoold ) ! don't move more than available liquid
3745 end if
3746! Assign to output
3747532032991532032991 wtrc_dqequil = dviso
3748532032991532032991end function wtrc_dqequil
3749
3750!=======================================================================
3751subroutine wtrc_vap_distil(alpha,vtotold,vtotnew,visoold,visonew,dvapiso)
3752!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3753! Performs a rayleigh distillation on some vapour increment assuming
3754! the parcel is in isolation (this is in integral form).
3755!
3756! Given, dvi/dv = alpha (vi/v), integration from vold to vnew gives:
3757! vinew = viold*(vnew/vold)**alpha
3758!
3759! Nothing fancy here.
3760!
3761! David Noone <dcn@colorado.edu> - Thu Jul 22 11:18:29 MDT 2004
3762!
3763!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3764 implicit none
3765!---------------------------- Arguments --------------------------------
3766 real(r8), intent(in) :: alpha ! fractionation factor
3767 real(r8), intent(in) :: vtotold ! initial total vapour
3768 real(r8), intent(in) :: vtotnew ! final total vapour
3769 real(r8), intent(in) :: visoold ! initial isotope vapour
3770 real(r8), intent(out) :: visonew ! initial isotope vapour
3771 real(r8), intent(out) :: dvapiso ! change in isotope vapour (diagnostic)
3772!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3773 real(r8) :: qtiny = 1.e-22
3774!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3775 dvapiso = 0._r8
3776!
3777! Check for trivial cases
3778!
3779 if (vtotold < vtotnew) then
3780 write(*,*) '(wtrc_vap_distill) vapour increase, while expecting decrease'
3781! call endrun('ABORT')
3782 endif
3783 if (vtotold < qtiny) then
3784 write(*,*) '(wtrc_vap_distil) no (trivial) vapour - doing nothing.'
3785 visonew = visoold
3786 return
3787 end if
3788!
3789! Solve the logarithm, and back out change
3790!
3791 visonew = visoold*wtrc_ratio(isph2o,vtotnew,vtotold)**alpha
3792 dvapiso = visonew - visoold
3793 return
3794end subroutine wtrc_vap_distil
3795
3796!=======================================================================
379753248106496subroutine wtrc_precip_evap(state,rprd,deltat,evpbulk,subbulk,dqdt,prec,snow)
3798!
3799!--------------------------------------
3800!
3801!Purpose: To calculate the influence of
3802!precipitation phase changes (evaporation,
3803!sublimation, melting, and freezing) on water
3804!tracers and water isotopes.
3805!
3806!Written by: Jesse Nusbaumer <nusbaume@colorado.edu> - April 2012
3807!
3808!--------------------------------------
3809
3810
3811use shr_kind_mod, only: r8 => shr_kind_r8
3812use physics_types, only: physics_state
3813use ppgrid, only: pcols, pver, pverp
3814use physconst, only: gravit, tmelt
3815use cloud_fraction, only: cldfrc_fice
3816use wv_saturation, only: qsat
3817use water_types, only: iwtvap
3818
3819!*****************
3820!Declare variables
3821!*****************
3822
3823implicit none
3824
3825!Input/Output:
3826
3827type(physics_state), intent(in) :: state ! Physics state variabiles
3828
3829real(r8), intent(in) :: rprd(pcols,pver,pcnst) ! precip production (kg/kg/s)
3830real(r8), intent(in) :: deltat ! time step
3831
3832real(r8), intent(in) :: evpbulk(pcols,pver) ! bulk evaporation rate (kg/kg/s)
3833real(r8), intent(in) :: subbulk(pcols,pver) ! bulk sublimation rate (kg/kg/s)
3834
3835!real(r8), intent(in) :: cldfrc(pcols,pver) ! cloud fraction !TESTING!!!
3836
3837real(r8), intent(inout) :: dqdt(pcols,pver,pcnst) ! Change in water vapor (kg/kg/s)
3838real(r8), intent(inout) :: prec(pcols,pcnst) ! Conv.-scale precip. rate (m/s)
3839real(r8), intent(inout) :: snow(pcols,pcnst) ! Conv.-scale snowfall rate (m/s)
3840
3841!Local variables:
3842
3843real(r8) :: rnbulk(pcols,pver) !bulk rain evaporation rate (prec-snow) (kg/kg/s)
3844
3845real(r8) :: evp(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !Water tracer evaporation (kg/kg/s)
3846real(r8) :: mlt(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !Water tracer snow melt (kg/kg/s)
3847real(r8) :: frz(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !Water tracer rain freeze (kg/kg/s)
3848real(r8) :: sub(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !Water tracer snow sublimation (kg/kg/s)
3849
3850real(r8) :: flxpr(pcols,pverp,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !precip flux (kg/m2/s)
3851real(r8) :: flxsn(pcols,pverp,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !Snow flux (kg/m2/s)
3852real(r8) :: dldt(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !Rain tendency (kg/kg/s)
3853real(r8) :: dsdt(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !Snow tendency
3854
3855real(r8) :: Rp(pcols,pver) !Water tracer precip ratio
3856real(r8) :: Rr(pcols,pver) !Water tracer rain ratio
3857real(r8) :: Rv(pcols,pver) !Water tracer vapor ratio
3858real(r8) :: Rs(pcols,pver) !Water tracer snow ratio <-Not used?
3859real(r8) :: fice(pcols,pver) !Fraction of ice in layer
3860real(r8) :: fsnow(pcols,pver) !Fraction that becomes snow
3861real(r8) :: est(pcols,pver) !Saturation vapor pressure
3862real(r8) :: qst(pcols,pver) !Saturation specific humidity
3863real(r8) :: rh(pcols,pver) !Relative humidity
3864real(r8) :: heff(pcols,pver) !Effective humidity
3865
3866real(r8) :: alpliq !Equilibrium liquid-vapor fractionation factor
3867real(r8) :: alpkin !Kinetic fractionation factor
3868real(r8) :: phi !Tunable parameter to determine heff
3869real(r8) :: ivtmp !Temporary water tracer vapor value
3870real(r8) :: iltmp !Temporary water tracer rain value
3871real(r8) :: vtmp !Temporary standard vapor value
3872real(r8) :: ltmp !Temporary standard liquid value
3873real(r8) :: dliqiso !Change in isotopic liquid to due equilibration
3874real(r8) :: Re !Rain evaporation ratio (includes fractionation)
3875
3876!For Stewart rain re-evaporation:
3877real(r8) :: totrnfx(pcols,pverp) !Total precipitation flux
3878real(r8) :: gam,bet !Stewart equation parameters
3879real(r8) :: fr !Fraction of precip remaining after rain evaporation
3880real(r8) :: Rstw !precipitation ratio after application of Stewart equation
3881
3882!These next two variables are present in water_isotopes.F90, and thus
3883!ideally should be pulled from there. - JN
3884
3885real(r8) :: difrm(pwtspec) !Diffusivity ratio array
3886real(r8) :: dkfac !Diffusivity power law factor
3887
3888!For partial equilibration calculation:
3889integer :: ispec !water isotope species
3890real(r8) :: dz(pcols,pver) !layer thickness in height
3891real(r8) :: fequil !fraction equilibrated (unitless)
3892!real(r8), parameter :: radius=0.001_r8 !assumed radius of raindrop (m)
3893real(r8) :: radius !assumed radius of raindrop (m)
3894
3895!Index and loop variables:
3896
3897integer :: ncol !Number of atmospheric columns
3898
3899integer :: i,k,m !loop variables
3900
3901!For precip mass fixer:
3902real(r8) :: pdiff
3903real(r8) :: sdiff
3904real(r8) :: pmass0
3905real(r8) :: smass0
3906real(r8) :: Rd
3907
3908!********************
3909!Initialize variables
3910!********************
3911
3912!Set variables to zero:
3913102236160122150912evp(:,:,:) = 0._r8
3914102236160122150912mlt(:,:,:) = 0._r8
3915102236160122150912frz(:,:,:) = 0._r8
3916102236160122150912sub(:,:,:) = 0._r8
39172555904030457856fice(:,:) = 0._r8
39182555904030457856fsnow(:,:) = 0._r8
39192555904030457856rnbulk(:,:) = 0._r8
3920105644032126197760flxpr(:,:,:) = 0._r8
3921105644032126197760flxsn(:,:,:) = 0._r8
39222641100831469568totrnfx(:,:) = 0._r8
39232555904030457856dz(:,:) = 0._r8
3924
39255324853248ncol = state%ncol
3926
3927!Determine ice fraction in layer
39285324853248call cldfrc_fice(ncol, state%t, fice, fsnow)
3929
3930!Determine saturation vapor pressure:
39312156856048035936call qsat(state%t(1:ncol, 1:pver), state%pmid(1:ncol, 1:pver), &
3932 est(1:ncol, 1:pver), qst(1:ncol, 1:pver))
3933
3934!calculate relative humidity:
39352156856026467376rh(:ncol,:) = state%q(:ncol,:,1)/qst(:ncol,:)
3936
3937!Diffusivity ratios and powers (should be called from water_isotopes.F90 eventually):
3938212992319488difrm = (/ 1._r8, 1._r8, 0.9836504_r8, 0.9686999_r8 /) ! kinetic theory
39395324853248dkfac = 0.58_r8 ! From Stewart, 1975?
3940
3941!phi value given in Bony et. al., 2008:
3942phi = 0.9_r8
3943
3944!calculate layer thickness:
3945718952718952do i = 1,ncol
39462156856022287512 do k = 1,pver
3947 dz(i,k) = state%zi(i,k) - state%zi(i,k+1)
3948 end do
3949end do
3950
3951!**********************************
3952!Calculate bulk rain re-evaporation
3953!**********************************
3954
39552555904030457856rnbulk(:,:) = evpbulk(:,:)-subbulk(:,:)
3956
3957!**************************
3958!loop through water tracers
3959!**************************
3960
3961!do m=1,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)
3962
39632555904030457856Rp(:,:) = 0._r8 !initalize ratios
39642555904030457856Rv(:,:) = 0._r8
3965
3966!************************
3967!Loop through grid points
3968!************************
3969
3970718952772200do i=1,ncol
39712156856022287512 do k=1,pver
3972
397386274240107842800 do m=1,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)
3974
39754141163520049348865280 Rp(:,:) = 0._r8 !initalize ratios
39764141163520049348865280 Rr(:,:) = 0._r8
39774141163520049348865280 Rs(:,:) = 0._r8
39784141163520049348865280 Rv(:,:) = 0._r8
3979
3980!**********
3981!Set ratios
3982!**********
3983
3984!NOTE: Evaporation and sublimation are functions of the precip flux, not the precip
3985!production. Thus the ratios should be based off of the precip flux. - JN
3986
3987!Water tracer precipitation ratio:
39888627424086274240if(k .eq. 1) then !at top of column?
398928758085751616 Rp(i,k) = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),rprd(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),rprd(i,k,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap)))
3990else
39918339843283398432 if(flxpr(i,k,1) .ne. 0._r8) then !is there actual precipitation here?
3992777748415554968 Rp(i,k) = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),flxpr(i,k,m),flxpr(i,k,1))
3993 else !If not, just use local production.
399475620948151241896 Rp(i,k) = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),rprd(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),rprd(i,k,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap)))
3995 end if
3996end if
3997
3998!Water tracer rain ratio:
39998627424086274240if(k .eq. 1) then !at top of column?
400028758085751616 Rr(i,k) = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),rprd(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),rprd(i,k,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap)))
4001else
40028339843283398432 if((flxpr(i,k,1)-flxsn(i,k,1)) .gt. 0._r8) then !is there actual precipitation here (if negative, then assume all snow)?
4003633028412660568 Rr(i,k) = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),(flxpr(i,k,m)-flxsn(i,k,m)),(flxpr(i,k,1)-flxsn(i,k,1)))
4004 else !If not, just use local production.
400577068148154136296 Rr(i,k) = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),rprd(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),rprd(i,k,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap)))
4006 end if
4007end if
4008
4009!Water tracer snow ratio:
40108627424086274240if(k .eq. 1) then !at top of column?
401128758085751616 Rs(i,k) = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),rprd(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),rprd(i,k,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap)))
4012else
40138339843283398432 if(flxsn(i,k,1) .ne. 0._r8) then !is there actual precipitation here?
401416413363282672 Rs(i,k) = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),flxsn(i,k,m),flxsn(i,k,1))
4015 else !If not, just use local production.
401681757096163514192 Rs(i,k) = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),rprd(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),rprd(i,k,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap)))
4017 end if
4018end if
4019
4020!Water tracer vapor ratio:
402186274240172548480Rv(i,k) = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap)))
4022
4023!**************************
4024!Calculate rain evaporation
4025!**************************
4026
4027!Stewart, 1975 isotopic evaporation formulation:
4028
402986274240150979920if(wisotope .and. (m .gt. 1) .and. (totrnfx(i,k) .gt. 0._r8)) then !Are water isotopes being used and not H2O or H216O, and is precip. present?
4030
4031 !calculate equilibrium alpha:
403247477164747716 ispec = iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) !water isotope species
4033
4034 !calculate equilibrium alpha:
403547477169495432 alpliq = wtrc_get_alpha(state%q(i,k,wtrc_bulk_indices(iwtvap)),state%t(i,k),ispec,&
4036 iwtvap,iwtliq,.false.,1._r8,.false.)
4037
4038 !calculate kinetic alpha:
403947477169495432 alpkin = (1._r8/difrm(ispec))**dkfac
4040! alpkin = 1._r8 !turn kinetic fractionation off...
4041
4042 !calculate effective humidity:
4043 heff(i,k) = phi+((1_r8-phi)*rh(i,k)) !From Bony et. al., 2008
4044
4045 !remove evaporated mass in specific grid level:
4046 fr = (totrnfx(i,k)-(rnbulk(i,k)*state%pdel(i,k)/gravit))/totrnfx(i,k)
4047
4048 !Constrain ratio fraction:
4049 fr = min(1._r8,max(0._r8,fr))
4050
4051 !calculate radius based off rain rate:
4052 !NOTE: mean diameter in mm = 4/(4.1*R^-0.21), with R in mm/hr, assuming
4053 !Marshall-Palmer distribution. -JN
405447477169495432 radius = 2._r8/(4.1_r8*(totrnfx(i,k)*60._r8*60._r8)** (-0.21_r8))
4055
4056 !convert radius to meters:
4057 radius = radius/1000._r8
4058
4059 !Calculate fraction equilibrated:
406047477164747716 call wtrc_equil_time(ispec,state%t(i,k),state%pmid(i,k),radius,dz(i,k),alpliq,difrm(ispec),fequil)
4061
4062 !Constrain equilibration fraction:
406347477164747716 fequil = min(1._r8,max(0._r8,fequil))
4064
4065 !calculate evaporation rate:
4066! if((heff(i,k) < 1.0_r8) .and. (fr .lt. 1._r8)) then !Is the air un-saturated and rain is evaporating?
4067 if(.false.) then !Only equilibrate when using wtrc_equil_time. -JN
4068
4069 !calculate parameters
4070 gam = (alpliq*heff(i,k))/(1._r8-alpliq*alpkin*(1._r8-heff(i,k)))
4071 bet = (1._r8-alpliq*alpkin*(1._r8-heff(i,k)))/(alpliq*alpkin*(1._r8-heff(i,k)))
4072
4073 !Calculate new rain ratio applying Stewart, 1975 equation:
407400 Rstw = gam*Rv(i,k) + (Rr(i,k) - gam*Rv(i,k)) * fr**bet
4075
4076 !apply equilibration fraction:
4077 Re = fequil*Rstw + (1._r8-fequil)*Rr(i,k)
4078
4079 !Calculate rain re-evaporation:
408000 if((fr .eq. 0._r8) .and. (bet .lt. 0._r8)) then !Prevent NaNs (plus there shouldn't be any evaporation anyways)
408100 evp(i,k,m) = rnbulk(i,k)*Rr(i,k)
4082 else
408300 evp(i,k,m) = ((flxpr(i,k,m)-flxsn(i,k,m)) - Re*((flxpr(i,k,1)-flxsn(i,k,1))-(evp(i,k,1)*state%pdel(i,k)/gravit)))*&
4084 gravit/state%pdel(i,k)
4085 end if
4086 else
4087 !NOTE: This evp below should always be zero. If not, then at least it will match
4088 ! the bulk water (even if its physically incorrect) - JN
408947477164747716 evp(i,k,m) = rnbulk(i,k)*Rr(i,k)
4090
4091 !calculate liquid-vapor equilibrium:
4092 ivtmp = state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))+evp(i,k,m)*deltat !set temporary storage variables
4093 iltmp = (((flxpr(i,k,m)-flxsn(i,k,m))*gravit/state%pdel(i,k))-evp(i,k,m))*deltat
4094 vtmp = state%q(i,k,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap))+evp(i,k,1)*deltat
4095 ltmp = (((flxpr(i,k,1)-flxsn(i,k,1))*gravit/state%pdel(i,k))-evp(i,k,1))*deltat
409647441384744138 if((iltmp .gt. 0._r8) .and. (ltmp .gt. 0._r8)) then
409747440174744017 call wtrc_liqvap_equil(alpliq, fequil, vtmp, ltmp, ivtmp, iltmp, dliqiso) !calculate equilibrium tendency
4098 else
409936993699 dliqiso = 0._r8
4100 end if
410147477164747716 evp(i,k,m) = evp(i,k,m) - dliqiso/deltat !Add tendency to evaporation
4102
4103 end if !RH
4104else
41058152652481526524 evp(i,k,m) = rnbulk(i,k)*Rr(i,k)
4106end if
4107
4108!*******************
4109!Calculate snow melt
4110!*******************
4111
41128627424086274240if(state%t(i,k) > tmelt) then ! melt all snow
41132142848021428480 mlt(i,k,m) = flxsn(i,k,m) * gravit/state%pdel(i,k) !also convert back to kg/kg/s
4114else ! retain all snow
41156484576064845760 mlt(i,k,m) = 0._r8
4116end if
4117
4118!***********************
4119!Calculate rain freezing
4120!***********************
4121
41228627424086274240if(flxpr(i,k,1) > 0._r8) then
412377774847777484 frz(i,k,m) = min(max(0._r8,flxsn(i,k,1)/flxpr(i,k,1)),1._r8) ! guess snow fraction
4124else
41257849675678496756 frz(i,k,m) = 0._r8
4126end if
41278627424086274240frz(i,k,m) = max(fsnow(i,k),frz(i,k,m)) ! guess again
4128
4129417108417108if(mlt(i,k,1) > 0._r8) frz(i,k,m) = 0._r8
4130
4131!**************************
4132!Calculate snow sublimation
4133!**************************
4134
4135!No fractionation occurs during sublimation, so water tracers and water isotopes are equivalent. - JN
4136
41378627424086274240sub(i,k,m) = subbulk(i,k)*Rs(i,k)
4138
4139!********************
4140!Calculate tendencies
4141!********************
4142
4143!NOTE: dqdt seems to work if evpbulk is used - JN
4144
4145dqdt(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) = evp(i,k,m)+sub(i,k,m) !dqdt must remain pcnst
4146dldt(i,k,m) = -(evp(i,k,m)+sub(i,k,m)) !mlt(i,k,m)-frz(i,k,m)
4147dsdt(i,k,m) = frz(i,k,m)*rprd(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))-sub(i,k,m)-mlt(i,k,m)
4148
4149!********************
4150!Modify precipitation
4151!********************
4152
4153!NOTE: The k+1 allows precipitation to be added to the next level down, which is why the variables
4154!can be called in the freezing and melting calculations even though the variables are first created
4155!here. -JN
4156
4157!pdel/gravit converts kg/kg/s to kg/m2/s
4158
4159flxpr(i,k+1,m) = flxpr(i,k,m)+(rprd(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))+dldt(i,k,m))*state%pdel(i,k)/gravit !modify rain
4160flxsn(i,k+1,m) = flxsn(i,k,m)+dsdt(i,k,m)*state%pdel(i,k)/gravit !modify snow
4161
4162!prevent negative numbers:
4163flxpr(i,k+1,m) = max(flxpr(i,k+1,m), 0._r8)
4164flxsn(i,k+1,m) = max(flxsn(i,k+1,m), 0._r8)
4165
4166!Compute total rain amount:
41678627424086274240if(wisotope .and. m .eq. 1) then !Are isotope on, and is it H2O?
41682156856021568560 totrnfx(i,k+1) = totrnfx(i,k) + ((1._r8-frz(i,k,m))*rprd(i,k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))+&
4169 mlt(i,k,m)-evp(i,k,m))*state%pdel(i,k)/gravit
4170
4171 !prevent negative numbers:
4172 totrnfx(i,k+1) = max(totrnfx(i,k+1), 0._r8)
4173end if
4174
4175!*********
4176!End loops
4177!*********
4178
4179end do !water tracers
4180
4181 end do !pver
4182 end do !pcols
4183
4184!Dividing by 1000 converts kg/m2/s to m/s for H2O (aka density of liquid water is 1000 kg/m3) -JN
4185
4186212992266240do m=1,wtrc_nwset
4187
4188 !Set surface Rain (Precip.) values:
418928758083301792 prec(:ncol,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) = flxpr(:ncol,pverp,m)/1000_r8
4190
4191 !Set surface Snow values:
419228758083301792 snow(:ncol,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) = flxsn(:ncol,pverp,m)/1000_r8
4193
4194end do
4195
4196!-----------------------
4197!correct for mass errors:
4198!-----------------------
4199718952772200do i=1,ncol
4200 !Calculate differences:
4201718952718952 pmass0 = prec(i,wtrc_iatype(2,iwtvap))
4202 smass0 = snow(i,wtrc_iatype(2,iwtvap))
4203 pdiff = pmass0 - prec(i,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap))
4204 sdiff = smass0 - snow(i,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap))
420521568562156856 do m=2,wtrc_nwset
4206 !Total precip errors:
420721568564313712 Rd = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),(prec(i,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))-snow(i,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))),pmass0)
4208 prec(i,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) = max(0._r8, prec(i,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))-Rd*pdiff)
4209 !Snow errors:
421021568564313712 Rd = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),snow(i,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),smass0)
4211 snow(i,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) = max(0._r8, snow(i,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))-Rd*sdiff)
4212 !Giant error check:
4213 !NOTE: !Seems to occur baout once every seven years. -JN
4214 if(prec(i,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) .gt. 10._r8*prec(i,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap))) then
4215431431 if(prec(i,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap)) .gt. wtrc_qmin) &
4216216 write(*,*) 'ERROR: Isotopic deep-conv precip error!',prec(i,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),prec(i,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap)),&
4217 snow(i,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),snow(i,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap)),i,m
4218 !Set the tracer precip back to bulk water (it violates mass-conservation,
4219 !but is probably due to a numerical/non-physical error anyways).
4220431431 prec(i,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) = prec(i,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap))
4221 snow(i,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) = snow(i,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap))
4222 end if
4223 end do
4224end do
4225!----------------------
4226
4227!**************
4228!End subroutine
4229!**************
4230end subroutine wtrc_precip_evap
4231
4232
4233!=======================================================================
42342302697223026972subroutine wtrc_equil_time(ispec,temp,pres,rdrop,zdel,alpha,difrm,fequil)
4235!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4236!
4237! Function to compute adjustment timescale for isotopic equilibration.
4238! This routine could be bolted into CAM.
4239!
4240! Final adjustment fo isotope ratio of rain drops woiuld be:
4241!
4242!
4243! R_rain = (1.-fequil)*R_original * fequil*R_stewart
4244!
4245! This code outputs fequil
4246!
4247!
4248! David Noone <dcn@coas.oregonstate.edu> - Thu Jun 4 13:31:25 MDT 2015
4249!
4250! Modified for use in CAM5 by Jesse Nusbaumer <nusbaume@colorado.edu> - June, 2015
4251!
4252!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4253
4254use physconst, only: rair, rh2o, gravit, rhoh2o
4255use wv_saturation, only: qsat
4256
4257!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4258!Declare variables
4259!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4260 implicit none
4261!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4262!------------------------ Output Arguments -----------------------------
4263
4264 real(r8) , intent(out) :: fequil ! adustment fraction
4265
4266!------------------------- Input Arguments -----------------------------
4267
4268 integer , intent(in) :: ispec ! isotopologue species flag
4269 real(r8) , intent(in) :: temp ! temperature (K)
4270 real(r8) , intent(in) :: pres ! pressure (Pa)
4271 real(r8) , intent(in) :: rdrop ! drop RADIUS (m)
4272 real(r8) , intent(in) :: zdel ! layer thickness (m)
4273 real(r8) , intent(in) :: alpha ! equilibrium fractionation factor
4274 real(r8) , intent(in) :: difrm ! ratio of isotope diffusivities
4275
4276!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4277
4278 real(r8) :: tadjust ! adjustment time (sec)
4279 real(r8) :: texposure ! time in layer (sec)
4280
4281 real(r8) :: rhoa ! density of air (kg/m^3)
4282
4283 real(r8) :: Re ! Reynolds nunber
4284 real(r8) :: Sc ! Schemidt number
4285 Real(r8) :: xx ! Re**1/2 * Sc** 1/3
4286
4287 real(r8) :: difa ! diffusivity of H2O in air (m^2/s)
4288 real(r8) :: mu ! dynamic viscosity (kg/m/s)
4289 real(r8) :: vterm ! terminal velocity (m/s)
4290 real(r8) :: cddrop ! droplet drag coefficient
4291 real(r8) :: fvent ! ventillation factor (unitless)
4292
4293 !saturation vapor pressure variables:
4294 real(r8) :: esat ! saturation vapor pressure (Pa)
4295 real(r8) :: qst ! saturation mixing ratio (kg/kg)
4296
4297!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4298
4299!
4300! Compute density of air on input (equation of state):
4301!
43022302697223026972 rhoa = pres/(Rair*temp) ! density of air (kg/m3)
4303
4304!
4305! Calculate saturation vapor pressure:
4306!
43072302697223026972 call qsat(temp, pres, esat, qst)
4308
4309!
4310! Diffusivity of H2O in air (Hall and Pruppacher 1976)
4311!
43122302697246053944 difa = 2.11e-5_r8*difrm*(temp/273.15_r8)**1.94_r8 * (101325._r8/pres) ! m2/sec
4313
4314! No fractionation:
4315! difa = 2.11e-5_r8*(temp/273.15_r8)**1.94_r8 * (101325._r8/pres) ! m2/sec
4316
4317!
4318! Viscosity of air (Sutherland's formula)
4319!
4320!NOTE: use equation from MOZART aerosol subroutines (Rodgers and Yau, pg. 103):
43212302697246053944 mu = 1.72e-5_r8 * ((temp/273.0_r8)**1.5_r8) * 393.0_r8 / (temp+120.0_r8)
4322
4323!
4324! Drop terminal fall velocity (from Foote and Du Toit, 1969):
4325!
4326 cddrop = 0.6_r8 !From Straka, 2009
43272302697223026972 vterm = sqrt((4._r8/3._r8)*gravit*(2._r8*rdrop)*rhoh2o/(cddrop*rhoa) )
4328
4329!
4330! Reynolds number (note factor of 2, since length scale should be diamater):
4331!
4332 Re = 2._r8*rdrop*rhoa*vterm/mu !equation 10-10 in P&K, 1997
4333
4334!
4335! Schmidt number (Pruppacher and Klett):
4336!
4337 Sc = mu/(rhoa*difa)
4338
4339!
4340! Ventillation factor (Pruppacher and Klett, 1997):
4341!
43422302697269080916 xx = Re**(1._r8/2._r8) * Sc**(1._r8/3._r8)
4343
4344 if(xx .ge. 1.4_r8) then !cut off from Pruppacher and Rasmussen, 1979
43451869030518690305 fvent = 0.78_r8 + 0.308_r8*xx !equation 13-61 in P&K, 1997
4346 else
434743366674336667 fvent = 1.0_r8 + 0.108_r8*xx*xx !equation 13-60 in P&K, 1997
4348 endif
4349
4350!
4351! Compute adjustment time (Stewart, Lee and Fung)
4352! (Note, diffusivity here SHOULD be for isotopes IF you were interested
4353! in doing the kinetic component explictly along side the total
4354! fractionation)
4355!
4356! Equation from Lee and Fung, 2008:
4357
43582302697223026972 tadjust = alpha*(rdrop*rdrop)*rhoh2o*rh2o*temp/(3._r8*fvent*difa*esat)
4359
4360!No fractionation:
4361! tadjust = (rdrop*rdrop)*rhoh2o*rh2o*temp/(3._r8*fvent*difa*esat)
4362
4363!
4364! Compute the exposure time as the time falling throught this layer
4365!
4366 texposure = zdel/vterm
4367
4368!
4369! Finally the adjustment fraction
4370!
43712302697223026972 fequil = 1._r8 - exp(-texposure/tadjust)
4372
4373!
4374 return
43752302697223026972end subroutine wtrc_equil_time
4376
4377
4378!=======================================================================
437910640659821064065982function wtrc_efac(alpha, vapnew, liqnew)
4380!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4381! Computes isotopic equilibration factor - there are different ways to
4382! compute this which have slightly different numerical properties.
4383! Author: David Noone <dcn@colorado.edu> - Fri Aug 13 11:26:19 MDT 2004
4384!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4385 real(r8) , intent(in) :: alpha ! fractionation factor
4386 real(r8) , intent(in) :: vapnew ! new total vapour
4387 real(r8) , intent(in) :: liqnew ! new total liquid
4388 real(r8) wtrc_efac ! return value
4389!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4390 real(r8) efac ! equilibration factor
4391 real(r8) alov ! alpha times l on v
4392 real(r8) qtot ! total water
4393!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4394
4395!#define DIRECTWAY
4396!#ifdef DIRECTWAY /* This, most obvious way is less precise */
4397! alov = alpha*wtrc_ratio(isph2o, liqnew, vapnew)
4398!#else /* this one can have more precise numerics */
439910640659822128131964 alov = wtrc_ratio(isph2o, vapnew, vapnew+liqnew)
4400
4401 alov = alpha*(1.0_r8/alov - 1.0_r8) ! this is l/v
4402!#endif
4403
4404 efac = 1.0_r8/(alov + 1.0_r8)
4405
4406!
4407 efac = max(efac, 0._r8) !Ensure that equilibration factor is between zero and one
4408 efac = min(efac, 1._r8)
4409!
4410 wtrc_efac = efac
4411 return
441210640659821064065982end function wtrc_efac
4413
4414
4415!=======================================================================
4416!Version 3
4417!=======================================================================
4418!=======================================================================
441953248106496subroutine wtrc_q1q2_pjr(dqdt , ideep, lengath, &
4420 q ,qub , done ,lel ,lcl , &
4421 dupc ,du ,dp ,qstb ,qsthatb , &
4422 hmn ,hsatb ,hsthatb ,eu , &
4423 mu ,md ,qdb ,tu ,td , &
4424 dsubcld ,mx ,jt ,il2g , &
4425 msg ,ed ,rppe ,mupc ,mdpc , &
4426 evpc ,evp ,cupc ,cu ,pap , &
4427 dz ,qds ,rpdpc ,c0mask ,eps0 , &
4428 jd ,wtrprd ,wtdlf ,dtime)
4429
4430
4431!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4432!
4433! Purpose: This subroutine is designed to
4434!calculate the water tracer/isotope tendencies due to
4435!the ZM deep convective scheme.
4436!
4437! Author: Jesse Nusbaumer <nusbaume@colorado.edu> - August, 2012
4438!
4439!
4440! NOTE: The temperatures used in this code are temperatures that exist
4441! after (before?) condensation/evaporation of the model (bulk) water has
4442! occured. Ideally, the temperature before and after the latent
4443! heating or cooling would be known, and the phase change tendencies
4444! would be solved iterively over a changing temperature, similar
4445! to what's done in the cloud physics. For now, using the final
4446! temperature should be fine. - JN
4447!
4448!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4449
4450!**************
4451!Use statements
4452!**************
4453
4454 use physconst, only: cpair, latvap, rair, epsilo
4455 use ppgrid, only: pverp
4456
4457!********************
4458!Variable decleration
4459!********************
4460
4461 implicit none
4462!
4463! Input fields:
4464!
4465 logical, intent(in) :: done(pcols,pver) !updraft loop endpoint
4466 integer, intent(in) :: lel(pcols) !Equilibrium level (EL)
4467 integer, intent(in) :: lcl(pcols) !lifted condensation level (LCL)
4468 integer, intent(in) :: mx(pcols) !Bottom of updraft
4469 integer, intent(in) :: jd(pcols) !Top of downdraft
4470 integer, intent(in) :: jt(pcols) !Top of updraft
4471 integer, intent(in) :: il2g
4472 integer, intent(in) :: msg
4473 integer, intent(in) :: ideep(pcols) !location of deep convection
4474 integer, intent(in) :: lengath !number of grid spaces with deep convection
4475
4476 real(r8), intent(in) :: q(pcols,pver,pcnst) !Environmental water vapor mixing ratio (state%q) [kg/kg]
4477 real(r8), intent(in) :: qstb(pcols,pver) !bulk saturated env. water vapor mixing ratio [kg/kg]
4478 real(r8), intent(in) :: qsthatb(pcols,pver) !qst at interfaces
4479 real(r8), intent(in) :: qub(pcols,pver) !bulk water vapor mixing ratio in updraft [kg/kg]
4480 real(r8), intent(in) :: hmn(pcols,pver) !bulk environmental moist static energy
4481 real(r8), intent(in) :: hsatb(pcols,pver) !bulk saturated env. moist static energy
4482 real(r8), intent(in) :: hsthatb(pcols,pver) !hsat at interfaces
4483 real(r8), intent(in) :: dp(pcols,pver) !layer thickness [mb]
4484 real(r8), intent(in) :: mdpc(pcols,pver) !md before unit-change
4485 real(r8), intent(in) :: dupc(pcols,pver) !detrainment rate in updraft pre-unit change
4486 real(r8), intent(in) :: du(pcols,pver) !input detrainment rate in updraft
4487 real(r8), intent(in) :: mupc(pcols,pver) !mu before unit-change
4488 real(r8), intent(in) :: eu(pcols,pver) !input updraft entraiment rate
4489 real(r8), intent(in) :: mu(pcols,pver) !mass flux in updraft
4490 real(r8), intent(in) :: md(pcols,pver) !mass flux in downdraft
4491 real(r8), intent(in) :: qdb(pcols,pver) !bulk water vapor mixing ratio in downdraft [kg/kg]
4492 real(r8), intent(in) :: tu(pcols,pver) !temperature in updraft [K?]
4493 real(r8), intent(in) :: td(pcols,pver) !temperature in downdraft [K?]
4494 real(r8), intent(in) :: ed(pcols,pver) !downdraft entrainment rate [?]
4495 real(r8), intent(in) :: evpc(pcols,pver) !evaporation rate pre-unit change [kg/m3/s]
4496 real(r8), intent(in) :: evp(pcols,pver) !evaporation rate in downdraft
4497 real(r8), intent(in) :: cupc(pcols,pver) !condensation rate pre-unit change [kg/m3/s]
4498 real(r8), intent(in) :: cu(pcols,pver) !condensation rate in updraft
4499 real(r8), intent(in) :: rppe(pcols,pver) !g: rain production pre-evaporation [?]
4500 real(r8), intent(in) :: dsubcld(pcols) !sub-cloud layer thickness [mb]
4501 real(r8), intent(in) :: pap(pcols,pver) !Pressure at interfaces [Pa]
4502 real(r8), intent(in) :: dz(pcols,pver) !Layer thickness in height [m]
4503 real(r8), intent(in) :: qds(pcols,pver) !bulk water saturation value in downdraft [kg/kg]
4504 real(r8), intent(in) :: rpdpc(pcols,pver) !precipitation production pre-unit change [?]
4505 real(r8), intent(in) :: c0mask(pcols) !Autoconversion rates [1/m]
4506 real(r8), intent(in) :: eps0(pcols) !Not quite sure, should look up...
4507 real(r8), intent(in) :: dtime !2xdt (model timestep)
4508!
4509! Output fields:
4510!
4511 real(r8),intent(out) :: dqdt(pcols,pver,pcnst) !water tracer tendency [kg/kg/s]
4512 real(r8),intent(out) :: wtrprd(pcols,pver,pcnst) !precipitation production rate [kg/kg/s]
4513 real(r8),intent(out) :: wtdlf(pcols,pver,wtrc_nwset) !tendency due to condensate detrainment [kg/kg/s]
4514!
4515! Work fields:
4516!
4517 integer i
4518 integer k
4519 integer m
4520 integer kbm
4521 integer ktm
4522 integer kount
4523 integer blm
4524 integer tlm
4525
4526 !NOTE: These variables below may not need to be 3-D arrays, and could simply be reset
4527 !after every tracer loop. However, for now it should be left as is (because it works) - JN
4528
4529 real(r8) qhat(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !water vapor mixing ratios at level interfaces [kg/kg]
4530 real(r8) qu(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !water vapor mixing ratio in updraft [kg/kg]
4531 real(r8) qd(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !water vapor mixing ratio in downdraft [kg/kg]
4532 real(r8) wtcu(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !water tracer condensation rate [?]
4533 real(r8) wtevp(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !water tracer evaporation rate [?]
4534 real(r8) hu(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !tracer moist static energy in updraft
4535 real(r8) hd(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !tracer moist static energy in downdraft
4536 real(r8) wthmn(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !tracer environmental moist static energy
4537 real(r8) hsat(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !tracer saturated env. moist static energy
4538 real(r8) qst(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !tracer saturated env. vapor mixing ratio
4539 real(r8) gamma(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !No clue, just need it for parameterization
4540 real(r8) hsthat(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap))!hsat at interfaces
4541 real(r8) qsthat(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap))!qsat at interfaces
4542 real(r8) gamhat(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap))!Gamma at interfaces
4543 real(r8) Ru(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !water tracer updraft ratio [unitless]
4544 real(r8) Rd(pcols,pver,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !water tracer downdraft ratio [unitless]
4545 real(r8) huct(pcols,pver) !MSE storage variable for cloud top height
4546
4547 !For isotopic fractionation:
4548 real(r8) alpha !fractionation factor [unitless]
4549! real(r8) alpcn !condensation fractionation factor [unitless]
4550! real(r8) alpev !evaporation fractionation factor [unitless]
4551 real(r8) dliqiso !needed for isotopic equilbration subroutine [kg/kg]
4552 real(r8) nu !ice/liquid fraction [unitless]
4553 real(r8) que !equilibrated updraft vapor [kg/kg]
4554 real(r8) qle !equilibrated cloud condensate [kg/kg]
4555 real(r8) qur !Rayleigh-distilled updraft vapor [kg/kg]
4556 real(r8) qlr !Rayleigh-distilled updraft vapor [kg/kg]
4557 real(r8) cue !equilibrated updraft condensate [kg/kg]
4558 real(r8) cur !Rayleigh-distilled updraft condensate [kg/kg]
4559 real(r8) cuh !H2O updraft condensate [kg/kg]
