4560 real(r8) fr !Fraction of moisture remaining [unitless]
4561 real(r8) ltmp !temporary standard liquid amount [kg/kg]
4562 real(r8) iltmp !temporary isotopic liquid amount [kg/kg]
4563
4564 !For precip production:
4565 real(r8) totpcp(pcols,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !Total precipitation [?]
4566 real(r8) totevp(pcols,wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)) !Total evaporation [?]
4567 real(r8) rprd(pcols,pver) !Precipitation production pre-unit change [?]
4568 !NOTE: Might need to make "pevp" the evaporation term used in the actual
4569 !tendency calculation! - JN
4570 real(r8) pevp(pcols,pver) !precipitation evaporation
4571 real(r8) ql(pcols,pver,wtrc_nwset) !precipitable liquid [kg/kg]
4572 real(r8) ql1 !temporary precipitable liquid storage [kg/kg]
4573 real(r8) Rr !precipitation production ratio [unitless]
4574
4575 !For mass fixer:
4576 real(r8) uqdiff !correction factor for updraft humidity [kg/kg]
4577 real(r8) dqdiff !correction factor for downdraft humidity [kg/kg]
4578 real(r8) oval !original H2O water mass before mass-fixing [kg/kg]
4579 real(r8) Rfix !Water tracer/isotope ratio used to apply mass fix [unitless]
4580
4581 !Other variables:
4582 real(r8) Rc !water tracer condensation ratio [unitless]
4583 real(r8) Re !water tracer evaporation ratio [unitless]
4584 real(r8) qdifr
4585 real(r8) emc
4586 real(r8) mdt
4587
4588!***************************************
4589!Exit if no deep convection is occurring
4590!***************************************
4591
4592if(lengath.eq.0) then
4593
4594 !Set tendencies to zero:
459522082760 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
459674188808880576 dqdt(:,:,wtrc_iatype(m,:)) = 0.0_r8
4597 end do
4598
4599 return
4600
4601else
4602
4603!***********************
4604!Loop over water tracers
4605!***********************
4606
4607210784263480 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
4608
4609 !Initalize variables:
4610708234240847773248 dqdt(:,:,wtrc_iatype(m,:)) = 0.0_r8
4611101176320120568448 wtrprd(:,:,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) = 0.0_r8
4612101176320120568448 wtdlf(:,:,m) = 0.0_r8
4613101176320120568448 qhat(:,:,m) = q(:,:,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) !Done to match zm_convr
4614101176320120568448 qu(:,:,m) = 0.0_r8 !<-possibly not needed...
4615101176320120568448 qd(:,:,m) = 0.0_r8
46162698308046375208 qu(1:lengath,:,m) = q(ideep(:lengath),:,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))
46172698308046375208 qd(1:lengath,:,m) = q(ideep(:lengath),:,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))
4618101176320120568448 ql(:,:,m) = 0.0_r8
4619101176320120568448 wtcu(:,:,m) = 0.0_r8
4620101176320120568448 wtevp(:,:,m) = 0.0_r8
4621101176320120568448 wthmn(:,:,m) = 0.0_r8
4622101176320120568448 hsat(:,:,m) = 0.0_r8
4623101176320120568448 qst(:,:,m) = 0.0_r8
4624101176320120568448 gamma(:,:,m) = 0.0_r8
4625101176320120568448 hsthat(:,:,m) = 0.0_r8
4626101176320120568448 qsthat(:,:,m) = 0.0_r8
4627101176320120568448 gamhat(:,:,m) = 0.0_r8
4628101176320120568448 hu(:,:,m) = 0.0_r8
4629101176320120568448 hd(:,:,m) = 0.0_r8
463033725443794112 totpcp(:,m) = 0.0_r8
463133725443794112 totevp(:,m) = 0.0_r8
4632101176320120568448 Ru(:,:,m) = 0.0_r8
4633101176320120568448 Rd(:,:,m) = 0.0_r8
4634 uqdiff = 0.0_r8
4635 dqdiff = 0.0_r8
4636
4637 end do
4638
4639!**************************
4640!Calculate interface values (qhat)
4641!**************************
4642
4643!NOTE: The natural logarithm (log) is NOT a linear operator,
4644!thus the ratio will not neccesarily be carried through, and
4645!could result in a loss of tracer/tracer ratio conservation. - JN
4646
4647!-------------
4648!water vapor:
4649!-------------
4650
4651210784263480 do m=1,wtrc_nwset !water tracers
465252696005480384 do k = msg + 2,pver
46532248590027755500 do i = 1,lengath
46542248590022485900 qdifr = 0.0_r8
46551010 if (q(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) > 0._r8 .or. q(ideep(i),k-1,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) > 0._r8) &
46562248589922485899 qdifr = abs((q(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))- &
4657 q(ideep(i),k-1,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)))/max(q(ideep(i),k-1,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),&
4658 q(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))))
46592248590044971720 if ((qdifr > 1.E-6_r8) .and. (qdifr /= 1._r8)) then !qdifr /= 1 used to prevent divison by zero. - JN
46602248580344971606 qhat(i,k,m) = log(q(ideep(i),k-1,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))/q(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))) * &
4661 q(ideep(i),k-1,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) * &
4662 q(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))/ &
4663 (q(ideep(i),k-1,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) - &
4664 q(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)))
4665 else
46669797 qhat(i,k,m) = 0.5_r8* (q(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))+q(ideep(i),k-1,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)))
4667 end if
4668 end do
4669 end do
4670 end do
4671
4672!***********************************************************
4673!calculate updraft humidity with cloud condensate production
4674!***********************************************************
4675
4676!NOTE: Although according to the CAM5 documentation, the equation for qu should
4677!be complete, there still appear to be small errors [O(10e-16)] that occur between the equation
4678!and the standard bulk updraft water. Thus a "qdiff" variable is included to compensate for
4679!these differences. As this qdiff appears to be directly proportional to the original tracer ratio,
4680!it should only need to be calculated once. - JN
4681
468213174001370096 do k = pver,msg + 2,-1
468356214756938875 do i = 1,lengath
4684562147516627343 if ((k > 1 .and. k < mx(i)) .and. eps0(i) > 0._r8) then !Not sure why this is needed, but it errors without it - JN
468553291815329181 if(mupc(i,k) > 0._r8) then !Do only if mass flux is positive
4686
4687 !++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
4688 !determine liquid/ice fraction for isotopes
4689 !++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
4690 !NOTE: Using same temperature cut-off as Macrophysics for
4691 !convective detrainment. - JN
469219411951941195 if(tu(ideep(i),k) > 268.15_r8) then
469316777521677752 nu = 0.0_r8
4694263443263443 elseif(tu(ideep(i),k) < 238.15_r8) then
469584948494 nu = 1.0_r8
4696 else
4697254949254949 nu = (268.15_r8 - tu(ideep(i),k)) / 30._r8
4698 endif
4699 !+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
4700
470177647809705975 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
4702
4703 !Calculate ratio:
4704776478015529560 Ru(i,k,m) = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),qu(i,k+1,m),qu(i,k+1,1)) !calculate ratio
4705
4706 !Calculate condensation:
4707 wtcu(i,k,m) = Ru(i,k,m)*cupc(i,k)
4708
4709 !++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
4710 !Calculate isotopic fractionation in the updraft condensation
4711 !++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
471277647807764780 if(wisotope .and. (m .gt. 1)) then !only do for isotopes:
4713! if(.false.) then
4714 !Equilibrium fractionation factor:
4715582358511647170 alpha = wtrc_get_alpha(qub(i,k+1),tu(ideep(i),k+1),iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),&
4716 iwtvap,iwtliq,.false.,1._r8,.false.)
4717
4718 !---------------------------
4719 !Equilibrate liquid fraction
4720 !---------------------------
4721 cue = wtcu(i,k,m)*dz(i,k)/mupc(i,k) !convert to kg/kg
4722 cuh = wtcu(i,k,1)*dz(i,k)/mupc(i,k) !H2O condensation
4723 !Equilibrate:
472458235855823585 call wtrc_liqvap_equil(alpha, 1._r8, qu(i,k+1,1), cuh,&
4725 qu(i,k+1,m), cue, dliqiso)
4726
4727 !determine value of original condensation amount if equilibrated:
472858235855823585 cue = wtcu(i,k,m) + (dliqiso*mupc(i,k)/dz(i,k))
4729 !multiply by liquid fraction:
4730 cue = cue * (1._r8 - nu)
4731 !---------------------------
4732 !Distill ice fraction
4733 !---------------------------
4734 !calculate new fractionation factor:
4735582358511647170 alpha = wtrc_get_alpha(qub(i,k+1),tu(ideep(i),k+1),iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),&
4736 iwtvap,iwtice,.true.,pap(i,k),.true.)
4737 !fraction of mass that's condensed:
4738 fr = (qu(i,k+1,1)-cuh)/qu(i,k+1,1)
4739 !limit fraction:
4740 fr = min(1._r8,max(0._r8,fr))
4741 !distill isotope mass:
4742582358511647170 qur = qu(i,k+1,m)*fr**alpha
4743 !determine amount of mass condensed:
4744 cur = qu(i,k+1,m)-qur
4745 !determine value of original condensation amount if distilled:
4746 cur = cur*mupc(i,k)/dz(i,k)
4747 !multiply by ice fraction:
4748 cur = cur * nu
4749 !--------------------------------------
4750 !combine into final condensation amount
4751 !--------------------------------------
4752 wtcu(i,k,m) = cue + cur
4753 !--------------------------------------
4754 end if !wisotope
4755 !++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
4756
4757 !Calculate updraft humidity:
475877647807764780 qu(i,k,m) = mupc(i,k+1)/mupc(i,k)*qu(i,k+1,m) + dz(i,k)/mupc(i,k)* &
4759 (eu(i,k)*q(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))- &
4760 dupc(i,k)*Ru(i,k,m)*qstb(i,k) - wtcu(i,k,m))
4761
4762 !Apply mass fix:
4763 !--------------
4764 if(m .eq. 1) then !only do for H2O tracer
476519411951941195 oval = qu(i,k,m) !save original value
4766 uqdiff = qub(i,k)-qu(i,k,m)
4767 end if
4768776478015529560 Rfix = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),qu(i,k,m),oval)
4769 qu(i,k,m) = qu(i,k,m)+Rfix*uqdiff !add back difference
4770 !--------------
4771
4772 !Produce cloud condensate:
4773 if (k >= jt(i)) then
477477647807764780 ql1 = 1._r8/mupc(i,k)* (mupc(i,k+1)*ql(i,k+1,m)- &
4775 dz(i,k)*dupc(i,k)*ql(i,k+1,m)+dz(i,k)*wtcu(i,k,m))
4776
4777 ql(i,k,m) = ql1/ (1._r8+dz(i,k)*c0mask(i))
4778 else
477900 ql(i,k,m) = 0._r8
4780 end if
4781
4782 end do !water tracers
4783
4784 else
4785
47861355194416939930 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
4787 qu(i,k,m) = q(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) !If not, then assume updraft vapor is env. vapor
4788 end do
4789
4790 end if
4791 end if
4792 !complain if uqdiff is too large:
4793 !----------------
479456214755621475 if((uqdiff/qub(i,k)) .gt. 10e-10_r8) then !relative error greater than 1e-9?
479500 write(iulog,*) 'wtrc q1q2 uqdiff error here!',uqdiff/qub(i,k),uqdiff,&
4796 qub(i,k),i,k
4797 end if
4798 !---------------
4799 end do
4800 end do
4801
4802!********************************************
4803!Calculate downdraft humidity and evaporation
4804!********************************************
4805
4806!NOTE: These two quantities must be computed at the same time. - JN
4807
4808!NOTE: Assume initial downdraft vapor is equal to the ratio of the updraft vapor
4809!at the starting height (assumes that the vapor from the drowndraft comes directly
4810!from the updraft). - JN
4811
4812!NOTE: Also perform unphysical "qdiff" process here, just to make sure
4813!ratios are conserved. - JN.
4814
4815!NOTE: The evaporation term appears to be precipitation re-evaporation. For
4816!now, it might be wise to assume that its all rain or all snow, until a suitable
4817!temperature cutoff can be determined. NEW NOTE: Given that rain re-evaporation
4818!occurs again in the wtrc_precip_evap subroutine, and given that the downdraft should
4819!be close to saturated (at least if I am remembering the ZM scheme correctly), and
4820!given that rain is falling in a column of air (the downdraft) that is also
4821!moving downward, and thus the rain might be in contact with the same air for
4822!longer than normal, it is assumed that the precipitation is always rain, and
4823!that it equilibrates isotopically with the downdraft air. - JN
4824
4825224859277555 do i = 1,lengath
48268994361124295 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
4827899436899436 Rd(i,jd(i),m) = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),qu(i,jd(i),m),qu(i,jd(i),1))
4828 qd(i,jd(i),m) = Rd(i,jd(i),m)*qds(i,jd(i))
4829 end do
4830 end do
4831
483213174001370096 do k = msg+2,pver
483356214756938875 do i=1,lengath
483456214759237895 if (k >= jd(i) .and. k < mx(i) .and. eps0(i) > 0._r8) then
4835
483667586768448345 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
4837
4838675867613517352 Rd(i,k,m) = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),qd(i,k,m),qd(i,k,1)) !calculate tracer ratio
4839
4840 wtevp(i,k,m) = Rd(i,k,m)*evpc(i,k)
4841
4842 qd(i,k+1,m) = (dz(i,k)*(wtevp(i,k,m)+ed(i,k)*q(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))) - &
4843 mdpc(i,k)*qd(i,k,m))/(-mdpc(i,k+1))
4844
4845 !Apply mass fix:
4846 !---------------
4847 if(m .eq. 1) then !only do for H2O tracer
484816896691689669 oval = qd(i,k+1,m) !save original value
4849 dqdiff = qdb(i,k+1)-qd(i,k+1,m)
4850 end if
485167586766758676 Rfix = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),qd(i,k+1,m),oval)
4852 qd(i,k+1,m) = qd(i,k+1,m)+Rfix*dqdiff
4853 !---------------
4854
4855 totevp(i,m) = totevp(i,m) - dz(i,k)*ed(i,k)*q(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))
4856
4857 end do
4858
4859 end if
4860 !complain if dqdiff is too large:
4861 !----------------
486256214755621475 if((dqdiff/qdb(i,k)) .gt. 10e-10_r8) then !relative error greater than 1e-9?
486300 write(iulog,*) 'wtrc q1q2 dqdiff error here!',dqdiff/qdb(i,k),dqdiff,&
4864 qdb(i,k),i,k
4865 end if
4866 !---------------
4867 end do
4868 end do
4869
4870!***************************
4871!calculate total evaporation
4872!***************************
4873
4874210784263480do m=1,wtrc_nwset
48758994361110220 do i= 1,lengath
4876 totevp(i,m) = totevp(i,m) + mdpc(i,jd(i))*qd(i,jd(i),m) - mdpc(i,mx(i))*qd(i,mx(i),m)
4877 end do
4878end do
4879
4880!*******************************
4881!Calculate rain production rates (rprd)
4882!*******************************
4883
4884210784263480 do m=1,wtrc_nwset !wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)
4885
4886101176320120568448 pevp(:,:) = 0._r8 !inialize precipitable liquid
4887101176320120568448 rprd(:,:) = 0._r8
4888
4889!Produce precipitation:
489052696005480384 do k = pver,msg + 2,-1
48912248590027755500 do i = 1,lengath
48922248590049417432 if (k >= jt(i) .and. k < mx(i) .and. eps0(i) > 0._r8 .and. mupc(i,k) >= 0.0_r8) then
489386547728654772 totpcp(i,m) = totpcp(i,m) + dz(i,k)*(wtcu(i,k,m)-dupc(i,k)*ql(i,k+1,m))
4894 rprd(i,k) = c0mask(i)*mupc(i,k)*ql(i,k,m) !finalize rain production
4895 end if
4896 end do
4897 end do
4898
4899!Evaporate precipitation:
490052696005480384 do k = msg + 2,pver
49012248590027755500 do i = 1,lengath
49022248590022485900 totpcp(i,m) = max(totpcp(i,m),0._r8) !Remove negative values
4903 totevp(i,m) = max(totevp(i,m),0._r8)
49042118060021180600 if (totevp(i,m) > 0._r8 .and. totpcp(i,m) > 0._r8) then
49052116617521166175 pevp(i,k) = wtevp(i,k,m)*min(1._r8, totpcp(i,m)/(totevp(i,m)+totpcp(i,m)))
4906 else
490713197251319725 pevp(i,k) = 0._r8
4908 end if
49092248590022485900 rprd(i,k) = rprd(i,k)-pevp(i,k) !evaporate precipitation
49102248590044971800 Rr = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),rprd(i,k),rpdpc(i,k)) !calculate precip ratio
4911 wtrprd(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) = Rr*wtrprd(ideep(i),k,1) !calculate precip production (done to avoid unit conversions)
4912 !+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
4913 !Isotopically Equilibrate precipitation with downdraft vapor
4914 !+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
4915 !NOTE: This sections appears to produce regions where the preciptation
4916 !d-excess is -40 or less, which is way outside the range of observations
4917 !or theoretical expectations for those locations. This combined with
4918 !the fact that the precipitation goes through a second round of possible
4919 !equilibration in wtrc_precip_evap means that for now it would be better
4920 !to simply not equilibrate here. However, one could argue physically
4921 !that this should still be present, so if later it is found that
4922 !something generates an abnormally high d-excess over certain land
4923 !regions, turning this on may be a good way to counterbalance that. - JN
4924 if(.false.) then
4925! if(wisotope .and. (m .gt. 1)) then !only do for isotopes
492600 alpha = wtrc_get_alpha(qdb(i,k),td(ideep(i),k),iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),&
4927 iwtvap,iwtliq,.false.,1._r8,.false.)
4928
4929 !create temporary liquid values
4930 ltmp = wtrprd(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap))*dtime
4931 iltmp= wtrprd(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))*dtime
4932
493300 call wtrc_liqvap_equil(alpha, 1._r8, qd(i,k,1), ltmp, qd(i,k,m), iltmp, dliqiso)
4934
4935 !determine value of original precipitation amount if equilibrated:
493600 wtrprd(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) = wtrprd(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) + dliqiso/dtime
4937 end if
4938 !+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
4939 end do
4940 end do
4941
4942 end do !water tracers (m)
4943!------------
4944
4945!************************
4946! find the highest level top and bottom levels of convection
4947!************************
4948
49495269652696 ktm = pver
4950 kbm = pver
4951
4952224859224859 do i=1,lengath
4953 ktm = min(ktm,jt(i))
4954 kbm = min(kbm,mx(i))
4955 end do
4956
4957!********************************
4958!Calculate cloud-level tendencies
4959!********************************
4960
4961210784263480 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
496226320442842828 do k = ktm,pver-1
49631159532814227372 do i = 1,lengath
49641159532823190656 Rc = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),wtcu(i,k,m),wtcu(i,k,1)) !calculate tracer ratio
49651159532823190656 Re = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),wtevp(i,k,m),wtevp(i,k,1))
4966
4967 !NOTE: Ratios are used in order to avoid unit conversions. - JN
4968
4969 emc = -Rc*cu(ideep(i),k) & ! condensation in updraft
4970 +Re*evp(ideep(i),k) ! evaporating rain in downdraft
4971
4972 !Calculate tendencies:
4973 if(dp(i,k) .gt. 0._r8) then !the layer has a finite thickness?
49741159532811595328 dqdt(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) = emc + &
4975 (+mu(i,k+1)* (qu(i,k+1,m)-qhat(i,k+1,m)) &
4976 -mu(i,k)* (qu(i,k,m)-qhat(i,k,m)) &
4977 +md(i,k+1)* (qd(i,k+1,m)-qhat(i,k+1,m)) &
4978 -md(i,k)* (qd(i,k,m)-qhat(i,k,m)) &
4979 )/dp(i,k)
4980 else
498100 dqdt(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) = emc !no mass fluxes can occur...
4982 end if
4983
4984 !calculate detrained condensate:
4985 wtdlf(ideep(i),k,m) = du(i,k)*ql(i,k+1,m)
4986
4987 end do
4988 end do
4989
4990!******************************
4991!Calculate sub-cloud tendencies
4992!******************************
4993
4994256856467640 do k = kbm,pver
499511306121387468 do i=1,lengath
499611306121130612 if (k == mx(i)) then
4997
4998899436899436 dqdt(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) = (1._r8/dsubcld(i))* &
4999 (-mu(i,k)*(qu(i,k,m)-qhat(i,k,m)) &
5000 -md(i,k)*(qd(i,k,m)-qhat(i,k,m)) &
5001 )
5002231176231176 else if (k > mx(i)) then
50034889248892 dqdt(ideep(i),k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) = dqdt(ideep(i),k-1,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))
5004 end if
5005 end do
5006 end do
5007
5008 end do !Water tracers
5009
5010!******************
5011!End deep-con check
5012!******************
5013
5014end if !Lengath > 0
5015
5016!*********************
5017
5018 return
5019end subroutine wtrc_q1q2_pjr

5104 subroutine wtrc_rescale(q,ncol)
5105!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5106! Purpose: Ensures tracer water mass is exactly the same as prognostic
5107! Author: David Noone <dcn@caltech.edu> - Mon Mar 8 16:22:30 PST 2004
5108!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5109 use constituents, only: cnst_get_ind
5110!---------------------------- Arguments --------------------------------
5111 integer, intent(in) :: ncol
5112 real(r8), intent(inout) :: q(pcols,pver,pcnst)
5113!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5114 real(r8) qerr(pcols,pver)
5115 real(r8) rat
5116 integer i,k,m
5117 integer ixvap ! prognostic water species
5118 integer mbase ! tracer base for tracer m
5119 integer mprog ! prognostic base for tracer m
5120 integer ivap, itype
5121!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5122!
5123! Apply appropriate scaling
5124!
5125 do itype = 1, pwtype
5126 qerr(:,:) = 0._r8
5127
5128 m = wtrc_bulk_indices(itype)
5129
5130 do ivap = 1, wtrc_ntype(itype)
5131 mbase = wtrc_indices(wtrc_iatype(ivap, itype))
5132 qerr(:,:) = qerr(:,:) + q(:,:,mbase)
5133 end do
5134
5135!
5136! Compute the error
5137!
5138 qerr(:,:) = qerr(:,:) - q(:,:,m)
5139
5140!
5141! Compute tracer ratio, consistent with tracers, then
5142! apply to total (prognostic) mass
5143!
5144 do ivap = 1, wtrc_ntype(itype)
5145 mbase = wtrc_indices(wtrc_iatype(ivap, itype))
5146
5147 do k = 1, pver
5148 do i = 1, ncol
5149 rat = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(mbase), q(i,k,m), q(i,k,mbase))
5150!! q(i,k,m) = rat*q(i,k,mprog) ! direct scale
5151 q(i,k,m) = q(i,k,m) - rat*qerr(i,k) ! scale error
5152 end do
5153 end do
5154 end do
5155 end do
5156!
5157 return
5158 end subroutine wtrc_rescale
5159

516150962767215096276721 function wtrc_ratio(ispec,qtrc,qtot)
5162!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5163! Purpose: Compute tracer ratio from masses, with numerical checks
5164! Author David Noone <dcn@colorado.edu> - Sat Jul 3 18:52:40 MDT 2004
5165!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5166 integer,intent(in) :: ispec ! isotopic species
5167 real(r8),intent(in) :: qtrc ! tracer water mass
5168 real(r8),intent(in) :: qtot ! "base" water mass
5169 real(r8) :: wtrc_ratio ! return value
5170!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5171! real(r8) :: qtiny = 1.e-16_r8 ! bigger makes scheme more stable
5172 real(r8) :: qtiny = 1.e-22_r8 ! smaller makes scheme more accurate
5173!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5174
5175! if (qtot < qtiny) then
5176! wtrc_ratio = 1._r8
5177! else if (qtot > 0._r8) then
5178! wtrc_ratio = qtrc / (qtot+qtiny)
5179! else
5180! wtrc_ratio = qtrc / (qtot-qtiny)
5181! end if
5182
518350962767215096276721 if (abs(qtot) < wtrc_qmin) then
518428457151755691430350 wtrc_ratio = wtrc_get_rstd(ispec)
5185 else
518622505615462250561546 wtrc_ratio = qtrc / qtot
5187 end if
5188
5189 return
519050962767215096276721 end function wtrc_ratio

5194 subroutine wtrc_ratio_all(ncol,q,rat)
5195!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5196! Computes ratios for all water tracers
5197!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5198 use constituents, only: cnst_get_ind
5199!---------------------------- Arguments --------------------------------
5200 integer , intent(in) :: ncol
5201 real(r8), intent(in) :: q(pcols,pver,pcnst)
5202 real(r8), intent(out) :: rat(pcols,pver,pcnst)
5203!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5204 integer :: i ! column index
5205 integer :: k ! vertical index
5206 integer :: m ! constituent index for isotopic water
5207 integer :: mbase ! constituent index for "regular" water
5208 integer :: iwset ! water set index
5209 integer :: itype ! water type index
5210!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5211 rat(:,:,:) = 0._r8
5212
5213 ! Compute ratios based on total water set in the model. By definition,
5214 ! this should be the first water set.
5215 do iwset = 1, wtrc_nwset
5216 do itype = 1, pwtype
5217
5218 m = wtrc_iawset(itype, iwset)
5219 mbase = wtrc_iawset(itype, 1)
5220
5221 do k = 1, pver
5222 do i = 1, ncol
5223
5224 ! TBD: Should the strc routine or the wiso routine be used? Both would seem
5225 ! to need to be modified to handle smaller mixing ratios.
5226 rat(i, k, m) = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(m), q(i, k, m), q(i, k, mbase))
5227 end do
5228 end do
5229 end do
5230 end do
5231
5232 return
5233 end subroutine wtrc_ratio_all

523717710945291771094529 function wtrc_get_alpha(q, tk, ispec, isrctype, idsttype, rhclc, porqh, kin)
5238!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5239! Purpose: Retrieve the fractionation for a process that goes from
5240! the source water type to the destination water type.
5241!
5242! Author: Chuck Bardeen
5243!
5244! Modified for RH use by Jesse Nusbaumer
5245!
5246!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5247 use water_isotopes, only: isph2o
5248 use water_types, only: wtype_get_alpha
5249 use wv_saturation, only: qsat_water
5250
5251 real(r8), intent(in) :: q ! water vapor mixing ratio (kg/kg)
5252 real(r8), intent(in) :: tk ! temperature (K)
5253 integer, intent(in) :: ispec ! isotope species index
5254 integer, intent(in) :: isrctype ! source water type index
5255 integer, intent(in) :: idsttype ! destination water type index
5256 logical, intent(in) :: rhclc ! Does RH need to be calculated?
5257 real(r8), intent(in) :: porqh ! Either pressure (Pa) or RH, depending on rhclc
5258 logical, intent(in), optional :: kin ! Use kinetic fractionation? (over-rides namelist)
5259 real(r8) :: wtrc_get_alpha ! return fractionation factor
5260
5261 real(r8) :: pmid1(1) ! pressure (Pa)
5262 real(r8) :: tk1(1) ! temperature (K)
5263 real(r8) :: es(1) ! sat. vapor pressure
5264 real(r8) :: qs(1) ! saturation specific humidity
5265 real(r8) :: gam(1) ! (l/cp)*(d(qs)/dt) !<-Probably not needed... - JN
5266 logical :: alpkin ! Kinetic fractionation logical
5267!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5268
526917710945295313283587 if(present(kin)) then !Is kinetic fractionation being specified?
527015642821651564282165 alpkin = kin
5271 else !If not, then let namelist determine
5272206812364206812364 alpkin = wtrc_alpha_kinetic
5273 end if
5274
527517710945291771094529 if(rhclc) then !If relative humidity is being calculated:
52762159498121594981 pmid1(1) = porqh
5277 tk1(1) = tk
5278
52792159498164784943 call qsat_water(tk1, pmid1, es, qs, gam)
5280
52812159498121594981 if (wisotope) then
52822159498143189962 wtrc_get_alpha = wtype_get_alpha(ispec, isrctype, idsttype, tk, q / qs(1), alpkin)
5283 else
528400 wtrc_get_alpha = wtrc_fixed_alpha(ispec)
5285 end if
5286
5287 else !If relative humidity is already known:
5288
528917494995481749499548 if (wisotope) then
529017494995483498999096 wtrc_get_alpha = wtype_get_alpha(ispec, isrctype, idsttype, tk, porqh, alpkin)
5291 else
529200 wtrc_get_alpha = wtrc_fixed_alpha(ispec)
5293 end if
5294
5295 end if
5296
5297 return
529817710945291771094529 end function wtrc_get_alpha
5299

530229226886552922688655 function wtrc_get_rstd(ispec)
5303!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5304! Get the standard isotopic ratio, but adjust the H216O fraction so that
5305! the result for the model configuration sum to 1.
5306!
5307! NOTE: If wisotope is false, then a ratio of 1 is returned for h216o and
5308! 0 for all other species.
5309!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5310 use water_isotopes, only: wiso_get_rstd, isph2o
5311
5312 integer, intent(in) :: ispec
5313 real(r8) :: wtrc_get_rstd
5314
5315!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5316
5317 ! Either return the true standard isotopic ratio or the default value
5318 ! if isotopes are not enabled.
531929226886552922688655 if (wisotope) then
532029226886555845377310 wtrc_get_rstd = wiso_get_rstd(ispec)
5321 else
532200 wtrc_get_rstd = wtrc_fixed_rstd(ispec)
5323 endif
5324
5325 return
532629226886552922688655 end function wtrc_get_rstd
5327

5330
5331
5332
5333! NOTE: The following routines are to generate test cases and/or perform
5334! checks. These routines have been brought over from the previous version
5335! of the CAM isotope code, but are not currently being used. As
5336! development progresses, they may be removed if they are not found to
5337! be needed. The are similar to some checks that are incorporated into\
5338! the new code.
5339#undef NOCHECK /* DEBUG: define to bypass conservation checks */
5340#undef QCHKMESS /* DEBUG: define to give "sucess" message for checks */
5341#undef QCHKTERM /* DEBUG: define to terminate when "qchk" failed */

5344!=======================================================================
5345 subroutine wtrc_init_qpert(qpert)
5346!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5347! Initialize constituent perturbation to something (smow?)
5348!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5349 use water_isotopes, only: wiso_get_rstd
5350
5351 real(r8), intent(inout) :: qpert(pcols,pcnst)
5352
5353 real(r8) rat
5354
5355 integer ivap
5356!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5357 qpert(:,:) = 0._r8
5358
5359 if (trace_water) then
5360
5361 do ivap = 1, wtrc_ntype(iwtvap)
5362
5363 rat = wiso_get_rstd(wtrc_species(wtrc_iatype(ivap, iwtvap)))
5364!
5365 qpert(:,wtrc_indices(wtrc_iatype(ivap,iwtvap))) = rat * qpert(:,wtrc_bulk_indices(iwtvap))
5366 end do
5367
5368 end if
5369!
5370 return
5371 end subroutine wtrc_init_qpert

5384!---------------------------- Arguments --------------------------------

5406 call wtrc_qchk2(subr, trim(vname)//trim(wtype_suffix(wtrc_types(icnst))), &

5416 subroutine wtrc_qchk2(subr,vname,ncol,qtrc,qprg,qmag0)
5417!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5418! Purpose: Check the tracer water mass equal the prognostic
5419! Author: David Noone <dcn@caltech.edu> - Mon Jun 30 19:00:15 MDT 2003
5420!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5421
5422!---------------------------- Arguments --------------------------------
5423 character(len=*),intent(in) :: subr ! name of calling subroutine
5424 character(len=*),intent(in) :: vname ! name of variable
5425 integer , intent(in) :: ncol ! number of columns to scan
5426 real(r8), intent(in) :: qtrc(pcols,pver) ! tracer water
5427 real(r8), intent(in) :: qprg(pcols,pver) ! prognostic water
5428 real(r8), intent(in), optional :: qmag0 ! minimum magnitude of qprg
5429!------------------------- Local Variables -----------------------------
5430 real(r8) etest ! test variable
5431 real(r8) qmag
5432 real(r8) qdw, etw ! worst values
5433 integer nbad ! number of bad values found
5434 integer i,k
5435!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5436 nbad = 0
5437! qmag = 0._r8
5438 qmag = wtrc_qchkmin
5439 qdw = 0._r8
5440 etw = 0._r8
5441 if (present(qmag0)) qmag = qmag0
5442!
5443 do k = 1, pver
5444 do i = 1, ncol
5445 if (wtrc_qchk_one(qtrc(i,k),qprg(i,k),etest,qmag) > 0) then
5446#ifdef QCHKTERM
5447 write(iulog,1) 'WTRC_QCHK2: '//'('//trim(subr)//'.'//trim(vname)//')'// &
5448 ' q(m,1):',i,k,qtrc(i,k),qprg(i,k),etest
54491 format(a36,2i4,2e12.3,e12.4)
5450#endif
5451 etw = max(etw, abs(etest))
5452 qdw = max(qdw, abs(qtrc(i,k)-qprg(i,k)))
5453 nbad = nbad + 1
5454 end if
5455 end do
5456 end do
5457!
5458 if (nbad /= 0) then
5459 write(iulog,*) 'WTRC_QCHK2: '//'('//trim(subr)//'.'//trim(vname)//')',&
5460 ' *** WARNING - chunk tracers /= Q =',nbad,etw,qdw
5461#ifdef QCHKTERM
5462 call endrun('QCHK2 failed.')
5463#endif
5464 else
5465
5466#ifdef QCHKMESS /* print a sucess message */
5467 write(iulog,*) 'WTRC_QCHK2: '//'('//trim(subr)//'.'//trim(vname)//')',&
5468 ' All OK.'
5469#endif
5470 end if
5471!
5472 return
5473 end subroutine wtrc_qchk2
5474

5488!------------------------- Local Variables -----------------------------

5490 real(r8) qmag

5495 nbad = 0
5496! qmag = 0._r8

5499 etw = 0._r8
5500 if (present(qmag0)) qmag = qmag0
5501!
5502 do i = 1, ncol
5503 if (wtrc_qchk_one(qtrc(i),qprg(i),etest,qmag) > 0) then
5504#ifdef QCHKTERM
5505 write(iulog,1) 'WTRC_QCHK1: '//'('//trim(subr)//'.'//trim(vname)//')'// &
5506 ' q(m,1):',i,qtrc(i),qprg(i),etest
55071 format(a40,i4,' ',2e12.4,e12.4)
5508#endif

5510 qdw = max(qdw, abs(qtrc(i)-qprg(i)))
5511 nbad = nbad + 1
5512 end if
5513 end do

5518#ifdef QCHKTERM /* terminate */
5519 call endrun('QCHK1 failed.')
5520#endif

5532!=======================================================================
5533 function wtrc_qchk_one(qtrc,qprg,etest,qmag)
5534!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5535! Purpose: Check the one tracer water mass equal the prognostic
5536! Author: David Noone <dcn@caltech.edu> - Mon Jun 30 19:00:15 MDT 2003
5537!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5538! real(r8), parameter :: elimit = 1.0e-16 ! precision required
5539! real(r8), parameter :: elimit = 1.0e-14 ! precision required (q1q2 fails)
5540! real(r8), parameter :: elimit = 1.0e-12 ! precision required
5541 real(r8), parameter :: elimit = 1.0e-10_r8 ! precision required
5542! real(r8), parameter :: qmin = 1.0e-18 ! precision required
5543 real(r8), parameter :: qmin = 1.e-26_r8 ! precision required
5544!---------------------------- Arguments --------------------------------
5545 real(r8), intent(in) :: qtrc ! tracer water
5546 real(r8), intent(in) :: qprg ! prognostic water
5547 real(r8), intent(in) :: qmag ! difference limit
5548 real(r8), intent(out) :: etest ! test variable
5549 real(r8) qdiff,qmabs
5550 integer wtrc_qchk_one ! return value
5551!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5552 wtrc_qchk_one = 0
5553
5554#ifdef NOCHECK
5555!
5556! By-pass all checking if running with fractionation
5557!
5558#else
5559 qmabs = max(abs(qprg),abs(qtrc))
5560 qdiff = abs(qtrc - qprg)
5561 if (qmabs > qmin .and. qdiff > qmag) then
5562 etest = qdiff / qmabs
5563 if (etest > elimit) then
5564 wtrc_qchk_one = 1
5565#ifdef QCHKTERM /* if going to fail, write all diagnostics */
5566 write(iulog,'(a36,4e16.9)') '(WTRC_QCHK) FAILED TEST:',qtrc,qprg,qdiff,etest
5567#endif
5568 end if
5569 end if
5570#endif
5571!
5572 return
5573 end function wtrc_qchk_one

5576 subroutine wtrc_chkdelta(subr, ncol, q)
5577!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5578! Checks the delta values of a 2d array (lon,lev)
5579!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5580 use constituents, only: cnst_get_ind
5581 use water_isotopes, only: wiso_delta
5582!---------------------------- Arguments --------------------------------
5583 character(len=*), intent(in) :: subr ! name of calling routine/message
5584 integer , intent(in) :: ncol ! number of columns to scan
5585 real(r8), intent(in) :: q(pcols,pver,pcnst) ! tracer quantity
5586 real(r8) del, delbad
5587 integer i,k,m
5588 integer mbase ! prognostic base for tracer m
5589 integer nbad
5590 real(r8) qbad
5591 integer icnst
5592!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5593!
5594! Apply appropriate scaling
5595!
5596 do icnst = 1, wtrc_ncnst
5597 m = wtrc_indices(icnst)
5598 mbase = wtrc_bulk_indices(wtrc_types(icnst))
5599!
5600 delbad = 0._r8
5601 qbad = 0._r8
5602 nbad = 0._r8
5603
5604 do k = 1, pver
5605 do i = 1, ncol
5606 del = wiso_delta(iwspec(m), q(i,k,m), q(i,k,mbase))
5607
5608 if (abs(del) > 1001._r8) then
5609 nbad = nbad + 1
5610 if (abs(del) > abs(delbad)) then
5611 qbad = q(i,k,mbase)
5612 delbad = del
5613 endif
5614!! call endrun('(wtrc_chkdelta) Stopped.')
5615 end if
5616 end do
5617 end do
5618
5619!! if (nbad > 0) then
5620!! write(*,*) trim(subr)//' Bad delta values for m=',m
5621!! write(*,*) 'nbad = ',nbad, ' worst=',delbad,qbad
5622!! end if
5623 end do
5624
5625 return
5626 end subroutine wtrc_chkdelta

5628!=======================================================================
5629 subroutine wtrc_check(subr, ncol, q)
5630!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5631! Checks H2O tracer (ice, liquid and vapour) is the same as the prognostic
5632! (optionallly adjust)
5633!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5634 use constituents, only: cnst_get_ind, qmin
5635 use water_isotopes, only: wiso_delta
5636 use water_types, only: wtype_names
5637!---------------------------- Arguments --------------------------------
5638 character(len=*), intent(in) :: subr ! name of calling routine/message
5639 integer , intent(in) :: ncol ! number of columns to scan
5640 real(r8), intent(inout) :: q(pcols,pver,pcnst) ! tracer quantity (optionally scaled)
5641 real(r8) dwatr(wtrc_nspec(isph2o),pcols,pver)
5642 integer i,j,k,m
5643 integer iw(2) ! indices of worst values
5644 integer mbase ! prognostic base for tracer m
5645 logical lerrors
5646 integer icnst, ixh2oq, itype
5647!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5648 real(r8) :: qtol = 1.e-12_r8 ! qmin(Q) = 1.e-12, qmin(L,I) = 0.)
5649! real(r8) :: qtol = 1.e-15 ! qmin(Q) = 1.e-12, qmin(L,I) = 0.)
5650! real(r8) :: qtol = 1.e-17 ! Too strict for zm_evap (review?)
5651!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5652!
5653 lerrors = .false.
5654!
5655! Get all differences
5656!
5657 do j = 1, wtrc_nspec(isph2o)
5658 icnst = wtrc_iaspec(j, isph2o)
5659
5660 m = wtrc_indices(icnst)
5661 mbase = wtrc_bulk_indices(wtrc_types(icnst))
5662
5663! There should be one and only one H2O vapor that is not a tagged tracer.
5664 if (wtrc_is_vap(m) .and. .not. wtrc_is_tagged(m)) then
5665 ixh2oq = m
5666 end if
5667
5668 do k = 1, pver
5669 do i = 1, ncol
5670 dwatr(j,i,k) = q(i,k,mbase) - q(i,k,m)
5671 end do
5672 end do
5673 end do
5674!
5675! Send reports
5676!
5677 if (.not. wtrc_warn_only) then
5678 do k = 1, pver
5679 do i = 1, ncol
5680 if (abs(dwatr(j,i,k)) > max(qtol,qmin(wtrc_bulk_indices(iwtvap)))) then
5681 write(iulog,1) i,k,q(i,k,wtrc_bulk_indices(iwtvap)), q(i,k,ixh2oq), dwatr(j,i,k)
56821 format (2i3,3e20.10)
5683 end if
5684 end do
5685 end do
5686 end if
5687!
5688 do i = 1, wtrc_nspec(isph2o)
5689 icnst = wtrc_iaspec(i, isph2o)
5690 itype = wtrc_types(icnst)
5691
5692 if (count(abs(dwatr(i,:ncol,:))>max(qtol,qmin(wtrc_bulk_indices(itype)))) > 0) then
5693 write(*,*) '(wtrc_check) ' // wtype_names(itype) // ' differences: '//trim(subr)
5694 iw = maxloc(abs(dwatr(i,:ncol,:)))
5695 write(*,2) count(abs(dwatr(i,:ncol,:))>qmin(wtrc_bulk_indices(itype))),iw(1),iw(2), &
5696 dwatr(i,iw(1),iw(2)), q(iw(1),iw(2),wtrc_indices(icnst))
5697 if (.not. wtrc_warn_only) &
5698 call endrun('wtrc_check: ' // wtrc_names(icnst) // ' check failed.')
5699 endif
5700 end do
5701 2 format(i4,' point(s), worst (i,k):',2i5,2e16.6)
5702!
5703! Do any adjustments
5704!
5705 if (wtrc_lh2oadj) then
5706!! write(*,*) 'Applying rescaling to tracers to prohibit drift.'
5707 call wtrc_rescale(q,ncol)
5708 end if
5709!
5710#ifdef QCHKMESS
5711 write(iulog,*) '(wtrc_check) all OK: '//trim(subr)
5712#endif
5713!
5714 return
5715 end subroutine wtrc_check
5716
5717
5718end module water_tracers
